programs.program_name: Ph.D. in Integrated Toxicology and Environmental Health

funding.note: Fully funded 5 yrs (stipend, tuition, fees, health insurance)

faculty.name: Joel N. Meyer
faculty.title: Sally Kleberg Distinguished Professor; Professor of Environmental Genomics
faculty.summary: Studies the toxicity and genotoxicity of environmental contaminants including polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and nanomaterials, with a particular focus on effects on mitochondria and mitochondrial DNA.

faculty.name: Heather M. Stapleton
faculty.title: Ronie-Richele Garcia-Johnson Distinguished Professor; Professor in the Division of Environmental Natural Sciences
faculty.summary: Investigates the sources, fate, transport, transformation, and metabolism of organic contaminants, emphasizing flame retardants and mechanisms of thyroid system disruption.

faculty.name: Nishad Jayasundara
faculty.title: Juli Plant Grainger Assistant Professor of Global Environmental Health; Assistant Professor of Environmental Toxicology and Health
faculty.summary: Uses a One Health framework to study the ecological and human health implications of chemical pollution.

faculty.name: Sven-Eric Jordt
faculty.title: Distinguished Professor of Anesthesiology; Professor of Pharmacology and Cancer Biology
faculty.summary: Investigates the mechanisms of environmental chemical irritation and chemical sensing and their contributions to inflammation, asthma, and lung injury.

faculty.name: Theodore Slotkin
faculty.title: Professor of Pharmacology and Cancer Biology
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of environmental toxicants including insecticides and nanoparticles, particularly on nervous-system development.

faculty.name: Edward D. Levin
faculty.title: Professor in Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences; Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
faculty.summary: Studies toxicological influences on learning and memory, utilizing both rodent and zebrafish models.

faculty.name: Donald P. McDonnell
faculty.title: Glaxo-Wellcome Distinguished Professor of Molecular Cancer Biology; Professor of Pharmacology and Cancer Biology
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms through which both therapeutic agents and endocrine disrupters modulate cell function.

faculty.name: Christopher M. Counter
faculty.title: George Barth Geller Distinguished Professor of Pharmacology; Professor of Pharmacology and Cancer Biology
faculty.summary: Examines how environmental carcinogens induce specific cancers using mouse models and sequencing approaches.

faculty.name: Laurie H. Sanders
faculty.title: Associate Professor in Neurology; Associate Professor of Pathology
faculty.summary: Investigates environmental influences on mitochondrial DNA damage in neurological disorders.

faculty.name: Samira Musah
faculty.title: Assistant Professor in the Department of Biomedical Engineering; Assistant Professor in Medicine
faculty.summary: Develops stem cell and organ-on-chip systems to model toxicity and disease mechanisms.

faculty.name: Robert M. Tighe
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Medicine; Associate Professor in the Division of Environmental Natural Sciences
faculty.summary: Identifies susceptibility factors relevant to host responses to environmental pollutants, studying mechanisms of air pollution exposure and lung injury and repair.

faculty.name: Kate Hoffman
faculty.title: Elizabeth Brooks Reid and Whitelaw Reid Associate Research Professor of Environmental Natural Sciences
faculty.summary: Investigates environmental contaminant exposure pathways, particularly among children.

faculty.name: Junfeng (Jim) Zhang
faculty.title: Professor of Global and Environmental Health
faculty.summary: Develops novel biomarkers of exposure and adverse health effects related to air pollution and studies the co-benefits of pollution-reduction interventions.

faculty.name: Christine K. Payne
faculty.title: Professor in the Thomas Lord Department of Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science
faculty.summary: Investigates the cellular response to nanoparticles present in the environment.

faculty.name: Michael H. Bergin
faculty.title: Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Investigates the influence of air pollution, particularly PM2.5, on both climate and human health.

faculty.name: Yan Lin
faculty.title: Assistant Research Professor in the Division of Environmental Natural Sciences
faculty.summary: Examines the role of lipid metabolism in cardiopulmonary diseases arising from air pollution exposure.

faculty.name: Mercedes Bravo
faculty.title: Assistant Research Professor of Global Health; Assistant Research Professor in the Division of Environmental Natural Sciences
faculty.summary: Studies connections between social and environmental exposures and health disparities, focusing on air pollution and environmental justice.

faculty.name: AnnMarie Walton
faculty.title: Dorothy L. Powell Term Chair of Nursing; Associate Professor in the School of Nursing
faculty.summary: Studies occupational exposure to carcinogens, particularly pesticide exposure among farmworkers.

programs.program_name: Ph.D. in Marine Science and Conservation

funding.note: Fully funded 5 yrs (stipend, tuition, fees, health insurance)

faculty.name: Andrew J. Read
faculty.title: Stephen A. Toth Distinguished Professor of Marine Biology in the Nicholas School of the Environment
faculty.summary: Read studies the conservation biology of long-lived marine vertebrates, particularly marine mammals, seabirds, and sea turtles. His work documents the effects of human activities on these populations through fieldwork, experimentation, and modeling.

faculty.name: Brian R. Silliman
faculty.title: Rachel Carson Professor of Marine Conservation Biology
faculty.summary: Silliman focuses on community ecology, food webs, conservation, restoration, and the ecological consequences of cooperative behavior in marine environments. His work examines how species interactions and mutualisms shape coastal ecosystems and inform strategies for protecting and restoring marine habitats.

faculty.name: Douglas P. Nowacek
faculty.title: Randolph K. Repass and Sally-Christine Rodgers University Distinguished Professor of Conservation Technology in Environment and Engineering
faculty.summary: Nowacek investigates the link between acoustic and motor behavior in marine mammals, primarily cetaceans and manatees, focusing on echolocation, foraging behaviors, and the impacts of human-generated noise on marine species.

faculty.name: Patrick N. Halpin
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Halpin's work centers on marine geospatial analysis and the ecological applications of geographic information systems and remote sensing to marine conservation and ecosystem-based management. He leads the Marine Geospatial Ecology Lab and applies spatial technologies to inform conservation for marine species and habitats.

faculty.name: James L. Hench
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Oceanography
faculty.summary: Hench's laboratory investigates fluid dynamics in the coastal ocean and its effects on transport processes through field measurements, computational models, and theory. His work emphasizes coral reef hydrodynamics and how water motion influences geochemistry, biology, and ecology in shallow marine environments.

faculty.name: Dana E. Hunt
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Microbial Ecology
faculty.summary: Hunt studies bacterial ecology and diversity, examining how microbes interact with their environments across temporal and spatial scales. Her lab investigates bacterial responses to environmental factors such as temperature change and emerging pollutants to understand the forces driving microbial diversity in nature.

faculty.name: Zackary I. Johnson
faculty.title: Juli Plant Grainger Associate Professor of Biological Oceanography and Marine Biotechnology
faculty.summary: Johnson's group investigates the distribution, diversity, and function of marine microorganisms, with particular focus on Prochlorococcus, the most abundant phytoplankton in the open oceans. Their work also explores biotechnological applications of marine microalgae for food and fuel.

faculty.name: Grant D. Murray
faculty.title: Professor of Marine Policy in the Marine Science and Conservation Division
faculty.summary: Murray investigates the social and economic dimensions of marine resource management, with a focus on aquaculture conflicts and coastal community impacts. His current work examines oyster mortality events, shellfish aquaculture expansion, and the competing values shaping policy debates in coastal waters.

faculty.name: Lisa M. Campbell
faculty.title: Rachel Carson Distinguished Professor of Marine Affairs and Policy
faculty.summary: Campbell investigates ocean governance across issues including fisheries, marine protected areas, and the blue economy, drawing on political ecology and science studies to examine how science and state and non-state actors shape governance outcomes. She also develops participatory and collaborative research methodologies.

faculty.name: Daniel Rittschof
faculty.title: Norman L. Christensen Distinguished Professor of Environmental Sciences
faculty.summary: Rittschof studies marine ecology, including larval biology and chemical, behavioral, and spatial ecology as well as environmental toxicology. His work spans macroinvertebrate ecology (blue crabs and mud snails), barnacle biology relevant to fouling prevention and bioadhesives, and xenobiotic impacts on marine organisms.

faculty.name: David A. Gill
faculty.title: Assistant Professor in the Division of Marine Science and Conservation
faculty.summary: Gill examines marine coupled human-natural systems with an emphasis on tropical coral reef management and conservation. His research provides evidence-based insights into how marine management and conservation can lead to equitable and sustainable outcomes, drawing on economics, ecology, and political science.

programs.program_name: Ph.D. in Civil and Environmental Engineering

funding.note: Fully funded 5 yrs (stipend, tuition, fees, health insurance)

faculty.name: Mike Bergin
faculty.title: Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Bergin investigates how atmospheric particles affect Earth's climate and human health, studying the emission, transformation, and deposition of particulate matter across polluted and pristine environments.

faculty.name: Fred Boadu
faculty.title: CEE Director of Master's Studies, Associate Professor of Civil & Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Boadu investigates how the engineering, environmental, and petrophysical properties of porous media (soils, fractured rock, biological tissues) affect measurable geophysical responses and develops methods to obtain these properties through non-invasive geophysical measurements.

faculty.name: Mark Borsuk
faculty.title: James L. and Elizabeth M. Vincent Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.sub_field: Environmental systems modeling and risk analysis
faculty.summary: Borsuk develops mathematical models for integrating scientific information across natural, technical, and social systems, specializing in Bayesian network modeling applied to environmental and human health decision-making.

faculty.name: Andy Bragg
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Bragg studies the physics and modeling of turbulence and turbulent transport, theoretical and computational fluid dynamics, and applied mathematics, focusing on complex turbulent flows in natural and engineered systems.

faculty.name: David Carlson
faculty.title: Yoh Family Associate Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Carlson develops machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques to accelerate scientific discovery, with applications in environmental health, mental health, and neuroscience.

faculty.name: Nathaniel Chaney
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Chaney harnesses global environmental data to improve understanding of the terrestrial water cycle, focusing on quantifying the role of multi-scale spatial organization over land in Earth systems.

faculty.name: Laura Dalton
faculty.title: Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.sub_field: Reactive multiphase transport in porous media
faculty.summary: Dalton is an experimentalist studying reactive, multiphase transport in porous media, working to understand and manipulate the chemical and physical processes that occur in engineered (cementitious) and natural (geological) porous materials.

faculty.name: Jeseth Delgado Vela
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Delgado Vela leverages environmental biotechnology to improve urban water infrastructure, integrating molecular tools and modeling to understand microbial community interactions in engineered water treatment systems.

faculty.name: Marc Deshusses
faculty.title: Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Deshusses focuses on the design, analysis, and application of remediation, waste-to-energy, and decentralized sanitation processes, developing novel reactors for treating air, water, and solid wastes.

faculty.name: Lee Ferguson
faculty.title: Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Ferguson develops analytical methods for measuring organic pollutants, with a major focus on high-resolution mass spectrometry to detect emerging contaminants such as PFAS in wastewater and drinking water.

faculty.name: Henri P. Gavin
faculty.title: W.H. Gardner Jr. Chair of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Professor
faculty.summary: Gavin's work spans computational mechanics, structural dynamics, and control systems, with emphasis on earthquake engineering and semi-active vibration isolation technologies.

faculty.name: Leanne M. Gilbertson
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Gilbertson develops sustainable materials to address environmental challenges, integrating molecular design with life cycle assessment to minimize impacts while solving environmental and public health problems.

faculty.name: Claudia Gunsch
faculty.title: Muriel Theodorsen Williams E'46 Distinguished Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Gunsch's research bridges environmental engineering and molecular biotechnology, investigating the ecological impacts of emerging contaminants on environmental microbiomes and developing microbiome engineering approaches for bioremediation and water treatment.

faculty.name: Heileen Hsu-Kim
faculty.title: Director of Graduate Studies, Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Hsu-Kim specializes in environmental aquatic chemistry and geochemistry, applying geochemical principles to understand the persistence, mobility, and bioavailability of pollutant metals in natural and built environments.

faculty.name: Andrew D. Jones
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.sub_field: Transport at biological interfaces and biofilms
faculty.summary: Jones's work focuses on transport mechanisms at biological interfaces, developing tools to address biofilms responsible for vascular graft infections, skin infections, waterborne diseases, and post-flood mold contamination.

faculty.name: Zbigniew Kabala
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Kabala's work focuses on groundwater hydrology, contaminant transport, and fluid dynamics through porous media, with applications to environmental remediation and aquifer characterization.

faculty.name: Gaby Katul
faculty.title: George Pearsall Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Katul conducts research on hydrology and fluid dynamics, focusing on turbulent transport processes in atmospheric boundary layers and canopy flows, with applications to water-plant-atmosphere interactions and ecosystem fluxes.

faculty.name: Jerome Lynch
faculty.title: Vinik Dean of Engineering; Fitzpatrick Family University Distinguished Professor of Engineering; Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineer
faculty.sub_field: Structural health monitoring and cyber-physical systems
faculty.summary: Lynch advances cyber-physical system architectures combining sensing, computing, and control for intelligent civil infrastructure, and is recognized for structural health monitoring research that assesses infrastructure performance to enhance safety and resilience.

faculty.name: Nicole C. Rockey
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Rockey's work focuses on reducing infectious disease burden by better understanding the persistence of viral pathogens in the built environment, using laboratory and modeling methods to assess transmission risks and develop engineering solutions.

faculty.name: Hossein (Amir) Salahshoor
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Salahshoor develops data-driven and computational frameworks to predict, control, and engineer the behavior of complex material systems, with applications to sustainability and health challenges including brain mechanics and advanced metamaterials.

faculty.name: Guglielmo Scovazzi
faculty.title: Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Scovazzi's work focuses on finite element and advanced numerical methods for computational fluid and solid mechanics, emphasizing multiphase porous media flows, transient compressible flows, turbulent flows, and fluid-structure interaction.

faculty.name: Manolis Veveakis
faculty.title: Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering; Associate Chair
faculty.summary: Veveakis focuses on theoretical and applied mechanics, geomechanics, and irreversible thermodynamics, with emphasis on multiphysical modeling of plasticity of solids, solid-fluid interactions, friction laws, and rheology of geomaterials.

faculty.name: Mark Wiesner
faculty.title: James B. Duke Distinguished Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Wiesner's research encompasses membrane processes, nanostructured materials, and the transport and fate of nanomaterials in the environment, along with related colloidal and environmental systems analysis.

faculty.name: Marta Zaniolo
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
faculty.sub_field: Water resources modeling and machine learning
faculty.summary: Zaniolo addresses water sustainability challenges by combining hydrology and water resources modeling with machine learning, focusing on ensuring reliable water access amid scarcity, competing demands, and climate change.

faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Works in condensed matter theory on how topology, symmetries, geometry, and interactions give rise to topological phases in insulators, superconductors, and metamaterials including photonic and acoustic crystals.

requirements.admission_model: Rotations program; no advisor commitment before admission

faculty.name: Robert Krafty
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for time series, longitudinal, signal, and functional data analysis, with applications to mental, behavioral, and social health. His group works with physiological signals (heart rate variability, EEG), wearable device data (Fitbits), and real-time self-reported data from mobile apps to understand biological underpinnings of health.

faculty.name: Howard Chang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops and applies statistical methods for analyzing complex spatial-temporal exposure and health data. Leads the ENVISON Research Group, co-leads the Emory Climate & Health Actionable Research and Translation Center (CHART), and conducts epidemiologic studies on environmental exposures including air pollution, extreme heat, and the built environment.

faculty.name: Limin Peng
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on survival analysis, dynamic regression, nonparametric and semiparametric inference, with recent extensions into causal inference, latent class analysis, and high-dimensional statistical learning. Collaborative research spans diabetes, cystic fibrosis, neurology, and other chronic diseases. ASA Fellow (2016), IMS Fellow (2022), and Mortimer Spiegelman Award recipient (2017).

faculty.name: Zhaohui (Steve) Qin
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops Bayesian model-based methods for next-generation sequencing technologies (ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, Hi-C, WGBS, resequencing) and creates accompanying software tools. Collaborates with biomedical scientists on projects using sequencing to understand genomics and epigenomics, with expertise spanning machine learning, Bayesian analysis, and statistical modeling.

faculty.name: Lance Waller
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops and applies statistical methods for spatially referenced data across environmental justice, neurology, epidemiology, and disease ecology. Co-author of Applied Spatial Statistics for Public Health Data (Wiley, 2004). Serves on the Independent Census Scientific Advisory Committee and directs the PhD program.

faculty.name: John Hanfelt
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops latent variable methods to gain insight into neurodegenerative diseases and robust methods for complex longitudinal and cluster-correlated studies. Directs the biostatistics/epidemiology/research design program for Georgia's CTSA and co-directs the statistics/data management core of the Emory Goizueta Alzheimer's Disease Research Center. ASA Fellow.

faculty.name: Amita Manatunga
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops methodology for multivariate survival data and assessing agreement in biomedical studies. Involved in reproductive/environmental epidemiology, renal imaging, and mental health research. Serves as primary biostatistician for Emory's GCRC and has collaborated on studies in hypertension, cardiology, and kidney disease. ASA Fellow (2004), COPSS E.L. Scott Award recipient (2020).

faculty.name: Robert Lyles
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods applicable to epidemiological studies, including missing and mismeasured data problems encountered in mortality/morbidity surveillance and with lab assay data in HIV and environmental research. Directs the Biostatistics and Bioinformatics Core of Emory's Center for AIDS Research. ASA Fellow.

faculty.name: Yijian (Eugene) Huang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works on survival analysis (multi-state processes, quality-adjusted survival time, lifetime medical cost, recurrent events, quantile regression), covariate measurement error, classification and prediction, and semi- and non-parametric inferences. Applied work in cancer, HIV/AIDS, cardiovascular diseases, and kidney disease. ASA Fellow with over 80 published papers.

faculty.name: Ying Guo
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Directs the Center for Biomedical Imaging Statistics (CBIS) and focuses on imaging statistics, brain network analysis, dimension reduction, blind source separation, and independent component analysis (ICA). Applies these methods to mental health, child development, and women's health research, with extensive collaboration with neurologists on depression imaging biomarkers. ASA Fellow (2018).

faculty.name: David Benkeser
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on the theory and applications of machine learning in causal inference, with collaborative research on preventive vaccines, tuberculosis, and HIV prevention. Also works on survival analysis, competing risks, complex longitudinal data, and robust nonparametric statistical inference. Serves as Director of Data Science Initiatives.

faculty.name: Karen Conneely
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for genetic and epigenetic studies, focusing on genetic association studies, DNA methylation, epigenetic aging biomarkers, and integrative genomics using genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic data. Applies these methods to understand how environment and genetics influence health outcomes.

faculty.name: Natalie Dean
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops quantitative methods for evaluating intervention effectiveness for emerging infectious diseases, particularly vaccine trial design and observational study designs like the test-negative design. Co-directs the Emory Alliance for Vaccine Epidemiology (EAVE) and leads the CDC-funded Emory Center for Infectious Disease Modeling and Analytics Training Hub (CIDMATH).

faculty.name: Donald Lee
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops nonparametric machine learning methods for survival analysis with time-dependent covariates, including the BoXHED gradient boosting framework published in Annals of Statistics. Applies these methods to healthcare settings including real-time warning indicators for stroke, early mortality prediction for cancer patients, and ICU mortality prediction.

faculty.name: Max (Siu Yin) Lau
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops innovative models and algorithms blending statistics, computational models, and ML/AI for infectious disease dynamics, phylodynamic inference, and spatiotemporal outbreak forecasting. Secondary appointments in Epidemiology and Computer Science. Actively mentors graduate students and postdocs.

faculty.name: Razieh Nabi
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops novel causal methodologies to address unmeasured confounders, missing or censored data, measurement error, and algorithmic bias. Draws on machine learning/AI (especially graphical models) and semiparametric statistics, with applications in healthcare, social justice, and public policy. PhD from Johns Hopkins (2021) under Ilya Shpitser.

faculty.name: Chang Su
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methodology for single-cell genomics and genetics, with a focus on gene network inference and understanding the genetic basis of single-cell genomics. Applies these methods to neurodegenerative, lung, and immune diseases. Holds a secondary appointment in Human Genetics.

faculty.name: Jian Hu
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops novel statistical methods for biomedical data including single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, multi-omics analysis, and digital pathology. Combines statistics, machine learning, and computational biology to elucidate the structure and function of genomes, with a joint appointment in Human Genetics. PhD in Biostatistics from Penn.

faculty.name: Julia Wrobel
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for functional data analysis with applications to wearable device data, spatial proteomics, multiplex single-cell imaging, and digital biomarkers (e.g., pupil light response for cannabis impairment detection). Contributes to open-source R packages including registr and mxnorm. Core faculty in Emory Center for AI Learning. PhD from Columbia (2019).

faculty.name: Yang Liu
faculty.title: Professor, Chair & Gangarosa Distinguished Professor of Environmental Health
faculty.summary: Develops data-driven methods, including satellite remote sensing, to understand how environmental exposures such as air pollution and extreme weather affect health outcomes like cancer, cardiovascular disease, and mental health.

faculty.name: Howard Chang
faculty.title: Professor, Vice Chair for Education
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for spatial-temporal exposure and health data, and conducts epidemiologic research on air pollution, heat, and built-environment effects.

faculty.name: Donghai Liang
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Exposure scientist and molecular epidemiologist characterizing the human exposome and the molecular mechanisms of health responses to air pollution and persistent organic pollutants, spanning maternal/child health, cancer, and Alzheimer's disease.

faculty.name: Carmen Marsit
faculty.title: Professor, Rollins Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates the molecular and epigenomic mechanisms by which environmental exposures affect disease, including cancer, pregnancy outcomes, and childhood conditions, within the exposome framework.

faculty.name: Dana Barr
faculty.title: Professor, Rollins Endowed Faculty Scholar
faculty.summary: Uses analytical chemistry to assess exposure to environmental toxicants and evaluate exposure sources, with a maternal-child health focus on prenatal exposures and neurodevelopment.

faculty.name: William Caudle
faculty.title: Associate Research Professor, Director of Graduate Studies (PhD Program)
faculty.summary: Integrates neuroscience and toxicology to study how environmental chemicals contribute to neurological disease and neurodegeneration.

faculty.name: Stefanie Ebelt
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies ambient air quality, climate, and health using exposure science and epidemiologic methods, including population-based studies of vulnerable groups drawing on administrative health data.

faculty.name: Stephanie Eick
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, EH-EPI MPH Program Director
faculty.summary: Environmental and reproductive epidemiologist studying the health effects of chemical and psychosocial stressors during pregnancy, with a focus on chemical mixtures and biomarkers of oxidative stress and inflammation.

faculty.name: Christine Ekenga
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Rollins Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Examines how environmental and occupational factors drive health disparities using a strengths-based, community-engaged epidemiologic approach, with recent focus on cancers and respiratory disease.

faculty.name: Todd Everson
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates how early-life exposures shape epigenomic and transcriptomic patterns and long-term health, through epigenome-wide association studies and multi-cohort collaborations on children's health.

faculty.name: Audrey Gaskins
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Rollins Endowed Faculty Scholar
faculty.summary: Investigates how environmental, dietary, and lifestyle factors relate to reproductive health and fertility, often using assisted-reproductive-technology cohorts.

faculty.name: Xin Hu
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Uses high-resolution mass spectrometry and omics to study how environmental contaminants affect health, focusing on prenatal exposure impacts on fetal respiratory development and early-life lung disease.

faculty.name: Anke Hüls
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Rollins Endowed Faculty Scholar
faculty.summary: Studies how air pollution, social factors, and molecular epigenetic mechanisms affect cognitive health across the lifespan, from cognitive decline in adults to development in children.

faculty.name: Longxiang Li
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Assesses human exposure to environmental pollutants and associated health effects, focusing on unconventional oil and gas development, and develops satellite-based machine-learning models and high-resolution radon maps.

faculty.name: Maya Nadimpalli
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Food-borne pathogen transmission & gut microbiome epidemiology
faculty.summary: Combines environmental microbiology, epidemiology, and genomics to study how food affects health via the gut microbiome, focusing on antibiotic-resistant pathogens in food systems.

faculty.name: Amina Salamova
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Vice Chair
faculty.summary: Uses analytical chemistry and exposure assessment to study exposures to harmful chemical contaminants, especially semi-volatile organic compounds, in vulnerable populations and to develop interventions.

faculty.name: Jeremy Sarnat
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies (MPH Programs), Rollins Endowed Faculty Scholar
faculty.summary: Characterizes human exposure to urban air pollution and identifies the pollutant sources and chemical components responsible for adverse health effects, including the impact of exposure measurement error.

faculty.name: Noah Scovronick
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on the links between human health, climate change, and climate policy, and also investigates exposure to harmful industrial chemicals in Georgia.

faculty.name: Lisa Thompson
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on environmental health and nursing with emphasis on sustainability and environmental public health, leading environmental-health evaluation and implementation-science research.

faculty.name: Douglas Walker
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Environmental engineer and analytical chemist developing high-throughput exposome methods and exposome-wide association study approaches to measure unidentified exposures and mechanisms of environment-related disease.

faculty.name: Qiang Zhang
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops mechanistic quantitative adverse outcome pathway (qAOP) and physiologically based toxicokinetic models to understand how environmental chemicals, supplements, and drugs alter molecular pathways affecting health.

faculty.name: Thomas Gillespie
faculty.title: Professor & Chair
faculty.sub_field: Disease ecology and zoonotic pathogen emergence
faculty.summary: Studies interactions among anthropogenic environmental change, biodiversity, and the ecology and emergence of pathogens affecting people, wildlife, and domestic animals, with fieldwork in Africa and Latin America.

faculty.name: Jola Ajibade
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Environmental/human geography focused on climate justice and equitable adaptation
faculty.summary: Uses environmental justice and political ecology frameworks to study climate risk, urban disasters, climate migration, and adaptation, focusing on how exclusionary policies reproduce structural inequalities.

faculty.name: Megan Mucioki
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Interdisciplinary scholar examining food sovereignty, traditional foods, and ecocultural restoration in partnership with Indigenous communities, integrating ethnoecology, botany, applied anthropology, and Indigenous studies.

faculty.name: Stacy-ann Robinson
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Climate change adaptation and policy in small island developing states
faculty.summary: Examines the human, social, and policy dimensions of climate change adaptation in small island developing states across multiple scales, using qualitative and mixed methods.

faculty.name: Emily Burchfield
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Her FACES lab integrates social and environmental data to study agricultural sustainability, modeling land-use impacts on agroecological outcomes and drivers of farm-level behavior across scales.

faculty.name: Xiao Huang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Coordinator of Undergraduate Research
faculty.sub_field: Geospatial analysis of human-environment systems and disaster studies
faculty.summary: Examines human-environment interactions and urban vulnerabilities via geospatial techniques and big data, applying GeoAI and deep learning to disaster monitoring, assessment, and mitigation.

faculty.name: Eric Lonsdorf
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Applied ecosystem services and conservation science
faculty.summary: Conducts applied research incorporating ecosystem services into land management decisions and policy in agricultural and urban systems, bridging environmental science, economic valuation, and decision-making.

faculty.name: Eri Saikawa
faculty.title: Professor, Director of Emory Climate Hub
faculty.summary: Interdisciplinary work spanning atmospheric chemistry, environmental health, biogeochemistry, and climate science, studying emission sources tied to air pollution, ozone depletion, and climate change and their societal consequences.

faculty.name: Gonzalo Vazquez-Prokopec
faculty.title: Professor, Director of Graduate Studies, Winship Distinguished Research Professor in Environmental Sciences
faculty.sub_field: Ecology and spatial epidemiology of vector-borne infectious diseases
faculty.summary: Studies vector-borne diseases at the intersection of ecology and spatial epidemiology, focusing on transmission and geographic propagation and how urban landscapes influence disease spread.

faculty.name: Anthony Martin
faculty.title: Professor of Practice, Honors Program Coordinator
faculty.sub_field: Ichnology and paleontological trace fossil analysis
faculty.summary: Specializes in ichnology, the study of modern and fossil animal traces such as tracks and burrows; his discoveries include the only known burrowing dinosaur and the oldest dinosaur burrows in the record.

funding.note: All admitted students offered Graduate School Assistantship: full tuition, health insurance, stipend

faculty.name: Ali Arab
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops hierarchical Bayesian models for spatio-temporal, spatial, and time series data with applications in ecology (migratory bird patterns under climate change), epidemiology (infectious disease spread including malaria and Lyme disease), and human rights (forecasting forced displacement using unconventional data sources). Also works on Bayesian transfer learning for data-sparse contexts.

faculty.name: Sivan Leviyang
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops mathematical and statistical models of the immune response to viral infection through analysis of experimental datasets. Research spans computational transcriptomics, viral genomics, machine learning for genomics data, and single-cell RNA-seq analysis, with a focus on HIV/SIV viral evolution and CTL escape dynamics.

faculty.name: Mark J. Meyer
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Functional Data Analysis, Bayesian Statistics, Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops Bayesian and nonparametric methods for functional and longitudinal data analysis, including function-on-function regression, historical functional linear models, and functional inference. Focuses on making advanced statistical testing procedures accessible to non-specialists. Collaborates broadly across epidemiology, developmental psychology, neurology, global health security, environmental health, political science, and animal behavior. Affiliated with the Center for Global Health Scie

faculty.name: Mahlet G. Tadesse
faculty.title: Professor and Department Chair
faculty.sub_field: Bayesian Statistics, Statistical Genomics, High-dimensional Data Analysis
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and computational tools for the analysis of large-scale genomic data, including Bayesian variable selection, mixture models, MCMC methods, and integration of biological knowledge in genomic studies. Also develops predictive models for species and trait distribution patterns in highly biodiverse ecosystems. Elected Fellow of the American Statistical Association and elected member of the International Statistical Institute. Sc.D. in Biostatistics from Harvard University.

faculty.name: Maryam Yashtini
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops mathematical and computational frameworks to make AI systems more efficient, interpretable, scalable, and trustworthy. Applications include medical imaging (algorithms reducing MRI scan time from approximately 40 minutes to under 5 minutes while improving image quality), computer vision, large language models, and multimodal data integration. Ph.D. in Computational Mathematics from University of Florida, postdoc at Georgia Tech.

funding.note: Fully funded first 5 years for students in good standing: tuition, health insurance, service stipend assistantship

faculty.name: Sarah Adel Bargal
faculty.title: Assistant Professor; Provost's Distinguished Faculty Fellow
faculty.summary: Research on computer vision and machine learning, with focus on deep learning for visual understanding.

faculty.name: Matt Blaze
faculty.title: Professor; Robert L. McDevitt Chair
faculty.summary: Research on cryptography, computer and network security, and technology policy.

faculty.name: Jeremy Fineman
faculty.title: Provost's Distinguished Professor; Wagner Term Chair
faculty.summary: Research on algorithm design, data structures, parallel algorithms, scheduling, and memory-efficient algorithms.

faculty.name: Ophir Frieder
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on information retrieval, medical informatics, and communication systems.

faculty.name: Sasha Golovnev
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research on computational complexity, algorithms, pseudorandomness, cryptography, and learning theory.

faculty.name: Bala Kalyanasundaram
faculty.title: Craves Family Professor
faculty.summary: Research on online, parallel, and randomized algorithms, concrete complexity, learning theory, networking, and bioinformatics.

faculty.name: Yoshi Kohno
faculty.title: Professor; Robert L. McDevitt Chair
faculty.summary: Research on computer security, artificial intelligence and society, technology policy, and ethics and technology.

faculty.name: Mark Maloof
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on machine learning, data mining, online learning, concept drift, and security applications of ML.

faculty.name: Calvin Newport
faculty.title: Provost's Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Research on distributed algorithms and wireless networks.

faculty.name: Kobbi Nissim
faculty.title: Professor; Robert L. McDevitt Term Chair
faculty.summary: Research on cryptography, differential privacy, and privacy law and policy.

faculty.name: Elissa Redmiles
faculty.title: Clare Boothe Luce Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research on security, privacy, and ethics, with focus on usable security, measurement, HCI, and data science.

faculty.name: Nathan Schneider
faculty.title: Associate Professor (joint with Linguistics)
faculty.summary: Research on computational linguistics and natural language processing, including corpus annotation, machine learning, and applications.

faculty.name: Micah Sherr
faculty.title: Callahan Family Professor
faculty.summary: Research on security, privacy, and networks. Leads the Georgetown Security Lab.

faculty.name: Clay Shields
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on computer security, network security, and digital forensics.

faculty.name: Lisa Singh
faculty.title: Professor; Department Chair
faculty.summary: Research on data mining, social mining, privacy, visual analytics, data science, and databases.

faculty.name: Justin Thaler
faculty.title: Provost's Distinguished Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research on algorithms for massive data sets, verifiable computation, and computational learning.

faculty.name: Benjamin Ujcich
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research on security, networking, systems, and provenance.

faculty.name: Nitin Vaidya
faculty.title: Professor; Robert L. McDevitt Chair
faculty.summary: Research on distributed algorithms and systems, secure and fault-tolerant algorithms for optimization and machine learning.

faculty.name: Mahe Velauthapillai
faculty.title: Professor; McBride Family Endowed Chair
faculty.summary: Research on learning theory, algorithms, and bioinformatics.

faculty.name: Radha Venkatagiri
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research on computer architecture, hardware resiliency, and approximate computing.

faculty.name: Muthu Venkitasubramaniam
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on cryptography, privacy, network security, and complexity theory.

faculty.name: Grace Hui Yang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on information retrieval, deep reinforcement learning, machine learning, ontology, question answering, and privacy.

funding.note: Assistantships/fellowships available; see department graduate fellowships page

faculty.name: Paola Barbara
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies superconductivity, superconducting devices, and the transport properties of nanowires and nanoscale electronic devices. Serves as Department Chair.

faculty.name: Daniel Blair
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates soft glasses, colloidal systems, and polymer dynamics using advanced microscopy and rheology techniques.

faculty.name: Rhonda Dzakpasu
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Examines pattern formation and dynamics in neural networks using multi-electrode recordings and computational methods.

faculty.name: Emanuela Del Gado
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Uses statistical mechanics and computational physics to study the structure and dynamics of amorphous solids, gels, glasses, and cement.

faculty.name: David Egolf
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies nonequilibrium dynamical systems and spatiotemporal chaos spanning fluids, granular media, and neural tissue.

faculty.name: Jim Freericks
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates strongly correlated electrons, nonequilibrium many-body physics, and ultracold atoms in optical lattices.

faculty.name: Maryam Kohram
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Holds a joint appointment in Physics and Biology; studies self-replication, senescence, and phenotypic variability in single bacterial cells using microfluidic devices.

faculty.name: Amy Liu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Uses first-principles computational methods to study the structural, electronic, and vibrational properties of novel materials including superconductors.

faculty.name: Kai Liu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on nanostructured magnetic materials, magnetic skyrmions, and magneto-ionic control of interfaces. Holds the McDevitt Chair.

faculty.name: Peter Olmsted
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works on soft matter physics and biophysics, including non-equilibrium phase transitions and the dynamics and mechanics of polymers, proteins, and lipid bilayer membranes.

faculty.name: Makarand Paranjape
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops micro- and nanotechnologies, including MEMS devices and sensors, for biomedical and electronic applications.

faculty.name: Jeff Urbach
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches cellular biophysics, physics of soft matter and biomaterials, biomedical optics, and granular dynamics.

faculty.name: Edward Van Keuren
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works on optics, nanoparticle synthesis and characterization, and applications of nanoparticles in photovoltaics and biomedical imaging.

faculty.name: Gen Yin
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Works on computational quantum geometry and topology, charge and spin transport theory, and the modeling of topological materials.

Merit-based fellowships (tuition, stipend, health/dental, fees); all applicants automatically considered

faculty.name: Ming T. Tan
faculty.title: Professor and Chair of Biostatistics; Director of Ph.D. Graduate Studies
faculty.summary: Tan's research focuses on statistical methods for evaluating multi-drug combinations and designing pre-clinical drug therapy studies, along with analysis of high-dimensional genomics data.

faculty.name: Jaeil Ahn
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Ahn develops statistical methods for tumor heterogeneity problems based on gene sequencing data, gene-environment interaction, and case-control studies.

faculty.name: Ruzong Fan
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Fan conducts statistical examination of complex genetic and genomic data to understand the biological architecture of disease.

faculty.name: Hongbin Fang
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Fang works on the statistical design and analysis of laboratory, translational, clinical, and epidemiological studies in cancer.

faculty.name: Valeriy R. Korostyshevskiy
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics; Director of MS Graduate Studies
faculty.summary: Korostyshevskiy studies nonlinear differential equations for metabolic pathways, biomedical imaging, and robust computational methods.

faculty.name: James Li
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Li's research centers on machine learning, deep learning, and AI algorithms and their biomedical applications, as well as DevOps.

faculty.name: George Luta
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Luta develops empirical likelihood-based statistical methods for the analysis of data from clinical trials.

faculty.name: Kepher Makambi
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Makambi's research includes meta-analysis, adaptive design methods in clinical trials, structural equation modeling, and statistical methods in epidemiology.

faculty.name: Hongkun Wang
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Wang works on survival analysis, quality-adjusted lifetime analysis with censored data, and cost-effectiveness analysis.

faculty.name: Ao Yuan
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Yuan's research spans non-, semi-, and parametric methods, clinical trials, causal inference, statistical genetics, and Bayesian methods.

faculty.name: Simina M. Boca
faculty.title: Associate Professor (Innovation Center for Biomedical Informatics)
faculty.summary: Boca's research involves omics data analysis, including genomics and metabolomics, applied to precision medicine and cancer epidemiology.

faculty.name: Robert A. Beckman
faculty.title: Professor of Oncology and Biostatistics, Bioinformatics & Biomathematics
faculty.summary: Beckman's research focuses on cancer therapy development with emphasis on personalized medicine and tumor heterogeneity.

faculty.name: Ophir Frieder
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science (affiliated, Biostatistics/Bioinformatics)
faculty.summary: Frieder works on information retrieval, medical informatics, and communication systems.

faculty.name: Christopher A. Loffredo
faculty.title: Professor of Oncology; Program Leader, Cancer Prevention and Control
faculty.summary: Loffredo studies environmental and genetic causes of cancer, including the roles of chronic infection and chemical exposure.

faculty.name: Michael W. Plankey
faculty.title: Professor of Medicine (affiliated, Biostatistics)
faculty.summary: Plankey applies longitudinal data analysis methods to study syndemic risk factors and HIV outcomes.

faculty.name: Rochelle E. Tractenberg
faculty.title: Professor of Neurology; Director, Collaborative for Research on Outcomes and Metrics
faculty.summary: Tractenberg's research covers statistical methodology education, curriculum development, and neuropsychological assessment and outcome metrics.

faculty.name: Chiranjeev Dash
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Oncology; Assistant Director of Health Disparities Research
faculty.summary: Dash's research covers epidemiologic study design and molecular epidemiology in minority populations.

faculty.name: Jacob Abernethy
faculty.title: Associate Professor, School of Computer Science

faculty.name: Matthew Baker

faculty.name: Anton Bernshteyn

faculty.name: Greg Blekherman
faculty.title: Professor (School of Mathematics)

faculty.name: Leonid Bunimovich
faculty.title: Regents' Professor (School of Mathematics)
faculty.summary: Regents' Professor working in dynamical systems and statistical mechanics, known for foundational work on chaotic billiards.

faculty.name: Zongchen Chen
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, School of Computer Science
faculty.summary: Works in theoretical computer science, including sampling and counting algorithms, Markov chain mixing, and connections to statistical physics.

faculty.name: Diego Cifuentes Pardo
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Professor in ISyE. Research in optimization.

faculty.name: Ernie Croot
faculty.title: Professor (School of Mathematics)
faculty.summary: Works in number theory and additive combinatorics, including problems on arithmetic progressions and sumsets.

faculty.name: Santanu Dey
faculty.title: Professor, ISyE (Anderson-Interface Chair)
faculty.summary: Works in integer and mixed-integer optimization, including cutting-plane theory and convexification.

faculty.name: Zvi Galil

faculty.name: Srinivas Aluru
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in parallel algorithms for computational biology and bioinformatics. Develops high-performance computing methods for genome assembly, sequence analysis, and large-scale biological data processing. Known for foundational contributions to scalable bioinformatics algorithms.

faculty.name: King Jordan
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Directs a computational laboratory focused on human clinical and population genomics, studying the relationship between genetic ancestry and health outcomes. Leads bioinformatics capacity-building initiatives in Latin America and Africa. Director of the Bioinformatics Graduate Program.

faculty.name: Gregory Gibson
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Pioneering researcher in systems genetics, studying how genetic variation contributes to complex traits and disease susceptibility. Integrates genomics, transcriptomics, and computational approaches to understand genotype-phenotype relationships in human health.

faculty.name: Peng Qiu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops computational methods for analyzing single-cell data, with applications in immunology, cancer biology, and systems biology. Creates algorithms for automated cell population identification, trajectory inference, and integrative analysis of high-dimensional cytometry and single-cell sequencing data.

faculty.name: Saurabh Sinha
faculty.title: Wallace H. Coulter Distinguished Faculty Chair and Professor
faculty.summary: Researches computational methods for understanding gene regulation, developing algorithms to model transcriptional regulatory networks from genomics data. Integrates epigenomic and transcriptomic data to decipher the regulatory logic of development and disease.

faculty.name: Jeffrey Skolnick
faculty.title: GRA Eminent Scholar and Professor
faculty.summary: Director of the Center for the Study of Systems Biology. Develops computational approaches for protein structure and function prediction, protein-protein interactions, and systems-level modeling of biological networks. Pioneered threading methods for protein structure prediction and integrative systems biology approaches.

faculty.name: Elizabeth Cherry
faculty.title: Associate Professor and Associate Chair for Academic Affairs
faculty.summary: Develops and applies computational models to study cardiac electrophysiology and arrhythmias. Creates high-performance scientific computing approaches for simulating cardiac dynamics at multiple scales, from ion channels to whole-heart models, with applications in personalized medicine.

faculty.name: Melissa Kemp
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Integrates computational modeling with experimental approaches to study cellular signaling networks. Develops dynamical models of redox signaling in immune cells and cancer, combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches to understand complex biological regulation.

faculty.name: Jeffrey Markowitz
faculty.title: Associate Professor

faculty.name: Christine Heitsch
faculty.title: Associate Professor

faculty.name: Sam Brown
faculty.title: Associate Professor

faculty.name: Patrick McGrath
faculty.title: Associate Professor

faculty.name: Yuhong Fan
faculty.title: Associate Professor

faculty.name: Annalise Paaby
faculty.title: Associate Professor

faculty.name: Yunan Luo
faculty.title: Assistant Professor

faculty.name: Amirali Aghazadeh
faculty.title: Assistant Professor

faculty.name: Joseph Lachance
faculty.title: Assistant Professor

faculty.name: Abigail Lind
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Uses computational and comparative genomics approaches to study microbial evolution and ecology. Develops methods for metagenomic analysis and investigates microbial diversity, host-microbe interactions, and the evolution of microbial traits.

faculty.name: Ahmet Coskun
faculty.title: Bernie Marcus Early Career Assistant Professor

faculty.name: Facundo Fernandez
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops mass spectrometry-based metabolomics approaches integrated with computational and bioinformatics methods. Creates analytical and computational tools for high-throughput metabolic profiling with applications in disease biomarker discovery and systems biology.

faculty.name: Lynn Kamerlin
faculty.title: Professor

faculty.name: Kostas Konstantinidis
faculty.title: Carlton S. Wilder Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops computational and bioinformatics methods for studying microbial communities in environmental systems. Uses metagenomics, comparative genomics, and cultivation-independent approaches to understand microbial diversity, evolution, and ecosystem function.

faculty.summary: Research encompasses subsurface flow and reactive transport, computational methods for contamination assessment and groundwater remediation design, geostatistical parameter estimation, coastal hydrogeology and seawater intrusion, and coastal urban flood modeling.

faculty.name: Da Pan
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Carlton S. Wilder Early-Career Professor
faculty.summary: Integrates trace gas sensing, multi-scale monitoring/modeling, and machine learning to study atmospheric carbon and nitrogen cycles and their impacts on air quality, climate, and environmental policy, including nitrogen deposition, VOC emissions, and secondary inorganic aerosol formation.

faculty.name: Ameet Pinto
faculty.title: Professor, Carlton S. Wilder Early-Career Professor, Associate Director of Interdisciplinary Research and Collaboration, Brook Byers Institute for Sustainable S
faculty.summary: Research focuses on characterizing and managing microbial communities in the engineered water cycle; the group develops experimental and computational approaches to translate ecological and physiological theory into industry practice.

faculty.name: Armistead G. Russell
faculty.title: Howard T. Tellepsen Chair, Regents' Professor
faculty.summary: Research aims to understand the dynamics of air pollutants at urban and regional scales and assess their health and environmental impacts to develop air quality improvement strategies, spanning air quality modeling, aerosol dynamics, atmospheric chemistry, and environmental economics.

faculty.name: Shane Snyder
faculty.title: José Domingo Pérez Foundation Chair and Professor
faculty.summary: Work emphasizes water quality, treatment, and sustainability, using in vitro bioassays to assess mixture toxicity combined with high-resolution mass spectrometry to identify contaminants, and evaluating physical-chemical treatment processes for organic chemical removal.

faculty.name: Yuanzhi Tang
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Courtesy Appointment
faculty.summary: Research focuses on the fundamentals and applications of molecular-scale geochemical reactions at mineral-water interfaces in natural and engineered systems.

faculty.name: Jingfeng Wang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research fields include foundations and models of global water-energy-carbon cycles, non-equilibrium thermodynamics of heat and radiation transfer, Amazon deforestation and regional climate dynamics, and Bayesian probability and statistics.

faculty.name: Xing Xie
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Carlton S. Wilder Early-Career Professor, Group Coordinator
faculty.summary: Research centers on applications of environmental biotechnology and materials science at the nexus of water, food, energy, and health, including water treatment and reuse, pollutant detection and quantification, and energy and resource recovery.

faculty.name: Shaowen Bardzell
faculty.title: Professor and Chair of Interactive Computing
faculty.summary: Pioneer of feminist HCI and humanistic approaches to interaction design. Co-authored Humanistic HCI and Critical Theory and Interaction Design; researches care ethics in maker cultures and design for women's health. SIGCHI Academy member and ACM Distinguished Member.

faculty.name: Amy Bruckman
faculty.title: Regents' Professor and Senior Associate Chair
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in social computing, studying online communities, content moderation, and collaboration across differences. Author of Should You Believe Wikipedia? ACM Fellow and SIGCHI Academy member.

faculty.name: Munmun De Choudhury
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Social Computing and Digital Mental Health
faculty.summary: Directs the Social Dynamics and Well-Being Lab. Pioneered the use of social media data to predict and understand mental health conditions including depression and suicide risk. Contributed to U.S. Surgeon General's advisory on social connection. Recipient of SIGCHI Societal Impact Award and ICWSM Test-of-Time Award.

faculty.name: Betsy DiSalvo
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Directs the Culture and Technology Lab (CAT Lab), studying how cultural values shape technology use and informal learning. Designs educational technologies and games to broaden participation in computing, particularly for underserved communities.

faculty.name: Carl DiSalvo
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches design at the intersection of technology and civic life, examining how design practices can support public engagement and social change. Author of Adversarial Design. Explores alternative ways of doing design for community-oriented outcomes.

faculty.name: Keith Edwards
faculty.title: Professor and Director of GVU Center
faculty.summary: Researches HCI and ubiquitous computing, with focus on domestic technologies, interactive spaces, and understanding how people integrate technology into everyday life. Directs the GVU Center, Georgia Tech's interdisciplinary research center for people-centered technology.

faculty.name: Beki Grinter
faculty.title: Professor and Associate Dean for Faculty Development
faculty.summary: Pioneering researcher in CSCW and HCI, studying how people adopt and adapt technology in domestic and everyday settings. Her qualitative research on home technologies, religious computing, and technology in the developing world has shaped the field.

faculty.name: Michael Best
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Information and Communication Technology for Development
faculty.summary: Leads research in ICTD, studying how information and communication technologies can support sustainable development, peacebuilding, and digital inclusion in underserved regions globally. Directs the Technologies and International Development Lab.

faculty.name: Thomas Ploetz
faculty.title: Professor and Associate Chair of Graduate Studies
faculty.summary: Researches computational behavior analysis using wearable and mobile sensing. Develops machine learning methods for automated activity recognition with applications in healthcare, skill assessment, and human behavior understanding.

faculty.name: Thad Starner
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Pioneer of wearable computing who has worn a head-worn computer since 1993. Technical Lead on Google Glass. Researches accessibility technologies for Deaf and hard-of-hearing communities including ASL recognition, real-time captioning on smart glasses, and passive haptic learning for Braille acquisition. ACM Fellow and AWE XR Hall of Fame inductee.

faculty.name: Bruce Walker
faculty.title: Professor (Joint with School of Psychology)
faculty.summary: Directs the Sonification Lab, researching how sound can convey information for accessibility and data understanding. Develops assistive technologies for people with vision impairments including audio navigation systems, accessible museum exhibits, and sonification for scientific data. Former President of the International Community for Auditory Display.

faculty.name: Rosa Arriaga
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Researches human-centered computing for health and well-being, focusing on chronic care management, mental health support systems, and technologies for individuals with developmental disabilities and their caregivers.

faculty.name: Lynn Dombrowski
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Researches HCI through the lens of social justice, designing and evaluating technologies that support marginalized and underserved populations. Studies how welfare systems, community organizations, and social services use technology.

faculty.name: Andrea Grimes Parker
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Founder and director of the Wellness Technology Lab. Researches how social and interactive computing systems can address health disparities in low-SES communities and communities of color. Develops community-engaged health technologies in partnership with churches and grassroots organizations. Joint appointment at Emory Rollins School of Public Health.

faculty.name: Neha Kumar
faculty.title: Associate Professor (Joint with Sam Nunn School of International Affairs)
faculty.summary: Directs the Tandem Lab researching HCI at the intersection of global sustainable development. Designs AI and data-driven systems for frontline health workers in the Global South using ethnographic and participatory methods. President of ACM SIGCHI and NSF CAREER awardee.

faculty.name: Jessica Roberts
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Researches how technology can support learning in informal environments such as museums and science centers. Studies human-data interaction, designing tools that help learners engage with and make sense of data through interactive visualizations and participatory experiences.

faculty.name: Alex Endert
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Directs the Visual Analytics Lab, researching how interactive visual interfaces can support human sensemaking and data analysis. Develops visual analytics systems that integrate human reasoning with machine learning for intelligence analysis, text analysis, and data exploration.

faculty.name: Jennifer Kim
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Researches CSCW and HCI for health, focusing on social health information seeking and sharing practices. Studies how people with chronic and neurodevelopmental conditions use online communities and technologies for health advocacy, empathy, and peer support.

faculty.name: Judith Uchidiuno
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Researches culturally informed approaches to computer science education for underserved communities in the U.S. and globally. Designs and evaluates learning technologies that are responsive to local cultural contexts and broaden participation in computing.

faculty.name: Cindy Xiong
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Researches how visual representations of data influence human perception, cognition, and decision-making. Studies uncertainty visualization, cognitive biases in data interpretation, and how visualization design can improve data communication and trust.

faculty.name: HyunJoo Oh
faculty.title: Assistant Professor (Joint with School of Industrial Design)
faculty.summary: Researches tangible and physical computing, designing novel interactive materials and tools that blend craft, design, and computational media. Develops accessible technologies for creative expression and maker-based learning.

faculty.name: Naveena Karusala
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Researches human-centered computing for health equity in global contexts, studying the role of care work and community health practices in the design of sociotechnical systems. Uses participatory and ethnographic methods to understand technology-mediated care.

faculty.name: Cindy Kaiying Lin
faculty.title: Stephen Fleming Early Career Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Researches how sociotechnical infrastructures shape temporal experiences and inequities in public systems such as courts, healthcare, and immigration services. Uses ethnographic methods to understand how people navigate bureaucratic technologies.

faculty.name: Yalong Yang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Researches immersive visualization and visual analytics, designing novel interaction techniques for exploring data in augmented and virtual reality environments. Studies how spatial and embodied interactions can support complex data analysis and sensemaking.

faculty.name: Christos Alexopoulos
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches applied probability, simulation analysis methodology, statistics, and optimization under uncertainty, with recent work on sequential methods for estimating risk measures and using ML for production and inventory system optimization.

faculty.name: Sigrun Andradottir
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches simulation, applied probability, and stochastic optimization, with applications in production systems, service systems, and agile operations, focusing on decision making under uncertainty in queueing systems.

faculty.name: Turgay Ayer
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches healthcare analytics, AI and generative AI in medicine, and socially responsible operations, developing data-driven models to improve medical decision-making, inform health policy, and enhance humanitarian operations.

faculty.name: Xin Chen
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches optimization, revenue management, and supply chain management, spanning operations research, data analytics, dynamic pricing, and production-inventory systems.

faculty.name: Santanu Dey
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches the design and evaluation of algorithms for solving non-convex optimization problems, particularly mixed integer linear and nonlinear programming, with applications in power engineering, logistics, and statistics.

faculty.name: Yu Ding
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches engineering data science, blending data-driven techniques with physical and engineering principles, with methods primarily targeting wind energy and smart manufacturing applications.

faculty.name: Alan Erera
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches transportation and logistics systems planning and control, emphasizing planning under uncertainty and real-time operational control, including same-day delivery routing, resilient food supply chains, and container fleet management.

faculty.name: Nagi Gebraeel
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches federated and causal representation learning methods for trustworthy decisions in distributed industrial systems, advancing ML methodology for real-time monitoring and diagnostics of industrial assets.

faculty.name: David Goldsman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches simulation output analysis, statistical ranking and selection methods, and medical and humanitarian applications of operations research, bridging theoretical simulation methodology with practical healthcare applications.

faculty.name: Oktay Gunluk
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches theoretical and computational aspects of discrete optimization and integer programming, including cutting-plane methods, integer programming approaches for ML classification and clustering, and qubit assignment for quantum computing.

faculty.name: Pinar Keskinocak
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches applications of operations research in healthcare, humanitarian logistics, and supply chain management. Serves as H. Milton and Carolyn J. Stewart School Chair.

faculty.name: Guanghui Lan
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches foundational optimization methods for machine learning and intelligent decision-making systems, focusing on first-order and stochastic algorithms, optimization for reinforcement learning, and risk-averse optimization.

faculty.name: Arkadi Nemirovski
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches optimization theory and algorithms, focusing on designing efficient methods for convex programming, optimization under uncertainty, and applications in engineering and statistics.

faculty.name: Edwin Romeijn
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches optimization theory with applications in radiation therapy treatment planning and supply chain management, developing models and algorithms for cancer treatment plans, clinic scheduling, and integrated production-inventory-transportation optimization.

faculty.name: Nikolaos Sahinidis
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches at the crossroads of optimization, machine learning, and computational science, with seminal contributions to mixed-integer nonlinear optimization, sparse model discovery, and data-driven optimization applied to molecular engineering and energy systems.

faculty.name: Katya Scheinberg
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches practical algorithms and theoretical analysis for continuous optimization, including convex optimization, derivative-free optimization, machine learning, and quadratic programming, with applications in ML and reinforcement learning.

faculty.name: Jianjun Shi
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches data fusion for quality improvement, developing In-Process Quality Improvements (IPQI) and Stream of Variation (SoV) methodologies that blend engineering models with data science to enhance manufacturing and service systems.

faculty.name: Mohit Singh
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches discrete optimization, approximation algorithms, and convex optimization, with applications in cloud computing, logistics, network design, and machine learning.

faculty.name: Alejandro Toriello
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches the theory and application of supply chain management, logistics, and transportation, along with related optimization methodologies.

faculty.name: Pascal Van Hentenryck
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches artificial intelligence and operations research, developing AI methodologies and algorithms for energy systems, supply chains, manufacturing, healthcare, and mobility, with emphasis on merging AI with optimization for trustworthy AI.

faculty.name: Chelsea White
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches how real-time information and technology can enhance logistics and supply chain productivity and risk management, with special focus on the U.S. trucking industry, stochastic optimization, and supply chain disruptions.

faculty.name: Yao Xie
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches theory-grounded, computationally efficient methods for sequential inference and decision-making in high-dimensional settings, with focus on change-point detection, uncertainty quantification, and integrating generative modeling for robust inference in public safety and power-grid resilience.

faculty.name: Chuck Zhang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches additive manufacturing, scalable bio-/nano-manufacturing, advanced composite structures manufacturing and maintenance, and manufacturing cybersecurity.

faculty.name: Enlu Zhou
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches theory, methods, and applications of simulation, stochastic optimization, stochastic control, and reinforcement learning, with emphasis on data-driven decision-making, spanning robotics, systems biology, and financial engineering.
