faculty.name: Christopher G. Chute
faculty.title: Bloomberg Distinguished Professor of Health Informatics; Professor of Medicine
faculty.sub_field: Clinical data standards, terminologies and ontology
faculty.summary: Section head of Biomedical Informatics & Data Science and Chief Research Information Officer for Johns Hopkins Medicine, Chute studies how to represent clinical information to support analyses and decision support, emphasizing semantic consistency, harmonized information models, ontology, and harmonizing real-world EHR data for learning health systems.

faculty.name: Hadi Kharrazi
faculty.title: Professor of Health Policy and Management (joint appointment in Biomedical Informatics & Data Science); Director, Health Sciences Informatics PhD Program
faculty.summary: Director of the Health Sciences Informatics PhD and MSc research programs and co-director of the Center for Population Health IT (CPHIT), Kharrazi's research focuses on population and global health informatics, contextualizing clinical decision support into population health using electronic health records and consumer health informatics.

faculty.name: Harold P. Lehmann
faculty.title: Professor of Medicine (Biomedical Informatics & Data Science); Professor of Pediatrics
faculty.sub_field: Evidence-based medicine and clinical research informatics
faculty.summary: Director of research and training for the Health Sciences Informatics section, Lehmann investigates real-world evidence, evidence-based medicine and decision-making, and the informatics infrastructure for secondary use of electronic health records in clinical investigation.

faculty.name: Casey Overby Taylor
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Medicine (joint appointment in Biomedical Engineering)
faculty.summary: A BIDS-section faculty member and core faculty in the Institute for Computational Medicine, Overby Taylor works at the intersection of public health genomics and biomedical informatics, developing applications that translate genomic research into clinical and population-based health care using electronic health records.

faculty.name: Paul G. Nagy
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Medicine
faculty.summary: Head of Biomedical Informatics & Data Science and director of education for its graduate training programs, Nagy develops imaging biomarkers and conducts observational health research using standardized EHR data, and co-directs the Responsible AI, Information Sciences, and Education (RAISE) Center.

faculty.name: Karen A. Robinson
faculty.title: Professor of Medicine
faculty.summary: A faculty member in the General Internal Medicine / BIDS section, Robinson directs the Johns Hopkins Evidence-Based Practice Center and focuses on the identification, synthesis, and presentation of evidence to inform healthcare decisions and research, coining the concept of evidence-based research.

faculty.name: Khyzer Bin Izhar Aziz
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Pediatrics; Assistant Professor of Medicine
faculty.sub_field: Neonatal precision medicine and clinical data science
faculty.summary: Associate director of the MS in Applied Health Sciences Informatics programs in BIDS and Chief Medical Information Officer of The Johns Hopkins Hospital, Aziz leverages electronic medical records and national databases with machine learning to inform clinical decision-making in neonatal precision medicine.

faculty.name: Jonathan P. Weiner
faculty.title: Professor of Health Policy and Management (joint appointment in Health Sciences Informatics, School of Medicine)
faculty.sub_field: Population health informatics and predictive modeling
faculty.summary: Founding director of the Center for Population Health IT (CPHIT) and co-developer of the Johns Hopkins ACG risk-adjustment system, Weiner researches the application of information technology and 'big data' from medical, insurance, public health, and social sectors to population health, predictive modeling, and performance measurement.

faculty.name: Elham Hatef
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Medicine
faculty.sub_field: Population health informatics and social determinants of health
faculty.summary: A dual board-certified preventive medicine physician and clinical informatician and core faculty at CPHIT, Hatef assesses the impact of social needs and social determinants of health on outcomes and utilization using health IT, real-world data, and natural language processing of structured and unstructured EHR data.

faculty.name: Nic Dobbins
faculty.title: Assistant Director for Education, Biomedical Informatics & Data Science (Department of Medicine)
faculty.summary: Dobbins leads BIDS efforts in large-scale de-identification of clinical notes, large language model usage and evaluation, and cohort-discovery tool development; he is the creator of Leaf, a widely used cohort-discovery tool, and pioneered NLP/LLM methods to identify clinical-trial-eligible patients from EHR data.

faculty.name: Suchi Saria
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science, Statistics, and Health Policy (joint appointment in Health System Informatics, School of Medicine)
faculty.summary: Founding research director of the Malone Center for Engineering in Healthcare, Saria develops Bayesian and probabilistic machine-learning methods for modeling and prediction in real-world temporal health systems, using EHR and sensing data to individualize diagnosis and treatment (including early sepsis detection).

faculty.name: T. Y. Alvin Liu
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Ophthalmology
faculty.summary: Founding director of the Wilmer Precision Ophthalmology Center of Excellence and the Gills Rising Professor of AI in Ophthalmology, Liu develops and evaluates artificial intelligence for screening, diagnosis, and treatment of eye diseases such as diabetic retinopathy and age-related macular degeneration.

faculty.name: Scott Levin
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Emergency Medicine (joint appointment in Civil & Systems Engineering)
faculty.sub_field: Health systems engineering and data science
faculty.summary: Levin develops systems-engineering and data-science tools, including a machine-learning-based electronic triage system, to improve the effectiveness, safety, and efficiency of healthcare delivery and the deployment of scarce health-care resources.

faculty.name: Jeremiah S. Hinson
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Emergency Medicine
faculty.sub_field: Clinical data science and predictive modeling
faculty.summary: Co-director of the Center for Data Science in Emergency Medicine, Hinson applies machine-learning methods to electronic health record data to improve patient outcomes, including predictive models for acute kidney injury and electronic triage in the emergency department.

faculty.name: Wendy L. Bennett
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Medicine (General Internal Medicine)
faculty.summary: A BIDS faculty-board member and Director of Research at Johns Hopkins Community Physicians, Bennett conducts pragmatic and community-based trials that apply health information technology, clinical informatics, and data science to prevent and manage obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease, particularly among women.

faculty.name: Xun Jia
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Chief of Medical Physics Division. Develops GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo radiation transport simulations, AI-driven CBCT reconstruction, deep learning for treatment planning, and preclinical FLASH radiotherapy technologies. AIMBE Fellow, FAAPM, over 300 publications and 7,500+ citations.

faculty.name: Kai Ding
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Founding Co-Director of the Medical Physics PhD Program. Directs the Smart Biomaterial & Image-Guided Radiotherapy Lab, developing X-ray-based intra-operative image-guided platforms (XIOSIS) for smart material delivery and AI-based tumor contouring.

faculty.name: Todd McNutt
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Director of Clinical Informatics and Director of the Medical Physics Residency. Creator of Oncospace (now Plan AI), an FDA-approved AI-powered informatics system that uses data from over 5,000 patients to optimize radiation treatment plans. Acquired by Sun Nuclear/Mirion Medical in 2025.

faculty.name: Heng Li
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Director of Proton Physics and Vice Chief of Physics/Clinical-NCR at the Johns Hopkins National Proton Center. Leads commissioning of ultra-high dose rate (UHDR) proton beamlines for FLASH research, real-time gated proton therapy, and spatially fractionated proton therapy clinical trials. FAAPM, 142+ publications.

faculty.name: Robert Hobbs
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Director of Radiation Safety. Develops microscale dosimetry models for alpha-particle emitting radionuclides, including nephron-based kidney and bone marrow toxicity models. Chair of AAPM committee on Radionuclide Therapy and elected MIRD Committee member.

faculty.name: Junghoon Lee
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Leads the Medical Imaging and Computing Analysis (MICA) lab. Develops real-time intraoperative dosimetry systems (iRUF) for prostate brachytherapy, automatic seed reconstruction algorithms, and multimodality image registration for brachytherapy treatment planning. 145+ publications.

faculty.name: Weihua Mao
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Specializes in MRI-guided adaptive radiotherapy on MR-linac systems, markerless lung tumor tracking using EPID imaging, CBCT reconstruction for soft-tissue visualization, and real-time motion management for pancreas and lung cancers. 119 publications, 2,000+ citations.

faculty.name: Wil Ngwa
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Biomaterial Drones & Global Health Radiation Oncology
faculty.summary: PI of the Biomaterial Drones and Radio-immunotherapy Lab. Develops implantable biomaterial drones for smart delivery of immunoadjuvants combined with radiotherapy to trigger in-situ vaccination against metastatic disease. Director of Global Health Catalyst; Chair, Lancet Oncology Commission for Sub-Saharan Africa.

faculty.name: Sarah Han-Oh
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Tumor Motion Management & Pancreatic Cancer Radiotherapy
faculty.summary: Vice Chief of Medical Physics Division (Baltimore). Develops novel tumor tracking technologies including microwave radar fiducial localization and ultrasound-based intra-fraction motion tracking for pancreatic cancer SBRT. Active APEx surveyor for ASTRO accreditation.

faculty.name: Michael Roumeliotis
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Director of Brachytherapy Physics. Advances AI-based auto-segmentation (DCT-UNet) for MRI-guided cervical cancer brachytherapy, robotic bronchoscopy-guided lung brachytherapy, and ultrasound-compatible gynecologic brachytherapy applicators.

faculty.name: Mohammad Rezaee
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Invented an orthovoltage x-ray FLASH irradiator for preclinical research and established the FLASH radiation research program at Johns Hopkins. Investigates DNA damage mechanisms from high-LET particles, UHDR proton FLASH dosimetry, and platinum-based radiosensitizers.

faculty.name: William T. Hrinivich
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Proton Therapy & Deep Reinforcement Learning Planning
faculty.summary: Medical physicist at the Johns Hopkins Proton Therapy Center. Develops GPU-based ultra-fast proton pencil beam dose calculation algorithms, deep reinforcement learning for automated VMAT/IMPT planning, and custom hardware solutions (table-mounted range shifter boards) for pediatric craniospinal irradiation.

faculty.name: Rachel B. Ger
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on quantitative imaging biomarkers (radiomics) for cancer prognosis, proton dose evaluation and range uncertainty analysis, deformable image registration accuracy, and stem cell-sparing radiotherapy to reduce xerostomia in head and neck cancer patients.

faculty.name: Khadija Sheikh
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Associate Program Director of the Medical Physics Residency. Specializes in breath-hold techniques for breast proton therapy, daily CBCT-based adaptive planning workflows for proton treatment, and pediatric proton therapy planning optimization.

faculty.name: An Qin
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Proton Arc Therapy & Deformable Image Registration
faculty.summary: Develops spot-scanning proton arc therapy (SPArc) techniques for head and neck, lung, and prostate cancers. Works on deformable image registration for tumor/organ shrinkage monitoring, CBCT-based treatment dose monitoring, and U-net-generated synthetic CT for MRI-only treatment planning.

programs.program_name: Molecular Biophysics, PhD (Program in Molecular Biophysics)

faculty.name: Cynthia Wolberger
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies the structural and mechanistic basis for transcriptional regulation and ubiquitin signaling, using X-ray crystallography and cryo-EM to understand how histone modifications control gene expression and DNA repair.

faculty.name: James M. Berger
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates how multi-subunit assemblies use ATP to control DNA replication and chromosome superstructure, with a focus on replication initiation, replisome assembly, and topoisomerases as anti-cancer drug targets.

faculty.name: Jie Xiao
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops advanced single-molecule and superresolution imaging approaches to study molecular mechanisms of bacterial cell division, transcription regulation, and chromosome organization in living cells.

faculty.name: Doug Barrick
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies tandem repeat proteins as model systems to quantify cooperativity in protein folding, using nearest-neighbor Ising models and consensus repeat design to understand folding energy landscapes and pathway selection.

faculty.name: Karen Fleming
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates the physical principles governing membrane protein folding, stability, and assembly in bacterial outer membranes, studying how lipid bilayers and periplasmic chaperones catalyze beta-barrel protein biogenesis.

faculty.name: Juliette Lecomte
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Uses NMR spectroscopy and other biophysical methods to study heme protein structure, stability, and dynamics, including truncated hemoglobins from microorganisms and their roles in reactive nitrogen species management.

faculty.name: Sarah Woodson
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies RNA folding, RNA-protein interactions, and ribosome assembly using single-molecule fluorescence methods, with a focus on how the Hfq chaperone facilitates small RNA-mRNA pairing and how ribosomal proteins assemble co-transcriptionally.

faculty.name: Gregory Bowman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates the molecular mechanisms of ATP-dependent chromatin remodelers such as Chd1 that reposition nucleosomes along DNA, using cryo-EM and single-molecule approaches to understand how these motors control DNA accessibility.

faculty.name: Yuan He
faculty.title: Bloomberg Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Uses cryo-EM and AI-based tools to elucidate the molecular mechanisms of large multi-subunit complexes involved in eukaryotic gene transcription and DNA damage repair, including the transcription pre-initiation complex and NHEJ machinery.

faculty.name: Edward Twomey
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops time-resolved cryo-EM methods to capture dynamic states of glutamate receptors, revealing how neurotransmitter binding gates ion channel opening at physiological temperatures, with implications for neurological disorders.

faculty.name: Bin Wu
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops single-molecule microscopy methods to visualize RNA birth, trafficking, translation, and decay in live cells and neurons, including the SINAPS technique for real-time imaging of translation on single mRNAs.

faculty.name: Albert Lau
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Combines computational and experimental approaches to study the atomic details of ionotropic glutamate receptors, investigating conformational dynamics that underlie synaptic transmission and identifying novel drug-binding sites.

faculty.name: Jungsan Sohn
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates how innate immune stress sensors assemble, detect danger signals, and initiate responses, focusing on inflammasome formation, self vs. non-self DNA discrimination, and phase separation in DNA sensing pathways.

faculty.name: Dominique Frueh
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops novel NMR methods to study protein dynamics in large enzymatic systems, focusing on the molecular mechanisms of nonribosomal peptide synthetases that produce antibiotics and other bioactive compounds.

faculty.name: Chang Liu
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Uses cryo-EM and cryo-ET to study coronavirus-host interactions, including the structural basis of SARS-CoV-2 proofreading, mechanisms of antiviral drug resistance, and modulation of host transcription by viral proteins.

faculty.name: Elizabeth A. Stuart
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops causal inference methods for evaluating public health and educational interventions, focusing on propensity score methods for non-experimental studies and assessing generalizability of randomized trials to target populations. Elected to National Academy of Medicine. Chair of Biostatistics.

faculty.name: Karen Bandeen-Roche
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Creates statistical methodology to study healthy aging and independence in older adults. Develops latent variable models and multivariate survival methods to measure frailty, resilience, and cognitive decline. Elected to National Academy of Medicine. Emeritus Chair (2008-2023).

faculty.name: Brian S. Caffo
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops computationally intensive statistical methods for large complex data in neuroscience, including fMRI, MRI, and PET imaging analysis. Co-created the Coursera Data Science Specialization with over 7 million enrollments. PECASE Award recipient.

faculty.name: Nilanjan Chatterjee
faculty.title: Bloomberg Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for genetic epidemiology, including polygenic risk prediction, gene-environment interaction analysis, and integration of genomic data for complex disease risk modeling. COPSS Presidents' Award recipient. Joint appointment with School of Medicine.

faculty.name: Ciprian M. Crainiceanu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for high-dimensional data from wearable/implantable computing devices and neuroimaging. Co-founded the Neuroconductor R platform for reproducible medical imaging analysis. Leads the SMART research group for biological signal methodology.

faculty.name: Abhirup Datta
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and machine learning methods to understand how spatial, environmental, and epidemiologic factors shape population health. Works on highly multivariate geostatistical analysis for environmental exposure assessment. COPSS Emerging Leader Award recipient.

faculty.name: Marie Diener-West
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Teaches and collaborates on the design, conduct, and analysis of multicenter clinical trials, with deep commitment to statistical education and mentoring of public health graduate students. Holds the Abbey-Merrell Professorship and chairs the MPH Program.

faculty.name: Constantine Frangakis
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Co-developed principal stratification, a foundational causal inference framework with Donald Rubin, for addressing noncompliance, missing outcomes, and surrogate endpoints in clinical trials. Applied methods to HIV needle exchange evaluation and school choice programs.

faculty.name: Frank C. Curriero
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops and applies spatial and spatio-temporal statistical methods across public health, including geostatistical exposure assessment and models characterizing spatial variation in disease risk as a function of environmental determinants. Directs the Spatial Analysis for Public Health program.

faculty.name: Kasper D. Hansen
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods and open-source software for high-throughput genomics and genetics. Creator of the widely used 'minfi' Bioconductor package for DNA methylation array analysis. Joint appointment with McKusick-Nathans Institute of Genetic Medicine.

faculty.name: Hongkai Ji
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical, computational, and machine learning methods for high-throughput genomic data, with emphasis on single-cell genomics and gene regulation. Created widely used tools TSCAN and SCATE for single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data analysis.

faculty.name: Martin Lindquist
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops mathematical and statistical methods for functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) data analysis. Leads an NIH-funded national consortium developing neuroimaging-based biomarkers of pain.

faculty.name: Betsy Ogburn
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops causal inference methods for complex data settings including social network data with interference between units and data with unmeasured confounding. Research recognized among the American Journal of Epidemiology's best papers.

faculty.name: Michael Rosenblum
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops innovative adaptive clinical trial designs and open-source software to efficiently determine which treatments work best for which populations. Pioneered adaptive enrichment and seamless trial designs, with extensive FDA collaboration.

faculty.name: Mei-Cheng Wang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops analytical methods for time-to-event data, recurrent events, and recurrent marker processes in follow-up and longitudinal studies. Contributed foundational methods for regression analysis with correlated responses alongside Scott Zeger and Kung-Yee Liang.

faculty.name: Scott L. Zeger
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Co-developed Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE) for correlated data analysis, a landmark methodology in biostatistics. Co-directs Hopkins inHealth for precision medicine, developing Bayesian methods to use population data for improving individual clinical decisions. Member of National Academy of Medicine.

faculty.name: Stephanie Hicks
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods and open-source software (Bioconductor) for noisy high-dimensional biomedical data including single-cell genomics and spatial transcriptomics. Co-led landmark paper on orchestrating single-cell analysis with Bioconductor. COPSS Emerging Leader Award and ASA Fellow.

faculty.name: Ni Zhao
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and computational methods for high-dimensional omics data including metagenomics, genomics, and epigenomics. Known for developing MiRKAT (microbiome association test) and ConQuR (batch effect removal via conditional quantile regression). PhD Program Director.

faculty.name: Vadim Zipunnikov
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops advanced statistical methods for multimodal digital health data from wearables, smartphones, and implantables. Co-leads the Wearable and Implantable Technology group and serves as Biostatistics Director for the NIMH-funded Motor Activity Research Consortium. Collaborates with FDA on digital biomarker regulatory science.

faculty.name: Yiqun Chen
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: AI and Statistical Methods for Biomedicine
faculty.summary: Develops AI and statistical machine learning methods for reliable biomedical research, including using large language models for evidence-based clinical Q&A and GenePT embeddings for single-cell biology. Joint appointment with Computer Science. PhD from University of Washington with Daniela Witten.

faculty.name: Leonardo Collado Torres
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops open-source R/Bioconductor tools to understand gene expression in the human brain and its role in neuropsychiatric disorders. Core developer of recount3, spatialLIBD, and derfinder packages. Investigator at the Lieber Institute for Brain Development.

faculty.name: Akihiko (Aki) Nishimura
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops Bayesian methods and efficient MCMC algorithms for large-scale biomedical applications. Created the prior-preconditioned conjugate gradient method for accelerated Gibbs sampling in high-dimensional sparse regression. Laplace Award and Savage Award recipient.

faculty.name: Tanya Alderete
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates the effects of environmental exposures on human health throughout the life course, integrating clinical, epidemiological, and multiomics research.

faculty.name: Shyam Biswal
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty studying molecular mechanisms, pathophysiology and therapeutics of COPD and lung cancer.

faculty.name: Joseph Bressler
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies how environmental pollutants affect neurodevelopment, with specific interests in autism and fetal alcohol syndrome.

faculty.name: Giehae Choi
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Exposure Sciences and Environmental Epidemiology (ESEE) track faculty studying reproductive, perinatal and pediatric epidemiology, chemicals and air pollution.

faculty.name: Meghan Davis
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Faculty in the ESEE and ESRH tracks studying environmental microbiology, one health, and asthma.

faculty.name: Natalie Exum
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Bridges public health and sanitary engineering to understand how environmental infectious pathogens are transmitted to humans.

faculty.name: Louis Fazen
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE track faculty studying occupational health, organizational justice, and cardiovascular disease risk.

faculty.name: John Groopman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research involves the development and application of molecular biomarkers of exposure, dose, and effect from environmental carcinogens.

faculty.name: Thomas Hartung
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Toxicology and alternatives to animal testing
faculty.summary: TPMM track co-director studying developmental neurotoxicity, immunotoxicity and endocrine disruption with integrated omics technologies.

faculty.name: Christopher Heaney
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE track faculty studying environmental epidemiology, water and health, and community-based research.

faculty.name: Benjamin Huynh
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Uses data science and AI to address public health issues related to environmental injustices and disasters.

faculty.name: Kirsten Koehler
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE track co-director and ESRH faculty studying exposure assessment, aerosols and air quality.

faculty.name: Mark Kohr
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM track co-director studying sex-dependent differences in cardiovascular physiology and disease and redox signaling.

faculty.name: Paul Locke
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: A scientist and lawyer who researches, designs, and implements evidence-based policies to improve public health and protect the environment.

faculty.name: Jaime Madrigano
faculty.title: Bloomberg Associate Professor of American Health
faculty.summary: ESEE track co-director studying air pollution, climate change and public health.

faculty.name: Alexandra Maertens
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Uses machine learning to study how chemicals perturb cellular signaling and cause toxicity, and how to design safer chemicals.

faculty.name: Keeve Nachman
faculty.title: Robert S. Lawrence Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE and ESRH track faculty (ESRH co-director) studying risk science, risk assessment and food systems.

faculty.name: Gurumurthy Ramachandran
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE track faculty studying exposure assessment, nanoparticles and risk assessment for nanomaterials.

faculty.name: Ana Rule
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE and ESRH track faculty studying air pollution, bioaerosols and metal speciation.

faculty.name: Kellogg Schwab
faculty.title: Abel Wolman Professor in Water and Public Health
faculty.summary: ESEE and ESRH track faculty studying water, sanitation and hygiene, environmental microbiology, and microbial fate and transport.

faculty.name: Brian Schwartz
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE and ESRH track faculty studying environmental epidemiology, sustainability, the built environment and lead.

faculty.name: Fenna Sillé
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM-track advising faculty studying developmental immunotoxicity in the context of chronic and infectious diseases and vaccine efficacy.

faculty.name: Lena Smirnova
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty studying microRNA, developmental neurotoxicology, gene-environment interactions, and iPSC-derived brain models.

faculty.name: Genee Smith
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE and ESRH track faculty studying environmental epidemiology and the health effects of climate change and infectious diseases.

faculty.name: Joseph P. Bressler
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Advising faculty in the Toxicology, Physiology and Molecular Mechanisms (TPMM) track studying neurotoxicology.

faculty.name: John D. Groopman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM-track advising faculty studying molecular biomarkers of environmental carcinogens and chemoprevention.

faculty.name: Robert A. Wise
faculty.title: Professor of Medicine
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty (School of Medicine) studying the pathogenesis of COPD.

faculty.name: Robert A. Casero
faculty.title: Professor of Oncology
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty (Oncology) studying the role of polyamine catabolism in inflammation-associated carcinogenesis.

faculty.name: Valeria Culotta
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty studying pathogens and metal toxicity.

faculty.name: Rachel Damico
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty (School of Medicine) studying the role of the pulmonary endothelium in lung disease.

faculty.name: Sharon McGrath-Morrow
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty studying pediatric lung diseases.

faculty.name: Alan L. Scott
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty studying the immunology of lung disease.

faculty.name: James Sham
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty studying cardiac and pulmonary vascular cell physiology.

faculty.name: Ramana Sidhaye
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: TPMM program faculty studying quantitative changes in lung epithelial structure and function in response to environmental insults.

faculty.name: Marsha Wills-Karp
faculty.title: Anna M. Baetjer Professor and Department Chair
faculty.summary: Department Chair and TPMM program faculty studying genetic and environmental mechanisms of asthma and allergy.

faculty.name: Shima Hamidi
faculty.title: Bloomberg Assistant Professor of American Health
faculty.summary: ESEE and ESRH track faculty studying geospatial data, the built environment, and housing and transportation and health.

faculty.name: Roni Neff
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE and ESRH track faculty (ESRH co-director) studying food systems, wasted food, resilience and equity.

faculty.name: Carsten Prasse
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: ESEE and ESRH track faculty studying emerging contaminants, engineering processes and analytical detection methods.

faculty.name: Lesliam Quirós-Alcalá
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Leverages expertise in exposure science and environmental epidemiology to investigate the potential health impacts of chemical exposures on high-risk populations.

faculty.name: Peter DeCarlo
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: ESRH track faculty (Whiting School of Engineering) studying atmospheric aerosols (particulate matter), air quality and climate.

faculty.name: Paul Ferraro
faculty.title: Bloomberg Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: ESRH track co-director (Whiting School of Engineering / Carey Business School) studying behavioral science, causal inference and environmental policy.

faculty.name: Benjamin Hobbs
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: ESRH track faculty (Whiting School of Engineering) studying systems analysis of energy and water.

faculty.name: Benjamin Q. Huynh
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: ESRH track faculty studying AI, data science, environmental justice and planetary health.

faculty.name: Scot Miller
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: ESRH track faculty (Whiting School of Engineering) studying global change, greenhouse gases and air pollutants.

funding.note: Fully funded (all Rossin College PhDs 100% funded); P3 Fellowship available

faculty.name: Brian D. Davison
faculty.title: Professor and Chair; Daniel E. '39 and Patricia M. Smith Endowed Chair, Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Department Chair and leading researcher in data science, web search, and information retrieval. Work on machine learning and data mining with applications in text, the Web, and social networks. Co-founder of the MS in Data Science program. NSF CAREER awardee.

faculty.name: Daniel P. Lopresti
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering; Interim Dean, Rossin College of Engineering
faculty.summary: Distinguished researcher in pattern recognition and document analysis systems. Work on electronic voting security, cybersecurity, and bioinformatics. Interim Dean of the Rossin College of Engineering and Applied Science. ACM Distinguished Scientist.

faculty.name: Mooi Choo Chuah
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: IEEE Fellow and NAI Fellow. Leading researcher in network and cyber-physical system security, mobile healthcare, and assistive technologies. Holds 62+ US patents. Previously Distinguished Member of Technical Staff at Bell Labs. Associate Director of I-DISC.

faculty.name: Jeff Heflin
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering; Director, Cognitive Science Program
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in artificial intelligence, the Semantic Web, and knowledge representation. Work on ontologies, intelligent agents, and web-based knowledge systems. Director of the Cognitive Science Program.

faculty.name: Henry Korth
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in database systems, blockchain technology, and distributed systems. Work on zero-knowledge proofs, consensus algorithms, and blockchain benchmarking. Co-director of the Computer Science and Business (CSB) program. Co-author of the widely-used 'Database System Concepts' textbook.

faculty.name: Michael Spear
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering; Director of Master's Program
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in concurrency, parallel computing, and programming language design. Work on transactional memory, multicore synchronization, and cloud computing infrastructure. Director of the MS program in CSE.

faculty.name: Parv Venkitasubramaniam
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in privacy and security, with focus on the fundamental tradeoffs between privacy and performance in networked systems. Work on information-theoretic privacy, cyber-physical security, and statistical data privacy.

faculty.name: Roberto Palmieri
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in distributed computing and systems. Work on concurrent data structures, transactional memory, and fault-tolerant distributed protocols. Focus on cluster and geographic replication for high-performance and reliable systems.

faculty.name: Eric P. S. Baumer
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in human-computer interaction and social informatics. NSF CAREER awardee. Work on participatory methods for human-centered design of algorithmic systems, natural language processing, and critical studies of algorithms in society.

faculty.name: Hector Munoz-Avila
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: NSF CAREER awardee. Researcher in agentic AI, hierarchical task network (HTN) planning, and case-based reasoning. Current work on AI grounding, AI alignment, and combining hierarchical representations with large language models. Lehigh Class of 1961 Professor.

faculty.name: Lifang He
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Rising researcher in machine learning and data science. Work on tensor analysis methods and their applications to biomedical informatics and neuroimaging. IEEE Senior Member. Tenured in 2025. Multiple NSF, NIH, and DOE grants.

faculty.name: Brian Y. Chen
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering; PhD Program Director

faculty.name: Torsten Suel
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Suel works on information retrieval and web search, including indexing, query processing, compression, and algorithms for large web-scale data.

faculty.name: Qi Sun
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Sun works on computer graphics and perception for virtual and augmented reality, developing perceptually informed rendering and display techniques.

faculty.name: Joseph Tassarotti
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
faculty.summary: Tassarotti works on programming languages and formal verification, including machine-checked proofs for concurrent and probabilistic programs.

faculty.name: Julian Togelius
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Togelius works on artificial intelligence and games, including procedural content generation, game-playing agents, and AI-assisted game design.

faculty.name: Paul Torrens
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering; Vice Dean for Faculty Affairs, Tandon School of Engineering
faculty.summary: Torrens works on geographic information science and geosimulation, using agent-based modeling and spatial computing to study human movement and behavior in cities.

faculty.name: Erdem Varol
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Varol develops machine-learning and statistical methods for neuroscience and biological imaging, analyzing high-dimensional neural and biomedical data.

faculty.name: Michael Walfish
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science
faculty.summary: Walfish works on computer systems, including verifiable computation and building systems whose correctness and security can be checked.

faculty.name: Sam Westrick
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
faculty.summary: Westrick works on programming languages and systems for parallel computing, including functional parallel programming and memory management.

faculty.name: Ed K Wong
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
faculty.summary: Wong works on image processing, multimedia, and pattern recognition.

faculty.name: Sherry Yang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
faculty.summary: Yang works on machine learning for sequential decision making, including generative and foundation models, world models, and reinforcement learning.

faculty.name: Chee Yap
faculty.title: Professor of Computer Science
faculty.summary: Yap works on computational geometry and exact geometric and algebraic computation, with applications to robotics and reliable geometric algorithms.

faculty.name: Sai Qian Zhang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering and Computer Science
faculty.summary: Zhang works on efficient machine learning and hardware-software co-design, developing systems and accelerators for machine learning and immersive computing.

faculty.name: Denis Zorin
faculty.title: Silver Professor of Computer Science and Mathematics
faculty.summary: Zorin works on geometric modeling, computer graphics, and scientific computing, including subdivision surfaces, geometry processing, and physical simulation for design and fabrication.

funding.note: Fully funded via MacCracken (full tuition + stipend + health insurance, 4-5 yrs + 3 summers)

faculty.name: Jonathan Niles-Weed
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies statistical and computational problems arising from data with geometric structure, with much of his recent work dedicated to developing a statistical theory of optimal transport. Co-authored the monograph 'Statistical Optimal Transport' and received the 2023 IMS Tweedie New Researcher Award.

faculty.name: Carlos Fernandez-Granda
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Designs and analyzes data-science methodology with a primary focus on machine learning and its applications to medicine, climate science, and scientific imaging. Author of 'Probability and Statistics for Data Science' and Interim Director of the NYU Center for Data Science.

faculty.name: Yanjun Han
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Works on the mathematics of data science, including statistics, learning theory, bandits, and information theory, with a recent focus on the theory of empirical Bayes methods. Holds a PhD from Stanford and completed postdocs at the Simons Institute and MIT.

faculty.name: Benjamin Peherstorfer
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Works at the intersection of computational mathematics, machine learning, and computational statistics, focusing on nonlinear model reduction, multi-fidelity methods for uncertainty quantification, and data-driven modeling of dynamical systems. Holds NSF CAREER, DoE Early Career, and AFOSR YIP awards.

faculty.name: Paul Bourgade
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research interests lie in probability, in particular random matrices and statistical physics, with work spanning random matrix theory, Coulomb plasmas, interacting particle systems, and eigenvector statistics. Serves as Editor for the Annals of Probability.

faculty.name: Eyal Lubetzky
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works on the dynamics and interfaces of the Ising and Potts models, cutoff phenomena for Markov chains, and random walks and random graphs. His research bridges probability theory and combinatorics with a focus on phase transitions and mixing times.

faculty.name: Roland Bauerschmidt
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works in probability theory and analysis applied to statistical mechanics, including spin systems and phase transitions, renormalisation, stochastic dynamics, and random matrices. Previously Professor of Probability at the University of Cambridge.

faculty.name: Nina Holden
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Works in probability theory and mathematical physics, with research on Liouville quantum gravity, Schramm-Loewner evolutions, random planar maps, and statistical physics. Earned her PhD from MIT in 2018 under Scott Sheffield and was a Junior Fellow at ETH Zurich.

faculty.name: Jonathan Weare
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on the design, mathematical analysis, and application of stochastic algorithms and models, drawing on probability theory, numerical analysis, and machine learning. His work is driven by collaborations in astrophysics, biophysics, computational chemistry, and climate science.

faculty.name: Gerard Ben Arous
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works in probability theory including stochastic analysis, large deviations, random media, random matrices, and spin glasses, with connections to PDEs, dynamical systems, and statistical mechanics. Director of the Courant Institute and Fellow of the Institute of Mathematical Statistics.

faculty.name: Eric Vanden-Eijnden
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works on mathematical and computational aspects of statistical mechanics applied across molecular dynamics, materials science, atmosphere-ocean science, fluid dynamics, and neural networks. Combines tools from probability theory, mathematical physics, numerical analysis, and optimization.

faculty.name: Sylvia Serfaty
faculty.title: Silver Professor
faculty.summary: Works on analysis, partial differential equations, and mathematical physics, with a focus on the Ginzburg-Landau model of superconductivity and the statistical mechanics of Coulomb-type systems including log gases, random matrices, and point processes. Plenary speaker at ICM 2018 and elected to the American Academy of Arts and Sciences.

faculty.name: Andrew Gordon Wilson
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops a prescriptive foundation for building intelligent systems, with contributions spanning scalable Gaussian processes (creator of GPyTorch), Bayesian deep learning, model selection, and generalization theory. Discovered mode connectivity and created the SWA optimization procedure now natively included in PyTorch.

faculty.name: Joan Bruna
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works on the mathematical foundations of machine learning, covering optimization, representation, and statistical aspects, with applications to computational science including geophysics and climate modeling. Co-founder of the Math and Data (MaD) group at NYU and affiliated with the Flatiron Institute. On sabbatical for 2025-26.

faculty.name: Jinyoung Park
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Works on combinatorics and graph theory, with a focus on random discrete structures and phase transitions. Co-proved the Kahn-Kalai conjecture on threshold phenomena and received the Maryam Mirzakhani New Frontiers Prize (2023) and the Levi L. Conant Prize (2025).

faculty.name: Hau-Tieng Wu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leads the MISTA Lab, establishing rigorous mathematical foundations for analyzing high-frequency physiological waveform signals (ECG, EEG, etc.) using time-frequency analysis, manifold learning, and machine learning. Holds both a PhD in Mathematics from Princeton (advised by Ingrid Daubechies) and an MD.

funding.note: Fully funded via MacCracken (full tuition + stipend + health insurance, 4-5 yrs + 3 summers)

faculty.name: Andrew D. Kent
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental condensed matter physicist studying magnetism, spintronics, and spin dynamics.

faculty.name: Javad Shabani
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental condensed matter physicist developing hybrid superconductor devices for quantum information.

faculty.name: Aditi Mitra
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Condensed matter theorist studying non-equilibrium quantum dynamics of many-body systems.

faculty.name: Daniel L. Stein
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Condensed matter theorist working on disordered systems, spin glasses, and statistical physics.

faculty.name: Paul Chaikin
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental condensed matter and soft matter physicist studying colloidal and self-organizing systems.

faculty.name: David Pine
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental soft-matter physicist studying colloidal self-assembly and functional materials.

faculty.name: David Grier
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental physicist developing holographic optical trapping and microscopy for soft-matter systems.

faculty.name: Alexander Grosberg
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical biophysicist working on polymer physics and the organization of biological macromolecules.

faculty.name: Jasna Brujic
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental soft-matter physicist studying emulsions, packing, and programmable self-assembly.

faculty.name: Michael Blanton
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Observational astrophysicist studying galaxies and large-scale structure through large sky surveys.

faculty.name: Glennys Farrar
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Astroparticle physicist studying ultra-high-energy cosmic rays and the nature of dark matter.

faculty.name: David Hogg
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Astrophysicist developing data-driven and machine-learning methods for astronomical surveys.

faculty.name: Roman Scoccimarro
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical cosmologist studying the growth and statistics of cosmic large-scale structure.

faculty.name: Andrei Gruzinov
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical astrophysicist working on plasma processes and high-energy astrophysical phenomena.

faculty.name: Andrew MacFadyen
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical/computational astrophysicist studying explosive transients and relativistic flows.

faculty.name: Gregory Gabadadze
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical physicist working on modified gravity, cosmology, and quantum field theory.

faculty.name: Sergei Dubovsky
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical particle physicist working on quantum field theory, gravity, and related topics.

faculty.name: Massimo Porrati
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical physicist working on string theory, supergravity, and quantum field theory.

faculty.name: Neal Weiner
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical particle physicist working on dark matter and physics beyond the Standard Model.

faculty.name: Matthew Kleban
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical physicist working on cosmology, string theory, and the early universe.

faculty.name: Allen Mincer
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental particle and astroparticle physicist working on collider and cosmic-ray experiments.

faculty.name: Burton Budick
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Atomic, molecular and optical physicist listed among the department's physics faculty.

faculty.name: Yacine Ali-Haimoud
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical cosmologist studying the early universe, the CMB, and gravitational-wave sources.

faculty.name: Andy Haas
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental particle physicist searching for new physics at the LHC with ATLAS.

faculty.name: Emily Davis
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Physicist working on quantum phenomena, spin systems, and quantum sensing.

faculty.name: Drummond Fielding
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Computational astrophysicist studying gas flows and feedback in galaxy formation.

faculty.name: Marc Gershow
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Physicist studying sensory processing and behavior in small organisms using quantitative methods.

faculty.name: Kota Katsumi
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental physicist studying quantum materials with ultrafast and terahertz spectroscopy.

faculty.name: Sarah Kostinski
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Physicist working on soft-matter and biophysical problems using theoretical methods.

faculty.name: Jesse Liu
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental particle physicist searching for dark matter and new phenomena, including with quantum sensors.

faculty.name: Stefano Martiniani
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Physicist studying disordered and non-equilibrium systems using statistical mechanics and computation.

faculty.name: Monica Pate
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: High energy theorist working on asymptotic symmetries and celestial holography.

faculty.name: Anthony Pullen
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Observational cosmologist using intensity mapping and surveys to probe large-scale structure.

faculty.name: Joshua Ruderman
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical particle physicist working on dark matter and physics beyond the Standard Model.

faculty.name: Tomohiro Soejima
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Condensed matter theorist studying correlated quantum phases and numerical many-body methods.

faculty.name: Katepalli R. Sreenivasan
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Physicist and engineer studying turbulence and nonlinear dynamics of fluids.

faculty.name: Jeremy Tinker
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Observational cosmologist studying the galaxy-halo connection and large-scale structure.

faculty.name: Andrei Vrajitoarea
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental physicist building superconducting circuits for quantum simulation and information.

faculty.name: Joel Wang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental physicist working on superconducting quantum devices and information processing.

faculty.name: Yifan Wang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: High energy theorist working on conformal field theory and quantum field theory.

faculty.name: Jun Zhang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Physicist studying fluid dynamics, fluid-structure interactions, and related biophysical problems.

faculty.name: Alexandra Zidovska
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental biophysicist studying the dynamics and organization of the cell nucleus.

faculty.name: Shirley Ho
faculty.title: Research Professor
faculty.summary: Research professor applying machine learning and statistics to cosmology and large-scale structure.

funding.note: Fully funded via MacCracken (full tuition + stipend + health insurance, 4-5 yrs + 3 summers)

faculty.name: Max Costa
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Medicine; Professor, Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Pharmacology
faculty.summary: Costa investigates the molecular mechanisms of metal carcinogenesis, focusing on how nickel and cadmium ions affect histone demethylases and epigenetic regulation, leading to cellular transformation and cancer.

faculty.name: Suresh Cuddapah
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Department of Medicine
faculty.summary: Cuddapah studies epigenetic regulation of chromatin structure and gene expression programs during differentiation and disease, including tumor suppressor gene silencing and the epigenetic effects of heavy metals.

faculty.name: Wei Dai
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Medicine; Professor, Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Pharmacology
faculty.summary: Dai's research focuses on the surveillance mechanisms that regulate cell cycle progression and how defects in these checkpoints contribute to genomic instability and cancer development.

faculty.name: Terry Gordon
faculty.title: Research Professor, Department of Medicine
faculty.summary: Gordon's research program employs human and animal models to study susceptibility factors, including genetics, age, and gender, underlying the adverse pulmonary and cardiac effects of environmental and occupational air pollutants.

faculty.name: Chunyuan Jin
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Medicine
faculty.summary: Jin investigates how environmental exposures such as aldehydes and heavy metals compromise chromatin assembly pathways, with emphasis on histone variants and their roles in development, aging, and cancer.

faculty.name: Catherine G. Klein
faculty.title: Research Associate Professor, Department of Medicine
faculty.summary: Using molecular biologic and cytogenetic techniques, Klein studies the mutagenic and epigenetic mechanisms that silence gene expression leading to cancer and other diseases, including effects of metals, formaldehyde, and e-cigarettes. She is listed as an advisor in the Environmental Health Sciences Graduate Program.

faculty.name: Angelica Ortiz
faculty.title: Research Assistant Professor, Department of Medicine
faculty.summary: Ortiz studies extracellular vesicles as biomarkers and mediators of inflammatory diseases, carcinogenesis, and metastasis, examining how toxic metal exposure alters vesicle composition to influence cancer progression.

faculty.name: Hong Sun
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Department of Medicine
faculty.summary: Sun examines epigenetic regulation of cell proliferation, differentiation, and malignant transformation by environmental toxic metals, with current work on hexavalent chromium's effects on histone modification enzymes and carcinogenesis.

faculty.name: Moon-Shong Tang
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Medicine; Professor, Department of Pathology
faculty.summary: Tang studies the mechanisms by which environmental agents such as tobacco smoke and sunlight induce carcinogenesis, with recent work on the health effects of electronic-cigarette aerosols, nicotine, and cotinine.

faculty.name: George D. Thurston
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Medicine; Professor, Department of Population Health
faculty.summary: Thurston investigates the human health effects of exposure to air pollutants including particulate matter and ozone, encompassing PM2.5 mortality research, source apportionment, and the global burden of disease from outdoor air pollution.

faculty.name: Arul Veerappan
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Department of Medicine
faculty.summary: Veerappan's laboratory investigates environmental and occupational exposures using human and animal models, including World Trade Center and ambient particulate matter, wildfire, heavy metals, and endocrine disruptors, and their pulmonary, cardiac, renal, and vascular effects.

faculty.name: Judith T. Zelikoff
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Medicine
faculty.summary: Zelikoff's laboratory focuses on the effects of inhaled toxicants on immune system function and the reproductive process, including studies of particulate matter, nanoparticles, cigarette smoke, and alternative tobacco products.

requirements.admission_model: Umbrella program across multiple biomedical training areas; neuroscience applicants apply via GSAS Neural Science portal instead

faculty.name: Maurizio Porfiri
faculty.title: Institute Professor; Interim Chair, Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering; Director, Center for Urban Science + Progress
faculty.summary: Institute Professor with appointments in Mechanical and Aerospace, Biomedical, and Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering, and director of CUSP and the Urban Institute. He conducts and supervises research on complex systems, with applications ranging from mechanics to behavior, public health, and robotics.

faculty.name: Magued Iskander
faculty.title: Professor; Senior Director of Strategic Initiatives
faculty.summary: Professor of Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering whose research covers modeling transparent soil-structure interaction and flow, sustainable piling made of recycled polymers, geotechnical instrumentation, foundation engineering, high strain rate behavior of soils, and offshore and marine geotechnology foundations.

faculty.name: Mohamad Awada
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Assistant Professor integrating sensing systems, immersive technologies, and artificial intelligence to enhance human livability by optimizing the design and operation of built environments. He directs the Smart Innovations in Built Environment Research (SIBER) Lab, with work spanning healthy and sustainable infrastructure and biosensing solutions on construction sites.

faculty.name: Semiha Ergan
faculty.title: Professor; Associate Department Chair
faculty.summary: Professor and Associate Chair of Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering with a courtesy appointment in Computer Science and Engineering. Her research spans AR/VR, BIM and digital twins, computer vision/AI/ML, data analytics and visualization, and building/urban informatics.

faculty.name: Chen Feng
faculty.title: Institute Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Institute Associate Professor affiliated with Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering, Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, and Computer Science and Engineering, directing the AI4CE lab. His group develops algorithms and systems for intelligent agents to understand and interact with dynamic, unstructured environments, addressing infrastructure challenges in construction robotics, manufacturing automation, and autonomous vehicles.

faculty.name: Masoud Ghandehari
faculty.title: Professor of Urban Systems Engineering
faculty.summary: Professor of Urban Systems Engineering whose work focuses on climate resilience of infrastructure systems using sensing, data acquisition, and modeling, aimed at a fundamental understanding of the health and performance of the built environment. Research interests include infrastructure asset management and data-driven characterization of systems interdependencies.

faculty.name: Debra Laefer
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Professor in Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering and CUSP, leading the NYU Urban Modeling Group. Her research spans urban informatics, remote sensing, geospatial data management, geotechnical engineering, and disaster mitigation, including technical solutions for protecting architecturally significant buildings from sub-surface construction.

faculty.name: Bridger Ruyle
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Assistant Professor studying how human activity, the biosphere, and climate change affect water quality, including aquatic contaminant biogeochemistry and mechanistic and statistical modeling. His lab develops tools to quantify chemical contamination such as fluorinated chemicals (PFAS) and pharmaceuticals and integrates remote sensing data to assess climate impacts on water systems.

faculty.name: Andrea Silverman
faculty.title: Institute Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Institute Associate Professor in Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering and CUSP whose research focuses on water quality, wastewater treatment, and urban flooding, with an overarching goal to protect public health and environmental quality. Specific areas include detection and disinfection of waterborne pathogens, wastewater-based epidemiology, and design of natural wastewater treatment systems; she co-directs the FloodNet project.

faculty.name: Eleonora Maria Tronci
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Assistant Professor in Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering and CUSP. Her research focuses on structural damage assessment using machine learning, multi-domain transfer learning, offshore wind structure performance, and structural informatics.

faculty.name: Omar Wani
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Assistant Professor whose group combines statistical and computational methods to study the dynamics of hydroclimatic risk in built and natural environments, which are often interconnected and coupled systems. Research interests include statistical hydrosciences, urban water, and fluvial geomorphology.

faculty.name: Tarek Abdoun
faculty.title: Global Network Professor, NYU Tandon; Professor and Program Head of Civil and Urban Engineering, NYU Abu Dhabi
faculty.summary: Global Network Professor of Civil and Urban Engineering at NYU Tandon and Program Head at NYU Abu Dhabi. His research covers geotechnical systems and soil-structure interaction, soil dynamics and earthquake engineering, geo-centrifuge and full-scale testing, and AI sensor-based infrastructure health monitoring.

faculty.name: Kemal Celik
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Civil Engineering, NYU Abu Dhabi; Global Network Assistant Professor, NYU Tandon
faculty.summary: Assistant Professor at NYU Abu Dhabi and Global Network Assistant Professor at NYU Tandon, directing the AMBER Lab. His work centers on construction materials and building energy efficiency to develop sustainable and multi-functional structural materials, including low-carbon cements and alkali-activated cementitious materials.

faculty.name: Mostafa Mobasher
faculty.title: Professor of Civil and Urban Engineering, NYU Abu Dhabi; Associated Faculty, NYU Tandon
faculty.summary: Professor at NYU Abu Dhabi leading the Computational Solid Mechanics Lab. His research focuses on modeling fracture and multi-physical response of manmade and natural materials across spatial and temporal scales, integrating machine learning and AI with computational methods such as the finite element method, with applications in infrastructure resilience and energy.

faculty.name: Rita Leal Sousa
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Associate Professor in Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering. Her research interests include tunneling automation, natural threat risk assessment, soil erosion, and stochastic modeling.

faculty.name: Borja Garcia de Soto
faculty.title: Associate Professor, NYU Abu Dhabi; Global Network Associate Professor, NYU Tandon
faculty.summary: Associate Professor at NYU Abu Dhabi and Global Network Associate Professor in Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering at NYU Tandon, leading the S.M.A.R.T. Construction Research Group. His research covers construction automation and robotics, digital twins for the built environment, AEC cybersecurity, AI and multimodal LLMs in construction, lean project delivery, and BIM.

faculty.name: Elizabeth Hénaff
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Technology, Culture and Society (affiliated with Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering)
faculty.summary: Assistant Professor in Technology, Culture and Society and CUSP, affiliated with the Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering department, leading the Laboratory for Living Interfaces. Her work explores the way living beings interact with their environment, with recent emphasis on microbial communities in urban settings.

programs.program_name: Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering

faculty.name: Kaan Ozbay
faculty.title: Professor; Director of C2SMART (Tier 1 USDOT University Transportation Center)
faculty.sub_field: Traffic simulation, sensing, and real-time traffic control
faculty.summary: Research interests include simulation models, advanced technology and sensing applications, traffic incident and emergency management, feedback-based online real-time traffic control techniques, operations research, humanitarian inventory control, and transportation economics. He directs C2SMART, a Tier 1 University Transportation Center funded by USDOT.

faculty.name: Joseph Chow
faculty.title: Institute Associate Professor; Deputy Director of C2SMART Center
faculty.sub_field: Multimodal transportation systems and behavioral urban logistics
faculty.summary: His expertise lies in transportation systems, with emphasis on multimodal networks, behavioral urban logistics, smart cities, and transport economics. He heads BUILT@NYU, the Behavioral Urban Informatics, Logistics, and Transport Laboratory.

faculty.name: Linda Ng Boyle
faculty.title: Vice Dean for Research; Professor of Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering
faculty.summary: Research interests include driving behavior, crash countermeasures, crash and safety analysis, and statistical modeling. She previously served as Professor and Chair of Industrial and Systems Engineering at the University of Washington and holds an NSF CAREER Award.

faculty.name: Daniel Vignon
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering
faculty.sub_field: Transportation economics and emerging mobility services
faculty.summary: His work focuses on informing the design, regulation, and operation of emerging mobility services and smart infrastructure systems, combining engineering and economics to model their interactions with markets, study their impact on social welfare, and design policies to regulate them. He leads FEATS, the laboratory For the Economic Analysis of Transportation Systems.

faculty.name: Eugene Vinitsky
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering
faculty.sub_field: Reinforcement learning for autonomous vehicles and traffic control
faculty.summary: Research interests are reinforcement learning, autonomous vehicles, and traffic control, centering on enabling complex, human-like behavior to emerge through unsupervised multi-agent learning with applications to autonomous vehicle operation.

faculty.name: Samer Madanat
faculty.title: Dean of Engineering, NYU Abu Dhabi; Xenel Distinguished Professor of Engineering
faculty.summary: Research interests are transportation infrastructure management and transportation systems analysis, including modeling facility performance, optimal management policies under uncertainty, and sustainable transportation solutions.

faculty.name: Zhibin Chen
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Engineering, NYU Shanghai; Global Network Assistant Professor, NYU
faculty.summary: Research interests are transportation network modeling and optimization, intelligent transportation systems, and discrete optimization.

faculty.name: Saif Eddin Jabari
faculty.title: Associate Professor, NYU Abu Dhabi; Global Network Associate Professor, NYU
faculty.sub_field: Traffic flow theory and urban network traffic management
faculty.summary: Research interests include traffic flow theory, algorithms for urban network traffic management, and applied probability and statistical mechanics, focusing on uncertainty modeling and emergent phenomena with applications to traffic state estimation, prediction, distributed control, and cybersecurity.

faculty.name: Monica Menendez
faculty.title: Professor, NYU Abu Dhabi; Global Network Professor of Civil, Urban and Environmental Engineering, NYU
faculty.sub_field: Multimodal transportation systems monitoring and control
faculty.summary: Her research focuses on monitoring, modeling, and control of multimodal transportation systems, considering new technologies and data sources. She is Director and Lead PI of the NYUAD Research Center for Interacting Urban Networks (CITIES).

faculty.name: Ali Diabat
faculty.title: Professor, NYU Abu Dhabi; Global Network Professor, NYU
faculty.summary: Research interests are logistics and supply chain management, within the Department of Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering.

faculty.name: Zhong-Ping Jiang
faculty.title: Institute Professor, Electrical and Computer Engineering; affiliated transportation faculty, Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering
faculty.sub_field: Learning-based control for connected and autonomous vehicles
faculty.summary: Research covers stability theory; robust, adaptive, and distributed nonlinear control; robust adaptive dynamic programming; and reinforcement learning, with applications including connected and autonomous vehicles. He is listed as affiliated faculty on the department's transportation faculty page and leads the Control and Networks (CAN) Lab.

faculty.name: Maurizio Porfiri
faculty.title: Institute Professor; Interim Chair, Civil, Urban, and Environmental Engineering; Director, Center for Urban Science + Progress (CUSP)
faculty.sub_field: Urban science and complex systems (mobility networks)
faculty.summary: Research interests include collective behavior, complex systems, network science, theoretical mechanics, and urban science; his profile highlights work on how factors like income inequality, poverty, and housing costs shape commuting flows between counties. He directs the Dynamical Systems Laboratory and the Center for Urban Science + Progress.

faculty.name: Amal Ahmed
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Amal Ahmed is an associate dean of graduate programs and a professor at Khoury College. Her programming languages research has touched on semantics, type systems, secure compilation, gradual typing, and software contracts.

faculty.name: Javed Aslam
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Javed Aslam is a professor at Khoury College. His research emphasizes machine learning and information retrieval, with forays into human computation, transportation, computer security, wireless networking, and medical informatics.

faculty.name: David Bau
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: David Bau is an assistant professor at Khoury College and the lead principal investigator of the National Deep Inference Fabric project. His research centers on human–computer interaction and machine learning, including the gap between the efficacy of AI and scientists’ ability to explain it.

faculty.name: Soheil Behnezhad
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Soheil Behnezhad is an associate professor at Khoury College. He is broadly interested in theoretical computer science, with much of his work focused on graph algorithms and the theoretical foundations of big data algorithms.

faculty.name: Jonathan Bell
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Jonathan Bell is an assistant professor at Khoury College. His research focuses on automated approaches to help developers write better software, particularly in Java and JavaScript.

faculty.name: Enrico Bertini
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Enrico Bertini is an associate professor at Khoury College, jointly appointed with the College of Arts, Media and Design. Through his research and his podcast Data Stories, he works to make data visualization more understandable and useful for broad audiences.

faculty.name: Carla Brodley
faculty.title: Professor, Former Dean
faculty.summary: Professor and former Dean (2014-2021) who hired 46 tenure/tenure-track faculty. Research in computing education, broadening participation in CS, and machine learning.

faculty.name: Seth Cooper
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Seth Cooper is an associate professor at Khoury College. By combining game design with crowdsourcing and automated tools, he has become a pioneer of scientific discovery games.

faculty.name: Gene Cooperman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Gene Cooperman is a professor at Khoury College and leader of the High Performance Computing Laboratory. He researches a slew of interdisciplinary computing, math, and physics topics, and contributed to “GEANT4 – A Simulation Toolkit” — the most widely cited paper in high-energy physics.

faculty.name: Peter Desnoyers
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Peter Desnoyers is an associate professor at Khoury College and a co-founder of the Massachusetts Open Cloud, a multi-institutional collaboration that develops new cloud computing models. His research examines storage issues in operating systems, namely the integration of emerging storage tech into existing software infrastructures.

faculty.name: Jennifer Dy
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Jennifer Dy is a professor in the College of Engineering and Khoury College of Computer Sciences. Her research explores machine learning, data mining, statistical pattern recognition, and computer vision.

faculty.name: Ehsan Elhamifar
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Ehsan Elhamifar is an associate professor at Khoury College, affiliated with the College of Engineering. The overarching goal of his research is to develop AI that learns from and makes inferences about visual data analogous to humans.

faculty.name: Yun Raymond Fu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Yun Raymond Fu is a University Distinguished Professor jointly appointed between the College of Engineering and Khoury College. He is a widely renowned scholar in AI, machine learning, data mining, and computer vision whose resume includes 500+ scientific publications and 40+ patented inventions.

faculty.name: Wolfgang Gatterbauer
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Wolfgang Gatterbauer is an associate professor at Khoury College. He works on the theory of scalable data management, with the goal of expanding data management systems and enabling them to support novel functionalities.

faculty.name: Fatemeh Ghoreishi
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Fatemeh Ghoreishi is an assistant professor at Khoury College, jointly appointed with the College of Engineering. Her research examines machine learning and Bayesian statistics for design and decision-making under uncertainty.

faculty.name: Arjun Guha
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Arjun Guha is an associate professor at Khoury College. His programming languages research addresses security and reliability problems in web programming, systems, and robotics.

faculty.name: Huaizu Jiang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Huaizu Jiang is an assistant professor at Khoury College. His research interests include computer vision, computational photography, machine learning, AI, and natural language processing.

faculty.name: Karl Lieberherr
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Karl Lieberherr is a professor at Khoury College, having joined in 1985. His research has led to advances in programming technology and algorithms that are widely used for object-oriented technology and SAT solvers.

faculty.name: Stacy Marsella
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Professor. Research in computational modeling of cognition, emotion, and social behavior, with applications in virtual agents and human-AI interaction.

faculty.name: Huy Lê Nguyen
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Huy Lê Nguyen is an associate professor at Khoury College. He researches the design and analysis of algorithms, with an emphasis on algorithmic techniques for machine learning and massive data sets.

faculty.name: Jose Perea
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Jose Perea is an associate professor at Khoury College, jointly appointed with the College of Science. He is passionate about using nonstandard mathematical ideas to solve problems in data science and machine learning.

faculty.name: Mirek Riedewald
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Mirek Riedewald is a professor at Khoury College. His research emphasizes the design of novel, scalable data management and analysis techniques, with applications in ornithology, physics, astronomy, and mechanical and aerospace engineering, among other fields.

faculty.name: Ji-Yong Shin
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Ji-Yong Shin is an assistant professor at Khoury College. His research focuses on formal verification methods that can be applied to system designs, with additional interests in distributed systems, cloud storage systems, and operating systems.

faculty.name: Frank Tip
faculty.title: Professor
