faculty.name: Scott Bartell
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health; Vice Dean, Academic Affairs
faculty.summary: Has dedicated his research to quantifying human exposures and health effects caused by environmental contaminants, including perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), with a focus on contamination and epidemiology in U.S. water sources.

faculty.name: Stephen Bondy
faculty.title: Professor of Medicine, Environmental & Occupational Health
faculty.summary: His work focuses on brain aging and the environmental and dietary agents that promote or retard such aging.

faculty.name: Saurabh Chatterjee
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health; Professor of Medicine, UCI School of Medicine
faculty.summary: Investigates host-microbiome interactions with redox biology, neuroimmune pathology, and gut-brain interactions in pro-inflammatory disease processes, including Gulf War illness and chronic multi-symptom illnesses.

faculty.name: Andrea De Vizcaya Ruiz
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health; Graduate Program Director, Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: An environmental toxicologist who focuses on the effects of particulate matter, microplastics, and nanomaterials toxicity on the human body, using laboratory and animal models to evaluate tissue injury, inflammation, and oxidative stress from environmental and occupational exposures.

faculty.name: Rufus Edwards
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health
faculty.summary: Investigates how emissions affect populations globally, examining exposures to combustion byproducts in industrialized nations and household solid fuel emissions in less industrialized regions; a widely cited expert on solid fuels used for cooking and heating.

faculty.name: Jill Johnston
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health
faculty.summary: Her research centers on community-driven approaches to understand health impacts from industrial pollution and energy production, partnering with local organizations and residents on air pollution, oil and gas extraction, extreme heat, and environmental justice issues.

faculty.name: Masashi Kitazawa
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health
faculty.summary: Investigates the molecular pathogenesis of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease and how environmental toxicants affect neuroinflammation, examining cellular signaling pathways in brain immune cells using experimental models and cultured cells.

faculty.name: Karen Lincoln
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental and Occupational Health; Director of Center for Environmental Health Disparities Research
faculty.summary: Investigates psychosocial, behavioral, and biological mechanisms that link social determinants to health and well-being, focusing on improving outcomes for Black Americans, older adults, and marginalized populations.

faculty.name: Ulrike Luderer
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health; Director, Center for Occupational & Environmental Health
faculty.summary: A reproductive toxicologist focused on how toxicants and ionizing radiation disrupt reproductive function and on mechanisms that protect against such disruption, including effects on ovarian health across generations.

faculty.name: Marizen Ramirez
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health; Associate Dean for Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
faculty.summary: Specializes in injury and violence prevention, examining factors that influence injury rates among workers and exploring community-based approaches to preventing violence.

faculty.name: David Richardson
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health; Associate Dean of Research
faculty.summary: Designs studies to explore potential occupational health hazards so that employers and policymakers can construct safer working environments, with interests including radiation exposure and cancer risk, heat-related worker injury, and novel epidemiological methods.

faculty.name: Nicole Sparks
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health
faculty.summary: Investigates how environmental toxicants, particularly tobacco product exposure, affect fetal development, using stem cell and animal models to examine changes in microRNA and mRNA expression that cause embryonic bone-cell defects.

faculty.name: Veronica Vieira
faculty.title: Chair & Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health
faculty.summary: Conducts epidemiologic analyses of health data to examine the contributions of known risk factors and environmental exposures to underlying patterns of disease risk, using geographic methods to model environmental exposures and identify communities facing elevated health risks.

faculty.name: Jun Wu
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental & Occupational Health; Director, Graduate Programs in Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Examines influences of various environmental exposures, such as air pollution, climate, and the built environment, on reproductive and children's health outcomes through population-based epidemiological studies.

requirements.admission_model: Faculty-advisor selection; must secure advisor before applying

funding.note: TA/RA and Graduate Division fellowships; most funding to PhD applicants

faculty.name: Yousef Bozorgnia
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on earthquake engineering and engineering seismology, including ground motion hazard analysis, seismic hazard mapping, and performance-based seismic design of structures.

faculty.name: Scott J. Brandenberg
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Specializes in geotechnical earthquake engineering with focus on soil-structure interaction, liquefaction assessment, geophysical imaging for site characterization, and seismic performance of levee systems.

faculty.name: Jiann-Wen (Woody) Ju
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in damage mechanics, computational plasticity, micromechanics, and durability modeling of concrete and composite materials. Develops multiscale computational methods for structural materials.

faculty.name: Jonathan P. Stewart
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research covers geotechnical earthquake engineering, soil-structure interaction, engineering seismology, site response analysis, and seismic hazard assessment for critical infrastructure.

faculty.name: Ertugrul Taciroglu
faculty.title: Professor and Department Chair
faculty.summary: Department Chair. Research in computational structural and solid mechanics, constitutive modeling, structural health monitoring, performance-based earthquake engineering, and soil-structure interaction. NSF CAREER Award recipient and ASCE Fellow.

faculty.name: John W. Wallace
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on earthquake engineering design methodologies, seismic evaluation and retrofit of existing structures, and large-scale experimental testing of structural components and systems.

faculty.name: Jian Zhang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in earthquake engineering, structural dynamics and mechanics, seismic protective devices and strategies, soil-structure interaction, and bridge engineering performance assessment.

faculty.name: Sriram Narasimhan
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on structural dynamics, system identification, uncertainty quantification, and sensing and monitoring of civil infrastructure systems for condition assessment and decision-making.

faculty.name: Eric M.V. Hoek
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in physical and chemical environmental processes, colloidal and interfacial phenomena, membrane separations for water treatment and desalination, and environmental applications of nanotechnology.

faculty.name: Jennifer A. Jay
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies aquatic chemistry and environmental microbiology, with emphasis on mercury biogeochemistry, contaminant fate and transport in aquatic systems, and water quality in natural and engineered environments.

faculty.name: Michael K. Stenstrom
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on process development and control for water and wastewater treatment plants, including biological nutrient removal, activated sludge processes, and stormwater characterization and treatment.

faculty.name: David Jassby
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on water treatment and desalination technologies, membrane separation processes, electrochemical water treatment, and environmental applications of nanotechnology.

faculty.name: Shaily Mahendra
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies environmental microbiology, biodegradation of groundwater contaminants, microbial-nanomaterial interactions, nanotoxicology, and application of molecular and isotopic tools for environmental remediation.

faculty.name: Gaurav N. Sant
faculty.title: Professor and Pritzker Professor of Sustainability
faculty.summary: Pritzker Professor of Sustainability. Research on cementitious materials and porous media, emphasizing chemistry-structure-property relationships, interfacial thermodynamics, and sustainable infrastructure materials including carbon capture via mineralization.

faculty.name: Dennis P. Lettenmaier
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: National Academy of Engineering member. Research in hydrologic modeling and prediction, hydrology-climate interactions, hydrologic change detection and attribution, and large-scale water resources assessment.

faculty.name: Steven A. Margulis
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in surface hydrology, hydrometeorology, remote sensing of land surface states and fluxes, and data assimilation for hydrologic prediction, with emphasis on snow hydrology in mountain environments.

faculty.name: Ali Mosleh
faculty.title: Professor and Evalyn Knight Professor of Engineering
faculty.summary: National Academy of Engineering member. Research on reliability engineering, physics of failure modeling, system life prediction, resilient systems design, and probabilistic risk assessment for complex engineered systems.

faculty.name: Enrique A. López-Droguett
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in risk and reliability sciences, Bayesian inference for structural health monitoring, prognostics and health management, digital twins, and machine learning for reliability and safety of engineered systems.

faculty.name: Henry V. Burton
faculty.title: Associate Professor and Presidential Endowed Professor of Structural Engineering
faculty.summary: Presidential Endowed Professor. Research in performance-based earthquake engineering, seismic design and retrofit, enhanced seismic performance systems, and building community resilience through integrated risk assessment.

faculty.name: Idil D. Akin
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in geotechnical engineering with focus on how wildfires alter soil properties and affect slope stability, unsaturated soil mechanics, and bio-inspired geotechnical design drawing from natural systems.

faculty.name: Mathieu Bauchy
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research on development of high-performance and sustainable glasses and cementitious materials using physics-based and data-driven multiscale simulations to understand structure-property relationships.

faculty.name: Timu W. Gallien
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research on urban coastal flood prediction, wave runup and overtopping, coastal hazard assessment, sea level rise impacts, flood control infrastructure performance, and nearshore remote sensing.

faculty.name: Sanjay K. Mohanty
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research on water quality and quantity changes in urban environments, sustainable urban development at the water-energy nexus, contaminant transport, stormwater capture and treatment, and bioremediation technologies.

faculty.name: Adnan Darwiche
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in automated reasoning, knowledge representation, and probabilistic graphical models. Known for work on symbolic reasoning, tractable inference, and explainable AI.

faculty.name: Amit Sahai
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leading researcher in theoretical cryptography, including attribute-based encryption, functional encryption, and program obfuscation. Director of the Center for Encrypted Functionalities.

faculty.name: Guy Van den Broeck
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on tractable probabilistic models, combining probabilistic reasoning with deep learning. Leading the Statistical and Relational AI (StarAI) Lab.

faculty.name: Songwu Lu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on wireless networking, mobile systems, and network security. Focus on 5G/next-G cellular networks, software-defined networking, and cloud computing.

faculty.name: Mani Srivastava
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in networked embedded systems, cyber-physical systems, IoT, and mobile health. Leading the Networked and Embedded Systems Lab (NESL).

faculty.name: Jason Cong
faculty.title: Professor (Volgenau Professor of Engineering Excellence)
faculty.summary: Pioneer in electronic design automation, FPGA synthesis, and customizable computing. Director of the Center for Domain-Specific Computing (CDSC).

faculty.name: Miryung Kim
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in software engineering, program analysis, and software evolution. Focus on code refactoring, API migration, and large-scale software analytics.

faculty.name: Yizhou Sun
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on mining large-scale information networks, graph neural networks, and knowledge graph reasoning. Leading the Data Mining Lab.

faculty.name: Wei Wang
faculty.title: Professor (Leonard Kleinrock Term Professor of Computer Science)
faculty.summary: Research in data mining, machine learning, and computational biology. Focus on genomics, epigenomics, and integrative analysis of biological data.

faculty.name: Quanquan Gu
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in machine learning foundations, optimization for deep learning, and reinforcement learning theory. Focus on understanding deep learning from an optimization perspective.

faculty.name: Cho-Jui Hsieh
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in large-scale machine learning, optimization algorithms, and NLP. Focus on scalable training, adversarial robustness, and efficient deep learning.

faculty.name: Bolei Zhou
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computer vision, interpretable machine learning, and AI for autonomous driving. Known for work on interpretable deep networks and scene understanding.

faculty.name: Kai-Wei Chang
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in natural language processing, focusing on robust and fair NLP models, multilingual representations, and knowledge-grounded language models.

faculty.name: Sriram Sankararaman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research at the intersection of computer science and human genetics. Focus on statistical methods for analyzing genomic data and understanding complex traits.

faculty.name: Jason Ernst
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computational epigenomics and regulatory genomics. Known for developing ChromHMM for chromatin state discovery and large-scale epigenomic data analysis.

faculty.name: Eleazar Eskin
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Chair of Computational Medicine. Research in statistical genetics, bioinformatics, and computational biology. Focus on GWAS, eQTL analysis, and population genetics methods.

faculty.name: George Varghese
faculty.title: Professor (Jonathan B. Postel Professor of Networking)
faculty.summary: Pioneer in network algorithmics and high-speed packet processing. Known for foundational work on IP lookup, packet classification, and self-stabilizing protocols.

faculty.name: Raghu Meka
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in theoretical computer science, particularly pseudorandomness, computational complexity, and learning theory. Known for work on derandomization and Boolean function analysis.

faculty.name: Aditya Grover
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in probabilistic machine learning, generative models, and AI for scientific discovery. Focus on foundation models for physical sciences and sequential decision-making.

faculty.name: Saadia Gabriel
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in NLP with focus on fairness, ethics, and social implications of AI. Working on detecting misinformation, understanding social biases in language models.

faculty.name: Mark S. Handcock
faculty.title: Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Research in social network analysis, network inference, survey methodology for hard-to-reach populations, spatial processes, demography, and social epidemiology. Dunn Family Endowed Chair in Data Theory.

faculty.name: Jingyi Jessica Li
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical genomics and bioinformatics, focusing on single-cell RNA sequencing analysis, false discovery rate control, and high-dimensional inference methods.

faculty.name: Frederic Schoenberg
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in point process theory with applications to earthquake forecasting, wildfire prediction, crime forecasting, and epidemic disease modeling. Director of the MASDS Program.

faculty.name: Oscar Hernan Madrid Padilla
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in high-dimensional and nonparametric statistics, change point detection, network problems, deep learning theory, and causal inference methods.

faculty.name: Chad Hazlett
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in causal inference methodology with applications in political science, civil conflict, and program evaluation. Co-Director of the Practical Causal Inference Lab.

faculty.name: Guang Cheng
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in theoretical statistics including high-dimensional inference, nonparametric Bayesian methods, and statistical foundations of deep learning with applications in data science.

faculty.name: Qing Zhou
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in Bayesian statistical methods for genomics, network inference, and computational biology, developing algorithms for analyzing high-throughput biological data.

faculty.name: Ying Nian Wu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in machine learning, computer vision, generative modeling, and representation learning, developing deep generative models with statistical foundations.

faculty.name: Arash A. Amini
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical network analysis, high-dimensional inference, spectral methods, and community detection in complex networks with theoretical guarantees.

faculty.name: Hua Zhou
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computational statistics, optimization algorithms for statistical models, mixed-effects models, and applications in statistical genomics and imaging genetics.

faculty.name: Daniele Bianchi
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Leads the UCLA Ocean Biogeochemistry and Ecosystem Group, which investigates ocean biogeochemistry and ecosystem dynamics, with research areas including the California Current ecosystem, oxygen minimum zones, and the mesopelagic ecosystem.

faculty.name: Jacob Bortnik
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leads the Bortnik Group, which applies machine learning to study Earth's space environment as part of the department's space physics research division.

faculty.name: Marcelo Chamecki
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates turbulence dynamics and transport processes in atmospheric and oceanic boundary layers, combining numerical simulations, field experiments, and analytical methods; topics include particle and pollutant dispersion, forest-canopy turbulence, and large-eddy simulation model development.

faculty.name: Gang Chen
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies large-scale atmospheric circulation and transport that shape weather and climate extremes, bridging theory and modeling to understand jet stream behavior and how circulation patterns connect to extreme weather events.

faculty.name: Yue Dong
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Studies climate dynamics and change, with emphasis on large-scale interactions in the coupled climate system, such as atmosphere-ocean interactions and tropics-extratropics teleconnections, and how these processes relate to Earth's radiative responses and climate sensitivity.

faculty.name: Rob Eagle
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research examines how physical environments influence organism biology, and explores climate history alongside the evolution of life and biomineralization, including experimental studies of species vulnerability to changing ocean conditions.

faculty.name: Rong Fu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leads the WAVE Research Group studying mechanisms that control droughts, fire weather, and rainfall seasonality and variability over Amazonian and North American regions, using satellite remote sensing of atmosphere-land-vegetation interactions. Elected to the National Academy of Engineering in 2024 for methodologies using satellite data to characterize and predict land precipitation.

faculty.name: Alex Hall
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: His group studies how global climate models project future climate impacts, with emphasis on extreme precipitation, snow and water resources, and drought, developing techniques including emergent constraints and downscaling methods to improve climate projections at policy-relevant spatial scales.

faculty.name: Jasper Kok
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: His group studies how aerosols, particularly desert dust, interact with Earth's climate system through modeling and observations, examining cloud microphysics, Earth's energy balance, climate feedbacks, and the feasibility of climate intervention strategies.

faculty.name: Qinbin Li
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leads UCLA's atmospheric chemistry modeling group, working on global and regional 3-D modeling and analysis of satellite, aircraft, and ground observations using GEOS-Chem, CMAQ, and WRF-Chem, with particular focus on chemical data assimilation, inverse modeling, and biomass-burning aerosols such as black carbon.

faculty.name: Karen McKinnon
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research sits at the nexus of climate science and statistics, addressing questions that span the weather-climate divide, the interactions between natural variability and human-caused climate change, and links to downstream human and biological impacts; holds a joint appointment in Statistics and the Institute of the Environment and Sustainability.

faculty.name: James C. McWilliams
faculty.title: Louis B. and Martha B. Slichter Professor of Earth Sciences
faculty.summary: Research is broadly about natural geophysical fluid dynamics in the ocean and climate, encompassing theory, computational simulation, and data analysis; frequent subjects include the general circulation and its variability, mesoscale eddy processes, surface turbulent boundary layers, and submesoscale currents in the upper ocean. Member of the National Academy of Sciences.

faculty.name: Jonathan Mitchell
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: His group investigates the atmospheric dynamics and climate of terrestrial planets, particularly Titan and Earth, drawing comparisons across planetary bodies and using climate models to understand extreme atmospheric conditions.

faculty.name: J. David Neelin
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates coupled interactions within the climate system, particularly ocean-atmosphere dynamics and how moist convection processes affect tropical climate variability and precipitation responses to global warming.

faculty.name: Suzanne Paulson
faculty.title: Professor and Center for Clean Air Director
faculty.summary: Investigates atmospheric chemistry, urban air quality, and pollutant health effects, combining field and laboratory measurements, modeling, bibliometrics, and machine learning to study cloud droplet chemistry, particle sources in cities, and air pollution.

faculty.name: Pablo Saide
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: His group investigates air quality and atmospheric composition modeling at local to regional scales, with emphasis on air quality forecasting, data assimilation techniques, and aerosol interactions affecting climate projections, including wildfire smoke modeling.

faculty.name: Ulli Seibt
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Her lab investigates how land ecosystems function and interact with the atmosphere, focusing on tropical, Mediterranean, boreal, and arctic systems vulnerable to climate extremes, combining process-based modeling with field observations using carbonyl sulfide and solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence.

faculty.name: Andrew Stewart
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leads the Dynamical Oceanography Group, which investigates ocean circulation physics with emphasis on high-latitude dynamics, particularly around Antarctic margins, examining how the ocean interacts with the atmosphere, sea ice, and ice sheets using simulation tools.

faculty.name: Jochen Stutz
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: His group uses atmospheric spectroscopy and numerical modeling to examine air pollution, the impact of the ground and snow on atmospheric composition, wildfires, and plant photosynthesis, and develops spectroscopic instruments for environmental monitoring.

faculty.name: Roger Varney
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Leads the Varney Geospace Research Group, which investigates the physics of Earth's space environment, specifically the ionosphere and interactions between the ionosphere, upper atmosphere, and magnetosphere, contributing to understanding of space weather phenomena.

faculty.name: A. Park Williams
faculty.title: Professor (Department of Geography; affiliated faculty in Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences)
faculty.summary: Studies the causes and consequences of hydrological extremes such as drought, focusing on hydroclimatology and bioclimatology and the effects of human-caused climate change on extreme events including heat waves, wildfires, and flooding; his work showed that climate change contributed substantially to the southwestern North American megadrought. 2023 MacArthur Fellow.

faculty.name: Craig E. Manning
faculty.title: Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Elected to the National Academy of Sciences in 2026. Leads the UCLA PTX Lab studying high-pressure, high-temperature processes in Earth's crust and upper mantle. Research focuses on experimental petrology, deep carbon cycling, subduction zone fluids, and fluid-rock interactions at mid-crustal to upper-mantle conditions.

faculty.name: Gilles Peltzer
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Professor of Geology and Geophysics, also a Research Scientist at NASA JPL. Uses satellite geodesy (InSAR, GNSS) to study earthquake tectonics, crustal deformation, and landslide processes. AGU Fellow researching active fault systems and seismic hazard assessment.

faculty.name: Caroline Beghein
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies the structure and composition of Earth's interior using seismic waves. Research focuses on mantle tomography, seismic anisotropy, and constraining the mineralogy and dynamics of the crust and upper mantle through surface wave and normal mode seismology.

faculty.name: Carolina Lithgow-Bertelloni
faculty.title: Professor and Louis B. and Martha B. Slichter Endowed Chair in Geosciences
faculty.summary: Holds the Slichter Endowed Chair in Geosciences. Research in geodynamics and geophysics, studying mantle convection, plate tectonics, and the thermal and chemical evolution of Earth and planetary interiors using numerical modeling and geophysical constraints.

faculty.name: Lars Stixrude
faculty.title: Professor and Leon and Joanne V. C. Knopoff Chair in Geophysics and Physics
faculty.summary: Holds the Knopoff Chair in Geophysics and Physics. Research uses first-principles quantum mechanical computations to study minerals at extreme pressures and temperatures. Investigates the composition, structure, and evolution of Earth's deep interior and other planetary bodies.

faculty.name: Edwin A. Schauble
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research combines theoretical and experimental approaches to stable isotope geochemistry. Studies isotope fractionation mechanisms to develop new geochemical proxies for paleoclimate, biogeochemical cycling, and planetary formation processes.

faculty.name: Edward D. Young
faculty.title: Distinguished Professor and Vice Chair for Academic Personnel
faculty.summary: Distinguished Professor studying the origin and evolution of the solar system and planetary bodies through high-precision isotope geochemistry. Develops novel mass spectrometry techniques including clumped isotope geothermometry applied to Earth and extraterrestrial materials.

faculty.name: Aradhna E. Tripati
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in paleoclimatology and geochemistry using stable and clumped isotope techniques to reconstruct past climate and environmental change. Studies carbonate formation, ocean acidification history, and climate dynamics across geological timescales.

faculty.name: Tina Treude
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies geobiology and marine biogeochemistry with focus on seafloor processes, microbial methane cycling, and benthic-pelagic coupling. Investigates the role of marine sediments in global biogeochemical cycles and ocean deoxygenation impacts.

faculty.name: David A. Paige
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Planetary scientist studying the geology and surface processes of solar system bodies, with emphasis on the Moon and Mars. Research uses spacecraft remote sensing data to investigate planetary surface evolution, polar deposits, and regolith properties.

faculty.name: Lingsen Meng
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies earthquake physics and seismology, focusing on rupture dynamics of large earthquakes, subduction zone processes, and strong ground motion. Uses seismic imaging techniques to understand fault mechanics and earthquake hazard.

faculty.name: Seulgi Moon
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research integrates geomorphology and tectonics to understand landscape evolution. Studies the interactions between tectonic forcing, climate, and surface processes that shape topography, including sediment routing from source to sink and erosion rate quantification using cosmogenic nuclides.

faculty.name: Mackenzie Day
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Sedimentologist studying aeolian (wind-driven) processes on Earth and other planetary bodies. Research focuses on dune dynamics, sedimentary structures, and using sedimentary geology to interpret surface environments and climate history on Earth, Mars, and Titan.

faculty.name: Hao Cao
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies planetary magnetism and interior dynamics including Earth's geodynamo. Research bridges geophysics and planetary science to understand the generation and evolution of magnetic fields in planetary cores and the implications for planetary habitability.

faculty.name: John He
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in structural geology and tectonics, focusing on continental deformation and the evolution of orogenic belts. Combines field-based geological mapping with geochronology and numerical modeling to understand mountain building processes.

faculty.name: Stacy Larochelle
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Geophysicist studying mechanical interactions between water and the solid Earth. Research spans fault mechanics and earthquake physics, ice sheet dynamics and subglacial hydrology, and hydrology-driven geodetic deformation using satellite geodesy and numerical modeling.

faculty.name: Peng Ni
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in experimental petrology and non-traditional stable isotope geochemistry to probe Earth's deep interior and solar system evolution. Uses high-pressure experiments and isotope analysis of diamond inclusions, lunar samples, and meteorites to understand planetary formation and differentiation.

faculty.name: William I. Newman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical and computational geophysicist studying nonlinear processes in Earth sciences. Research includes geophysical fluid dynamics, Earth rotation variations, computational methods for geophysical inverse problems, and applications of statistical physics to geological processes.

faculty.name: Vassilis Angelopoulos
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Principal Investigator of NASA's THEMIS and ARTEMIS missions studying particle acceleration in Earth's magnetosphere, magnetic reconnection triggering substorms, and the lunar plasma environment. Leads the Experimental Space Physics group and the ELFIN CubeSat program training undergraduates in space hardware.

faculty.name: Marco Velli
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Observational Scientist for NASA's Parker Solar Probe mission, studying solar wind acceleration, coronal heating, magnetic switchbacks, and heliospheric current sheet dynamics. Fellow of the American Geophysical Union with research spanning MHD turbulence, wave-particle interactions, and space weather.

faculty.name: Jonathan Aurnou
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Director of the SPINLab (Simulated Planetary Interiors Laboratory), using rotating tank experiments with liquid gallium and water to study planetary dynamo action, rotating turbulence, and convective transport in planetary cores and atmospheres. Also leads the DIYnamics educational outreach project.

faculty.name: Caroline Beghein
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Uses earthquake and marsquake recordings to map Earth and Mars mantle structure and seismic anisotropy. NASA InSight Participating Scientist who co-detected surface waves from a 4.7 magnitude marsquake and identified a mid-mantle discontinuity on Mars using transdimensional Bayesian inversion methods.

faculty.name: Lars Stixrude
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Uses first-principles quantum mechanical theory (DFT), thermodynamic modeling, and machine learning potentials to understand planetary interiors from atoms to planets. Co-developed the HeFESTo code for mantle phase equilibria and studies silicate melts, magma oceans, and core formation in Earth and exoplanets. AGU Macelwane Medalist.

faculty.name: Carolina Lithgow-Bertelloni
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies the connection between Earth's deep interior dynamics and surface processes including mantle convection, slab subduction, and dynamic topography. Co-developed the HeFESTo thermodynamic model for mantle minerals and demonstrated that many mantle plumes are barely hotter than surrounding mantle. AGU Union Fellow.

faculty.name: Lingsen Meng
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on earthquake source imaging, rupture dynamics, and building next-generation earthquake and tsunami early-warning systems by integrating seismic array back-projection, adjoint full-waveform inversion, numerical simulations, and AI techniques. Studies supershear ruptures, earthquake swarms, and slow slip phenomena.

faculty.name: Hao Cao
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies the origin, dynamics, and impacts of planetary magnetic fields through dynamo theory, spacecraft data analysis, and numerical simulations. Involved in NASA Juno and Europa Clipper missions, with key discoveries on Jupiter's deep interior dynamics and Saturn's complex magnetic field. 2025 Sloan Research Fellow.

faculty.name: David Paige
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Principal Investigator of the Diviner Lunar Radiometer on NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, mapping lunar surface temperatures and water ice in permanently shadowed regions since 2009. Also Deputy PI of RIMFAX ground-penetrating radar on Mars Perseverance rover and Co-I on Artemis lunar instruments. NASA Exceptional Scientific Achievement Medal recipient.

faculty.name: Jean-Luc Margot
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Uses radar and radio astronomy techniques to study planetary interiors, spin states, and surface properties of Venus, asteroids, and icy moons. EnVision Interdisciplinary Scientist for ESA's Venus mission and Europa Clipper gravity science team member. Also conducts radio SETI searches for technosignatures around nearby stars.

faculty.name: Jonathan Mitchell
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies atmospheric dynamics and climate of terrestrial planets, particularly Titan and Earth, using a hierarchy of climate models combined with satellite observations. Leads the TPACE group exploring transitions between Earth-like and Titan-like climates by varying planetary rotation rate, water vapor, and global water reservoir size.

faculty.name: David Jewitt
faculty.title: Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Co-discoverer of the Kuiper Belt (Kavli Prize in Astrophysics 2012, Shaw Prize). Studies comets, Kuiper Belt objects, and active asteroids using ground-based and space telescopes, focusing on the compositional and physical properties of icy bodies and the color systematics of small solar system bodies.

faculty.name: Hilke Schlichting
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops theoretical models of planet formation and evolution at the intersection of astrophysics and planetary science. Studies super-Earths and sub-Neptunes, the core-powered mass-loss mechanism sculpting the exoplanet radius valley, magma ocean-atmosphere interactions, and planetary collisions. Asteroid 9522 named in her honor.

faculty.name: Mackenzie Day
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies wind-driven (aeolian) sediment transport and landscape evolution on Earth, Mars, and other planetary bodies through field work, wind tunnel experiments, and numerical modeling. Leads the GALE Lab investigating how dunes record climate history and reconstructing paleo-wind patterns from lithified Martian dunes. AGU Ronald Greeley Early Career Award recipient.

faculty.name: Seulgi Moon
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies how tectonics, climate, and bedrock properties control landscape evolution, weathering, and erosion. Published a 2025 Science paper demonstrating that active faults weaken rocks up to ~100 km away, dramatically increasing erosional efficiency. AGU Luna B. Leopold Early Career Award and Sloan Research Fellow. Note: Moving to ETH Zurich as of February 2026 but still listed on UCLA EPSS faculty page.

faculty.name: John He
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Interdisciplinary field geologist studying lithospheric deformation and surface-crust-mantle connections through structural geology, sedimentology, geodynamic modeling, and thermochronology. Investigates lithospheric dripping beneath high-elevation plateaus and recently published a Science paper solving the mystery of the Colorado River's 5-million-year absence from the geological record.

faculty.name: Peng Ni
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental planetary scientist studying planet formation and differentiation through high-pressure/high-temperature experiments and non-traditional stable isotope geochemistry. Investigates planetesimal core formation, lunar evolution, and deep Earth processes using piston cylinder apparatus and synchrotron techniques applied to meteorites and lunar samples.

faculty.name: William Newman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies chaos and complexity in astrophysical and geophysical systems, including relativistic magnetohydrodynamics in astrophysical jets, star and solar system formation, earthquake modeling, and climate change statistics. Holds joint appointments in Physics & Astronomy and Mathematics. Former John Simon Guggenheim Fellow and member of the Institute for Advanced Study.

faculty.name: Eleazar Eskin
faculty.title: Professor (Chair, Computational Medicine)
faculty.summary: Founding Chair of Computational Medicine Department. Research in statistical genetics, human genetics, and computational methods for analyzing genomic variation. Co-directs the undergraduate bioinformatics minor.

faculty.name: Matteo Pellegrini
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Director of the UCLA-DOE Institute for Genomics and Proteomics. Research on computational analysis of genomic and epigenomic data, particularly DNA methylation and its role in development and disease.

faculty.name: Jason Ernst
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Developer of ChromHMM for chromatin state discovery. Research in computational epigenomics, regulatory genomics, and machine learning methods for analyzing large-scale functional genomics data. Joint appointment in Computer Science.

faculty.name: Jingyi Jessica Li
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical genomics and bioinformatics, developing methods for analyzing single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data, and statistical methodology for genomic studies. Joint appointment in Statistics & Data Science, Human Genetics, Computational Medicine, and Biostatistics.

faculty.name: Bogdan Pasaniuc
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical genetics and computational genomics, focusing on methods for analyzing genetic variation in diverse populations, fine-mapping GWAS loci, and polygenic risk prediction.

faculty.name: Xia Yang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in systems biology and integrative genomics, combining multi-omics data with network modeling to understand complex diseases including metabolic disorders and cardiovascular disease.

faculty.name: Xinshu Grace Xiao
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on computational analysis of post-transcriptional regulation, including alternative splicing and RNA editing. Integrating RNA biology with genomic data for disease understanding.

faculty.name: Roy Wollman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in quantitative systems biology, combining single-cell measurements with computational modeling to understand cellular signaling and gene expression dynamics.

faculty.name: Alexander Hoffmann
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in systems biology of cellular signaling, using computational modeling and quantitative experiments to understand immune signaling pathways, particularly NF-kB dynamics.

faculty.name: Eric Deeds
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research on understanding how molecular interactions give rise to cellular behavior, focusing on protein interaction networks, biochemical signaling, and the evolution of protein complexes.

faculty.name: Paul Boutros
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Director of the Jonsson Comprehensive Cancer Center Cancer Data Science program. Research in cancer genomics, developing computational methods for analyzing tumor evolution, heterogeneity, and biomarkers.

faculty.name: Thomas Graeber
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in cancer systems biology using multi-omics approaches (proteomics, metabolomics, genomics) to study cancer signaling, drug response mechanisms, and therapy resistance.

faculty.name: Aaron Meyer
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research at the intersection of systems biology and immunology, developing computational methods to study cell signaling and immune responses, with applications to cancer immunotherapy.

faculty.name: Harold Pimentel
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical methods for functional genomics, including RNA-seq analysis, gene regulatory network inference, and understanding genetic variation effects on gene expression.

faculty.name: Brunilda Balliu
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical genetics, focusing on understanding how genetic variation affects molecular traits at the single-cell level and developing methods for single-cell eQTL analysis.

faculty.name: Nandita Garud
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in population genetics and evolutionary genomics, with focus on detecting natural selection in genomes, understanding the evolutionary dynamics of the gut microbiome.

faculty.name: Van Savage
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computational and mathematical biology, developing theoretical models for biological scaling laws, metabolic networks, and ecological systems dynamics.

faculty.name: Shantanu Joshi
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computational imaging and biomedical informatics, applying computer vision and machine learning to neuroimaging analysis and brain mapping applications.

faculty.name: Kirk Lohmueller
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Home Area Director of the Bioinformatics program. Research in population genetics and evolutionary biology, using computational methods to understand genetic variation and evolutionary processes.

faculty.name: James Lloyd-Smith
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in mathematical and computational modeling of infectious disease dynamics, zoonotic disease emergence, and ecological drivers of disease transmission.

faculty.name: Michael McNitt-Gray
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops quantitative CT imaging techniques for lung cancer screening and radiation dose estimation, including Monte Carlo simulation methods for CT dosimetry and AI-driven computer-aided diagnosis systems. His lab also contributes to open-source CT reconstruction tools (FreeCT) and imaging biomarker validation for clinical trials.

faculty.name: Magnus Dahlbom
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on nuclear medicine physics with emphasis on PET/CT imaging, theranostics, and radiopharmaceutical therapy dosimetry. His research spans PSMA-targeted molecular radiotherapy for prostate cancer, preclinical small-animal PET systems, and myocardial perfusion quantitation using PET tracers.

faculty.name: Matthew S. Brown
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops quantitative CT imaging biomarkers and AI algorithms for lung diseases including COPD, interstitial lung disease, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. His work bridges computer vision, machine learning, and thoracic radiology to translate quantitative imaging tools into clinical practice.

faculty.name: Aichi Chien
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies intracranial aneurysm growth and rupture risk using computational fluid dynamics, MRA, and patient-specific hemodynamic analysis. Her lab also applies AI and vision-language models to cerebrovascular image analysis, including automated aneurysm detection and radiologic report summarization.

faculty.name: Anthony G. Christodoulou
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops novel MRI techniques through innovations in MR physics, machine learning, and image reconstruction. His signature MR Multitasking framework enables simultaneous multiparametric mapping in a single free-breathing scan for cardiovascular disease and cancer applications.

faculty.name: Benjamin Ellingson
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Directs the UCLA Brain Tumor Imaging Laboratory, developing and validating advanced MRI techniques to characterize brain tumors, assess treatment response, and predict patient outcomes. He co-authors consensus RANO criteria and investigates physiologic MRI biomarkers for anti-VEGF and immunotherapy response in gliomas and brain metastases.

faculty.name: Hyun Grace Kim
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Focuses on quantitative chest CT imaging and computational modeling of fibrotic lung diseases, particularly idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. Combines medical imaging, statistical learning, and artificial intelligence to develop CT biomarkers that predict disease progression and treatment response.

faculty.name: Kyung Sung
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: MRI Physics / AI in Medical Imaging
faculty.summary: Develops artificial intelligence and quantitative MRI technologies for early cancer diagnosis, treatment guidance, and therapeutic response assessment. His lab integrates deep learning with advanced image reconstruction for multiparametric prostate MRI, placental imaging, and liver perfusion MRI.

faculty.name: M. Albert Thomas
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Advances magnetic resonance spectroscopic imaging (MRSI) techniques for noninvasive metabolic assessment of tissues in health and disease. His lab develops novel MRSI methodologies and evaluates their clinical utility across brain, prostate, and other pathologies.

faculty.name: Holden Wu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Creates and translates quantitative MRI technologies for image-guided therapy spanning detection, treatment planning, interventional guidance, and treatment monitoring of cancer and metabolic diseases. His lab develops rapid quantitative MRI for prostate, liver, and placental applications, plus real-time MRI-guided ablation and biopsy techniques.

faculty.name: Daniel Tward
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops computational tools for neuroimaging and brain anatomy analysis, focusing on image registration and mapping algorithms to process and interpret large-scale brain MRI datasets. His work bridges computational mathematics and clinical neuroscience.

faculty.name: Arion Chatziioannou
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Pioneers the development of high-resolution in vivo molecular imaging technology, particularly microPET and microSPECT scanners for preclinical small-animal research. His work spans detector physics, dual-modality PET/optical imaging, and automated radiochemistry systems for positron-emitting radioisotopes.

faculty.name: Johannes Czernin
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leads translational research in nuclear medicine and theranostics, with a focus on PSMA-targeted PET/CT imaging and 177Lu-PSMA radioligand therapy for prostate cancer. His work spans preclinical radiopharmaceutical development, multi-institutional clinical trials, and health policy advocacy for molecular imaging and radiotherapeutics.

faculty.name: Oluwatayo Ikotun
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops molecular imaging tools for in vivo characterization of immune cells, with expertise in immunoPET and radiotracer development using radionuclides such as zirconium-89. Her research spans cancer biomarker imaging, cardiovascular PET/CT, and advancing AAV gene therapy monitoring for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

faculty.name: Jennifer Murphy
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops novel 18F-radiolabeling methodologies to create targeted PET imaging tracers for cancer, including brain-penetrant EGFR kinase inhibitors for glioblastoma imaging. Her lab designs synthetic strategies using bioorthogonal chemistry for modular, dual-modality PET/fluorescence molecular imaging agents.

faculty.name: Caius Radu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops PET imaging approaches to monitor T lymphocyte activation in cancer and autoimmunity, bridging molecular imaging with immunology. His research focuses on creating noninvasive tools to track immune cell dynamics for improving cancer immunotherapy.

faculty.name: Michael van Dam
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops microfluidic technologies for cancer research and molecular imaging, focusing on miniaturized and automated platforms for PET radiopharmaceutical production. His lab integrates microfluidics, radiochemistry, and engineering to enable rapid, low-cost synthesis of molecular imaging probes.

faculty.name: Nzhde Agazaryan
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Serves as Chief of Clinical Medical Physics in Radiation Oncology, specializing in stereotactic radiosurgery, SBRT, small field dosimetry, IGRT, and gated radiotherapy. His research focuses on technical innovation in treatment delivery accuracy, safety, and quality assurance across brain, spine, prostate, and lung treatments.

faculty.name: Daniel Low
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Specializes in radiation oncology medical physics with emphasis on MRI-guided radiation therapy, respiratory motion modeling via 4DCT/5DCT, and stereotactic body radiotherapy. He leads multi-institutional clinical trials including MIRAGE comparing MRI-guided versus CT-guided SBRT for prostate cancer.

faculty.name: James Lamb
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Advances radiation oncology through MRI-guided radiotherapy, automated quality assurance using deep learning, and AI-assisted treatment workflow. A key contributor to the MIRAGE randomized trial, his research spans online adaptive radiotherapy, motion management, and brachytherapy for uveal melanoma.

faculty.name: Sudipto Banerjee
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in Bayesian hierarchical modeling for spatially and temporally referenced data with applications in environmental health, epidemiology, and geostatistics.

faculty.name: Thomas R. Belin
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical methods for mental health research, Bayesian inference with incomplete data, and statistical consulting methodology for health sciences.

faculty.name: Ronald Brookmeyer
faculty.title: Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical methods for infectious disease surveillance and epidemiology, HIV/AIDS modeling, and biostatistical methods for public health policy evaluation.

faculty.name: Guang Cheng
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical machine learning, high-dimensional inference, and nonparametric Bayesian methods with applications in biomedical data analysis.

faculty.name: David Elashoff
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computational biostatistics for cancer research, developing statistical methods for genomic biomarker discovery, predictive modeling, and integrative bioinformatics analysis.

faculty.name: Michele Guindani
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in Bayesian nonparametric methods with applications in neuroimaging, biomarker discovery, and clinical trial design for neuroscience and biomedical research.

faculty.name: Gang Li
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in survival analysis, longitudinal data analysis, and clinical trial design, developing statistical methods for biomarker evaluation and personalized medicine.

faculty.name: Honghu Liu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in biostatistical methods for health services research, patient-reported outcomes, psychometrics, and quality of life measurement with focus on health disparities.

faculty.name: Christina Ramirez
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in biostatistical methods for global health research, focusing on infectious disease studies, clinical trials in resource-limited settings, and HIV/AIDS research.

faculty.name: Damla Senturk
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in functional and longitudinal data analysis, varying coefficient models, and statistical methods for neuroimaging data with applications in biomedical research.

faculty.name: Marc Suchard
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computational statistics for Bayesian phylogenetic inference, developing high-performance MCMC and GPU-accelerated algorithms for evolutionary biology and biomedicine.

faculty.name: Donatello Telesca
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in Bayesian nonparametric and semiparametric methods for functional and longitudinal data, with applications in neuroscience and biomedical studies.

faculty.name: Weng Kee Wong
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical optimal design of experiments, including clinical trial design, dose-finding studies, and applications in personalized medicine and biosciences.

faculty.name: Hua Zhou
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computational statistics, numerical optimization for statistical models, mixed-effects modeling, and applications in statistical genomics and imaging genetics.

faculty.name: Jin Zhou
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical genetics and precision medicine, developing methods for analyzing multi-omics data, longitudinal trajectories, and gene-environment interactions.

faculty.name: Jason Xu
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in stochastic modeling and statistical machine learning, including EM/MM algorithms, branching processes, and epidemiological modeling with computational statistics.

faculty.name: Andrew Holbrook
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in Bayesian inference with applications in computational biology, phylogenetics, and advanced MCMC methodology for complex biological models.

faculty.name: Brunilda Balliu
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in statistical genetics and genomics, developing methods for analyzing gene expression, expression quantitative trait loci, and their role in precision medicine.

faculty.name: Falco J. Bargagli Stoffi
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in causal inference and machine learning methodology, developing Bayesian and frequentist methods for policy evaluation and causal effect estimation in health policy.

faculty.name: Xiaowu Dai
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in causal inference with applications in econometrics and health policy, developing machine learning-based approaches for treatment effect estimation.

faculty.name: Sijia Li
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research in biostatistical methods with applications in clinical research, survival analysis, and developing novel approaches for complex health data analysis.

faculty.name: Rachael Jones
faculty.title: Professor and Chair of Environmental Health Sciences; Director, Southern California Education and Research Center
faculty.sub_field: Occupational exposure science and industrial hygiene
faculty.summary: Dr. Jones specializes in exposure modeling, simulation studies, and field sampling, with emphasis on the assessment and control of workplace exposures to infectious agents such as respiratory viruses. Her recent work explores equity dimensions in occupational health.

faculty.name: Jesus Araujo
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.sub_field: Environmental cardiology and air pollution toxicology
faculty.summary: Dr. Araujo investigates how air pollutant exposure promotes cardiovascular disease through mechanisms involving vascular oxidative stress and gene pathways. His work examines protective genes such as heme oxygenase-1 and their role in vascular inflammatory conditions like atherosclerosis.

faculty.name: Lara Cushing
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Dr. Cushing investigates how social and environmental stressors disproportionately affect vulnerable populations, examining exposure inequities related to climate change, energy development, and water quality. Her work partners with community organizations to inform policy.

faculty.name: Feng Gao
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.sub_field: Computational environmental health and exposure modeling
faculty.summary: Dr. Gao investigates how environmental contaminants such as metals, pesticides, and PFAS affect human health outcomes using advanced data analytics and computational techniques. His work spans exposure modeling, toxicity prediction, and epidemiological analysis of disease mechanisms.

faculty.name: Oliver Hankinson
faculty.title: Distinguished Research Professor of Environmental Health Sciences and Pathology & Laboratory Medicine
faculty.summary: Dr. Hankinson investigates how the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor mediates the toxic and carcinogenic effects of chemical pollutants found in smog, cigarette smoke, and overcooked foods. He also examines the role of dietary omega-3 fatty acids in inhibiting breast cancer growth and metastasis.

faculty.name: Michael Jerrett
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.sub_field: Geospatial exposure assessment and spatial epidemiology
faculty.summary: Dr. Jerrett investigates population exposures to air pollution and other environmental variables using geographic information science, examining how exposures affect different demographic groups and their health consequences. His recent work explores how the built and natural environment contribute to physical activity, obesity, and health outcomes.

faculty.name: Yifang Zhu
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Dr. Zhu's work focuses on measuring and modeling air pollutant emissions, transport, and transformation, as well as assessing and mitigating the associated health effects. Her scholarship has earned recognition including the NSF CAREER Award and the Haagen-Smit Prize.

faculty.name: André Nel
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.sub_field: Nanotoxicology and air pollution health effects
faculty.summary: Dr. Nel investigates how air pollutants contribute to asthma development, specifically examining the mechanisms by which ultrafine particle-induced oxidative stress generates airway inflammation. His work also encompasses nanobiology and the health effects of engineered nanomaterials.

faculty.name: Beate Ritz
faculty.title: Professor of Epidemiology and Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Dr. Ritz investigates how environmental and occupational exposures affect chronic diseases including neurological conditions, cancers, and adverse birth outcomes. Her work uses geographic information systems to model exposures and examines interactions between genetic susceptibility and environmental factors.

faculty.name: Candace Tsai
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.sub_field: Industrial hygiene and aerosol/nanoparticle exposure assessment
faculty.summary: Dr. Tsai investigates aerosol, nanoparticle, and toxic airborne substance exposure assessment in occupational and environmental settings. Her work encompasses particle sampling techniques, toxicological studies, computational modeling of aerosol exposure, and protective equipment efficacy.

faculty.name: Shane Que Hee
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental Health Sciences; Director, UCLA Industrial Hygiene Program
faculty.summary: Dr. Que Hee's work emphasizes glove permeation of chemicals and the development of sampling and analysis methods for workplace chemicals, using advanced analytical techniques such as GC-MS and ICP-MS. His research spans exposure assessment, risk evaluation, and protective equipment performance.

faculty.name: Timothy Malloy
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental Health Sciences; Faculty Director, UCLA Sustainable Technology and Policy Program
faculty.summary: Professor Malloy's work centers on the relationship between regulatory design and implementation and the structure of business organizations. He has written extensively in the area of risk governance and prevention-based regulation of chemicals and emerging technologies.

faculty.name: Miriam Marlier
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.sub_field: Global environmental change and air quality
faculty.summary: Dr. Marlier is an interdisciplinary environmental scientist who examines interactions between environmental change and public health using remote sensing data and modeling techniques. Her work spans fire emissions and air quality in Indonesia and India, climate drivers of western U.S. wildfires, and disaster response.

faculty.name: Yoshira Ornelas Van Horne
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Dr. Ornelas Van Horne's work focuses on addressing unequal exposures to harmful contaminants that affect structurally marginalized populations. Her current projects examine novel air pollution methods, community-based VOC exposure characterization, and the health impacts of federal environmental settlements.

faculty.name: Kirsten Schwarz
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Dr. Schwarz investigates environmental hazards and amenities in cities and how their distribution impacts minoritized communities, with particular focus on soil lead contamination and tree canopy equity. Her recent work emphasizes participatory design approaches to green infrastructure.

faculty.name: Wendie Robbins
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental Health Sciences; Audrienne H. Moseley Endowed Chair, School of Nursing
faculty.summary: Dr. Robbins' research examines relationships between work, environment, and health, including reproductive health impacts and environmentally induced germ cell damage. She combines laboratory and epidemiological studies with clinical nursing experience in pollution-affected communities.

faculty.name: Jian Li
faculty.title: Professor of Work and Health (Environmental Health Sciences and Epidemiology)
faculty.sub_field: Occupational health and work stress epidemiology
faculty.summary: Dr. Li investigates psychosocial factors, work stress, and health, with emphasis on epidemiology and intervention evaluation. His research examines how workplace conditions affect employee wellbeing and disease risk across diverse worker populations.

faculty.name: Oliver Hankinson
faculty.title: Distinguished Research Professor of Pathology & Laboratory Medicine and Environmental Health Sciences; Chair, Environmental and Molecular Toxicology Program
faculty.summary: Dr. Hankinson investigates the mechanisms of carcinogenesis by polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, dioxin, and related compounds, focusing on how the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor mediates their toxic and carcinogenic effects. He chairs the interdepartmental Environmental and Molecular Toxicology program.

faculty.name: André Nel
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental Health Sciences and Medicine
faculty.summary: Dr. Nel studies how air pollutants, particularly ultrafine particles, induce oxidative stress leading to airway inflammation and asthma. His broader work in nanobiology addresses the toxicological effects and safe design of engineered nanomaterials.

faculty.name: Jesus A. Araujo
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Medicine and Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.sub_field: Air pollution toxicology and environmental cardiology
faculty.summary: Dr. Araujo examines the genetic and environmental factors involved in vascular oxidative stress and atherosclerosis, including the cardiovascular effects of air pollutants. His work elucidates mechanisms by which particulate matter exposure promotes ischemic heart disease.

faculty.name: Beate Ritz
faculty.title: Professor of Epidemiology and Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Dr. Ritz studies the effects of occupational and environmental toxins on neurodegenerative disorders, cancer, and adverse birth outcomes, with particular attention to pesticides and air pollution in the etiology of Parkinson's disease. She integrates population data with analysis of genetic susceptibility.

faculty.name: Candace Tsai
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Dr. Tsai investigates exposure to aerosols, nanoparticles, and toxic airborne substances in occupational and environmental settings, combining exposure assessment with toxicological studies. Her work includes computational modeling of aerosol exposure and evaluation of protective equipment.

faculty.name: Wendie Robbins
faculty.title: Professor of Environmental Health Sciences and Nursing
faculty.summary: Dr. Robbins investigates environmentally induced germ cell damage and the development of biomarkers in sperm, examining relationships between work, environment, and reproductive health. Her research combines laboratory and epidemiological approaches in pollution-affected communities.

faculty.name: Feng Gao
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Environmental Health Sciences
faculty.summary: Dr. Gao analyzes the effects of environmental exposures such as metals, pesticides, and PFAS on human health using multi-omics data and novel computational methodologies. His work spans toxicity prediction, exposure modeling, and disease-mechanism analysis.

faculty.name: Patrick Allard
faculty.title: Professor, UCLA Institute for Society and Genetics (and Environmental Health Sciences)
faculty.summary: Dr. Allard uses C. elegans to investigate germ cell maintenance and differentiation and how environmental exposures such as plastics and pesticides affect reproduction and heritable epigenetic changes. His research sits at the intersection of genetics, developmental biology, and environmental health.

faculty.name: Jeff Bronstein
faculty.title: Professor of Neurology; Director of Movement Disorders, David Geffen School of Medicine at UCLA
faculty.summary: Dr. Bronstein directs a laboratory investigating the environmental and genetic causes of Parkinson's disease using cell and zebrafish models alongside population-based studies. His work has linked pesticide and air pollutant exposures to increased Parkinson's disease risk.

faculty.name: Xia Yang
faculty.title: Professor of Integrative Biology and Physiology and Molecular & Medical Pharmacology
faculty.summary: Dr. Yang identifies key regulatory genes and gene networks that mediate genetic and environmental effects on metabolic and other complex diseases. She applies integrative, data-driven systems-biology approaches to uncover mechanisms of environmentally influenced disease.

faculty.name: Srinivasa T. Reddy
faculty.title: Professor In-Residence of Molecular & Medical Pharmacology and Medicine
faculty.sub_field: Lipid mediators, inflammation, and cardiovascular toxicology
faculty.summary: Dr. Reddy studies arachidonic acid and its metabolites and their roles in inflammation and cardiovascular disease. His work connects lipid-mediated signaling to environmentally and metabolically driven disease processes.

faculty.name: David Krantz
faculty.title: Professor In-Residence of Psychiatry and Biobehavioral Sciences, David Geffen School of Medicine at UCLA
faculty.summary: Dr. Krantz uses Drosophila to study how neurotransmitter transporters and pesticide exposures influence synaptic transmission and behavior. His research probes molecular mechanisms of neurotoxicity relevant to environmental exposures.

faculty.name: Steven Swanson
faculty.title: Professor (Department Chair)
faculty.summary: Research in computer architecture and systems, focusing on non-volatile memory technologies, flash storage systems, and hardware-software co-design for emerging memory hierarchies.

faculty.name: Russell Impagliazzo
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leading theoretical computer scientist. Known for foundational work on pseudorandomness, derandomization, and the celebrated five worlds of average-case complexity. Research spans circuit complexity, cryptography, and hardness of approximation.

faculty.name: Mihir Bellare
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Leading cryptographer with foundational contributions to provable security. Known for the random oracle model, BLS signatures, HMAC, and authenticated encryption standards. Multiple test-of-time awards.

faculty.name: Stefan Savage
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Pioneer in empirical security research measuring large-scale cybercrime ecosystems, including spam, phishing, and automotive security. MacArthur Fellow. Research on practical security and measurement.

faculty.name: Hovav Shacham
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computer security and applied cryptography. Known for contributions to memory safety, proof of retrievability, and analysis of blockchain security and decentralized systems.

faculty.name: Ranjit Jhala
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in programming languages and formal methods. Creator of LiquidHaskell and the Liquid Types framework. Focus on automated program verification using refinement types.

faculty.name: Ravi Ramamoorthi
faculty.title: Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Pioneer in computer graphics and computational imaging. Research on realistic rendering, image-based lighting, computational photography, and the mathematics of light transport.

faculty.name: Pavel Pevzner
faculty.title: Professor (Ronald R. Taylor Chair)
faculty.summary: Leading computational biologist. Pioneer in de novo peptide sequencing, genome assembly algorithms, and mass spectrometry analysis. Known for founding the field of computational proteomics.

faculty.name: Julian McAuley
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in machine learning for recommender systems, personalization, and NLP. Creator of widely-used benchmark datasets for product recommendation and sentiment analysis.

faculty.name: Rose Yu
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in machine learning for spatiotemporal data and dynamical systems. Focus on physics-informed deep learning, traffic forecasting, and scientific ML applications.

faculty.name: Kamalika Chaudhuri
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in machine learning theory with focus on privacy-preserving learning, fairness in ML, and robustness. Known for contributions to differentially private learning algorithms.

faculty.name: Hao Su
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in computer vision, 3D deep learning, and embodied AI. Focus on 3D scene understanding, robotic manipulation, and simulation-to-real transfer for robot learning.

faculty.name: Laurel Riek
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in human-robot interaction and healthcare robotics. Director of the Healthcare Robotics Lab, developing robots that assist people with disabilities and healthcare providers.

faculty.name: Shachar Lovett
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in theoretical computer science at the interface of complexity theory, additive combinatorics, and algebraic methods. Contributions to pseudorandomness and arithmetic complexity.

faculty.name: Alex C. Snoeren
faculty.title: Professor (Co-Vice Chair for Academic Personnel)

faculty.name: Yiying Zhang
faculty.title: Associate Professor

faculty.name: Nadia Polikarpova
faculty.title: Professor (Vice Chair for Graduate Education)

faculty.name: Sanjoy Dasgupta
faculty.title: Professor

faculty.name: Dean M. Tullsen
faculty.title: Professor

faculty.name: Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research in natural language processing and machine learning, focusing on unsupervised and semi-supervised methods for text, document layout analysis, and historical document processing.

faculty.summary: Experimental AMO physicist using ultracold atoms in optical lattices to realize and probe topological and strongly correlated quantum states.

faculty.name: Alex Frano
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental condensed matter physicist using x-ray scattering and spectroscopy to study quantum materials, oxide heterostructures, and correlated electron systems.

faculty.name: Daniel Green
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Theoretical cosmologist studying inflation, the physics of the early universe, and cosmological signatures of particle physics.

faculty.name: Aobo Li
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Applies machine learning and AI to rare-event searches in neutrino and dark matter experiments, including neutrinoless double-beta decay (KamLAND-Zen, LEGEND); jointly appointed with the Halicioglu Data Science Institute.

faculty.name: Seungeun Oh
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops label-free optical microscopy tools, including quantitative phase and nonlinear microscopy, to study how single cells regulate their physical properties; jointly appointed with Cellular and Molecular Medicine.

faculty.name: Daniel Parker
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Condensed matter theorist studying quantum many-body dynamics, quantum chaos and operator growth, and the physics of moire and correlated materials.

faculty.name: Tzer Han Tan
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Experimental biophysicist studying active matter, self-organization, and morphogenesis in living and reconstituted systems.

faculty.name: Hongbo Zhao
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Studies the physics of living and soft matter using theory and computation, including biomolecular condensates, phase separation, and active matter; jointly appointed with Chemistry and Biochemistry.
