faculty.name: Ilona Jaspers
faculty.title: Professor of Pediatrics, Microbiology and Immunology; Director, Curriculum in Toxicology and Environmental Medicine
faculty.summary: Director of the Toxicology program. Research focuses on how inhaled environmental agents, particularly air pollutants, alter respiratory immune responses and enhance susceptibility to respiratory virus infections. Studies mechanisms at the respiratory mucosal barrier.

faculty.name: Kim L.R. Brouwer
faculty.title: Professor, UNC Eshelman School of Pharmacy
faculty.summary: Renowned expert in hepatobiliary drug disposition and hepatotoxicity. Research investigates the mechanisms governing hepatic drug transport, metabolism, and toxicity, with application to predicting and preventing drug-induced liver injury.

faculty.name: Rebecca Fry
faculty.title: Carol Remmer Angle Distinguished Professor, Department of Environmental Sciences and Engineering
faculty.summary: Uses toxicogenomic and systems biology approaches to understand molecular mechanisms of metal-induced disease and inter-individual susceptibility to environmental exposures, with focus on developmental origins of health and disease.

faculty.name: Julia Rager
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Department of Environmental Sciences and Engineering
faculty.summary: Integrates computational toxicology, bioinformatics, and high-throughput exposure science to evaluate health effects of environmental chemical mixtures. Develops data-driven frameworks to modernize chemical risk assessment.

faculty.name: Leena Nylander-French
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Environmental Sciences and Engineering
faculty.summary: Research focuses on dermal and inhalation exposure assessment, the role of genetic polymorphisms in detoxification pathways on individual susceptibility, and the development of biomarkers for occupational and environmental exposures.

faculty.name: Paul Watkins
faculty.title: Professor, Departments of Medicine and Environmental Sciences and Engineering
faculty.summary: Internationally recognized expert in drug-induced liver injury (DILI) and mechanistic toxicology. Research bridges preclinical models and clinical translation, developing safety biomarkers and novel approaches to predict and understand hepatotoxicity in patients.

faculty.name: Samir Kelada
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Genetics
faculty.summary: Studies gene-environment interactions in airway diseases such as asthma, using mouse genetic models to identify genes that modify susceptibility to environmental exposures including air pollutants and allergens.

faculty.name: Meghan Rebuli
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, Department of Pediatrics
faculty.summary: Research on respiratory immune toxicology with emphasis on sex-based differences in response to inhaled environmental exposures. Conducts translational and clinical studies characterizing airway responses to pollutants.

faculty.name: Mark Zylka
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Cell Biology and Physiology; Director, UNC Neuroscience Center
faculty.summary: Research on environmental risk factors in neurodevelopmental disorders including autism, using mouse models to identify chemicals that disrupt brain development. Also develops CRISPR-based gene therapies and studies chronic pain mechanisms.

faculty.name: Matthew Redinbo
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Chemistry
faculty.summary: Uses structural and chemical biology to understand human and microbial enzymes involved in drug metabolism and toxicity. Discovers interventions targeting the microbiome to prevent drug toxicity and improve therapeutic outcomes.

faculty.name: Alexander Tropsha
faculty.title: Professor, UNC Eshelman School of Pharmacy
faculty.summary: Research in biomolecular informatics and computational toxicology, developing quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) models and machine learning approaches to predict chemical toxicity and drug safety.

faculty.name: Bernard Weissman
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine
faculty.summary: Studies chromatin remodeling and epigenetic alterations in human cancers, investigating how environmental exposures contribute to epigenetic changes that drive carcinogenesis. Research focuses on tumor suppressor gene regulation.

faculty.name: Cyrus Vaziri
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine
faculty.summary: Research defines DNA repair dependencies and vulnerabilities of cancer cells, investigating mechanisms of DNA damage tolerance and bypass that are relevant to both environmental carcinogenesis and cancer therapeutic resistance.

faculty.name: Folami Ideraabdullah
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Department of Genetics and Nutrition
faculty.summary: Studies the interplay of genetics, nutrition, and environmental factors in developmental programming, investigating how maternal exposures and diet influence offspring health through epigenetic mechanisms.

funding.note: Full-tuition scholarship + stipend typical ($39k-44k for 2026-27 per Grad School)

funding.note: Full-tuition scholarship + stipend typical ($39k-44k for 2026-27 per Grad School)

faculty.name: Martina Bukač
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops numerical methods for fluid-structure interaction problems, particularly modeling blood flow and vessel dynamics to understand cardiovascular disease. Works at the intersection of numerical analysis, computational mathematics, and biomechanics.

faculty.name: Stefano Castruccio
faculty.title: Notre Dame Collegiate Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops spatio-temporal statistical models and physics-informed machine learning methods for environmental and climate applications, including renewable energy assessment and air pollution mortality. Fellow of ASA and elected member of ISI. Recipient of 2024 Gordon Bell Prize.

faculty.name: Guosheng Fu
faculty.title: Robert and Sara Lumpkins Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops high-order numerical methods including hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) methods for computational fluid dynamics, computational mechanics, and optimal transport problems. Contributes to open-source finite element libraries NGSolve and MFEM.

faculty.name: Kelsey Gasior
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops biologically grounded multiscale models using ODEs, PDEs, and phase field methods to study intracellular phase separation and epithelial mesenchymal transition, bridging applied mathematics and cell biology.

faculty.name: Yuefeng Han
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for complex high-dimensional data structures including tensors and matrices, along with stochastic optimization techniques and robust approaches to time series analysis and classification problems.

faculty.name: Jonathan Hauenstein
faculty.title: Robert and Sara Lumpkins Collegiate Professor and Department Chair
faculty.summary: Develops numerical methods for solving systems of nonlinear equations, implemented in the Bertini software package and applied across science and engineering. Fellow of the American Mathematical Society, Sloan Research Fellow.

faculty.name: Bei Hu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Partial Differential Equations and Mathematical Biology
faculty.summary: Studies free boundary problems in mathematical biology modeled by PDEs, with rigorous analysis of qualitative system behavior using elliptic/parabolic estimates, bifurcation analysis, and numerical simulations. Past work spans thermal runaway, mathematical finance, and optimal control.

faculty.name: Soham Jana
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops methods in statistical machine learning including robust clustering for mixture models, high-dimensional and nonparametric statistics, empirical Bayes estimation, and causal inference. PhD from Yale (2022), postdoc at Princeton before joining Notre Dame in 2024.

faculty.name: Jun Li
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and computational methods and algorithms for big datasets that challenge traditional statistical approaches. PhD from Stanford under Robert Tibshirani, focusing on methodology at the intersection of statistics and computation.

faculty.name: Alan Lindsay
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Uses computational and analytical techniques to study PDEs emerging from physical and biological systems, with applications in Micro Electro Mechanical Systems, mathematical ecology, and imaging/inverse problems.

faculty.name: Fang Liu
faculty.title: Notre Dame Collegiate Professor and Associate Chair
faculty.sub_field: Data Privacy and Statistical Machine Learning
faculty.summary: Develops modern approaches for data privacy protection including differential privacy, alongside research in statistical machine learning, Bayesian methods, and missing data analysis. Fellow of ASA and elected member of ISI.

faculty.name: Ondrej Maxian
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Builds computational models to study how cells tune their internal components for essential tasks like migration, division, and polarization, with emphasis on efficient numerical methods for simulating actin filaments and accessory proteins.

faculty.name: Robert Rosenbaum
faculty.title: Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
faculty.summary: Develops computational and mathematical models of neural circuits in the brain, studying excitatory-inhibitory balance in cortical circuits. Recent work explores the interface of neuroscience and AI.

faculty.name: Daniele Schiavazzi
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Works on stochastic analysis, multi-resolution approximation, numerical modeling, and finite element analysis, with applications to adaptive MCMC estimation and computational models for clinical decision-making under uncertainty.

faculty.name: Tiffany Tang
faculty.title: Clare Boothe Luce Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Creates interpretable statistical machine learning methods to extract actionable insights from real-world medical data, with focus on transparent AI in healthcare. Builds open-source tools to promote dependable data science practices. PhD from UC Berkeley (2023).

faculty.name: Charles Wampler
faculty.title: Huisking Foundation, Inc. Collegiate Research Professor
faculty.summary: Pioneer in numerical algebraic geometry, developing algorithms for solving systems of nonlinear equations. Co-author of the seminal paper in the field. Applied work spans robotics for automotive manufacturing, EV battery modeling, and NASA's Robonaut 2. Member of National Academy of Engineering.

faculty.name: Zhiliang Xu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops high-order accurate numerical schemes for PDEs arising in classical fluid dynamics and complex fluids problems, with applications in computational physics and biology.

faculty.name: Xiufan Yu
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops methods for high-dimensional statistical inference including power-enhanced hypothesis testing, causal discovery, and factor models, with applications in genomics. Elected member of the International Statistical Institute. PhD from Penn State (2021).

faculty.name: Zecheng Zhang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Works on mathematical analysis and computational applications of operator learning for scientific problems including PDE solving and model reduction, with focus on foundation models for science. Research funded by DOE AI for Science.

faculty.name: Yongtao Zhang
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops high-order accuracy numerical methods including WENO schemes, fast sweeping methods, and discontinuous Galerkin finite element methods for PDEs, with applications in morphogenesis, tissue patterning, and shock wave interactions.

faculty.name: Changbo Zhu
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methodology for complex non-Euclidean data including functional data analysis, distributional data analysis, and inference on metric spaces. Published in Biometrika and JRSSB on testing independence for sparse functional data and geodesic optimal transport regression.

faculty.name: Brian Baker
faculty.title: Coleman Professor of Life Sciences
faculty.summary: Notre Dame biophysics faculty whose research spans computational modeling and molecular imaging and structure.

faculty.title: Professor, former Chair

faculty.summary: Research in control theory and hybrid systems with applications to autonomous vehicles, distributed robotics, and cyber-physical systems. IEEE Fellow, IFAC Fellow.

faculty.name: Rahul Mangharam
faculty.title: Professor, ESE & CIS
faculty.sub_field: Safe autonomous systems, formal methods, machine learning, controls
faculty.summary: Research at the intersection of formal methods, machine learning, and controls for safety-critical autonomous vehicles, medical devices, and urban air mobility. PECASE award (2016), NSF CAREER.

faculty.name: Alejandro Ribeiro
faculty.title: Professor

faculty.summary: Research in networks and artificial intelligence, including distributed optimization for multi-agent systems, graph neural networks, and machine learning over network data.

faculty.name: Hamed Hassani
faculty.title: Associate Professor, ESE & CIS
faculty.summary: Research in machine learning and optimization, focusing on federated learning, distributed optimization, and theory of deep learning with statistical guarantees.

faculty.name: Daniel Lee
faculty.title: Professor, ESE & CIS
faculty.summary: Research in robotics and machine learning, developing algorithms for autonomous robot locomotion, manipulation, and perception using deep reinforcement learning.

faculty.name: Nikolai Matni
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, ESE & CIS
faculty.summary: Research at the intersection of control theory and machine learning, developing robust and safe learning-based control methods for autonomous and cyber-physical systems. NSF CAREER.

programs.program_name: Applied Mathematics and Computational Science, PhD

faculty.name: David L. Goldsby
faculty.title: Professor & Department Chair
faculty.summary: Investigates mineral and rock physics with emphasis on the rheological behavior of Earth and planetary materials, using experiments on grain size-sensitive flow and grain boundary sliding in materials such as olivine and ice. His work illuminates how creep behaviors control rheology in glaciers, icy satellites, and planetary interiors.

faculty.name: Joseph S. Francisco
faculty.title: President's Distinguished Professor
faculty.summary: Applies experimental physical and theoretical chemistry to atmospheric chemistry problems at the molecular level, including new chemistries on cloud surface interfaces, effects of solar radiation on interfacial reactions, and chemistry related to acid rain.

faculty.name: Reto Gieré
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Examines Earth materials, their response to geological forces, and their interaction with the environment and humans, spanning environmental geochemistry, mineralogy, petrology, and the health impacts of atmospheric pollution with a focus on energy, waste, and sustainability.

faculty.name: Jon Hawkings
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Biogeochemist investigating the role of glacial meltwater in downstream biogeochemical cycles, focusing on how meltwater influences ecosystem productivity and nutrient mobilization in freshwater and coastal environments, with fieldwork in Arctic, Patagonian, and Himalayan regions.

faculty.name: Douglas J. Jerolmack
faculty.title: Edmund J. and Louise W. Kahn Endowed Term Professor of Earth and Environmental Science; Professor of Mechanical Engineering and Applied Mechanics
faculty.summary: Conducts experimental geophysics research on the spatial and temporal evolution of patterns that emerge at the interface of fluid and sediment on Earth and planetary surfaces, integrating laboratory experiments, field studies, and theoretical modeling of granular physics and landform dynamics.

faculty.name: Michael Mann
faculty.title: Presidential Distinguished Professor; Director of Penn Center for Science, Sustainability and the Media
faculty.summary: Works on understanding climate science and climate change, with particular focus on climate variability and extremes, paleoclimate, tropical cyclones, and climate education and policy.

faculty.name: Irina Marinov
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies Southern Ocean dynamics and how the ocean regulates atmospheric carbon dioxide and global climate, modeling and observing ocean nutrients, carbon cycles, and phytoplankton, including feedbacks between climate change, the ocean carbon cycle, and ocean ecology.

faculty.name: Ileana Pérez-Rodríguez
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Studies geomicrobiology, ecophysiology, bioenergetics, and metabolic ecology to understand microbial processes and their biogeochemical impacts on environmental systems and Earth's history.

faculty.name: Alain F. Plante
faculty.title: Professor & Faculty Director, University Scholars Program
faculty.summary: Studies terrestrial carbon biogeochemistry, focusing on the mechanisms and processes that act to stabilize and de-stabilize organic carbon in surface soils and their connection to the global carbon cycle.

faculty.name: Leigh Stearns
faculty.title: Professor, Graduate Chair
faculty.summary: Investigates how a changing climate impacts the cryosphere and the risks associated with those changes, examining ice sheet dynamics, sea level rise, and Arctic sea ice using satellite remote sensing, machine learning, and geophysical instrumentation.

faculty.name: Hugo N. Ulloa
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Fluid dynamicist studying geophysical and environmental flows, particularly transport and mixing processes in natural waters such as lakes and coastal seas, using theory, numerical modeling, and experimental observations.

faculty.name: Einara Zahn
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates how turbulent processes at the Earth's surface interact with the atmosphere across scales through theory, simulations, and field observations, with focus on land-atmosphere interactions in natural and urban environments.

programs.program_name: Biochemistry, Biophysics and Chemical Biology, PhD

requirements.admission_model: Umbrella graduate group (BGS), independent of departments

faculty.name: Kim A. Sharp
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics (Chair, BBCB Graduate Group)
faculty.summary: Uses computational approaches including electrostatics modeling, molecular dynamics, and Monte Carlo methods to study how proteins recognize and bind other proteins, drugs, ligands, and nucleic acids, with current work on protein-ligand binding calculations and viral genome packaging.

faculty.name: Nikolaos Sgourakis
faculty.title: Associate Professor (Vice-Chair, BBCB Graduate Group)
faculty.summary: Investigates mechanistic molecular immunology at atomic resolution using NMR spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography combined with computation, addressing peptide antigen presentation, CAR-T cell targeting, and T cell receptor activation.

faculty.name: Ronen Marmorstein
faculty.title: George W. Raiziss Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.sub_field: Structural biology of chromatin and metabolism
faculty.summary: Studies protein post- and co-translational acetylation, acetyl-CoA metabolism, epigenetic regulation, and MAPK signaling using X-ray crystallography and cryo-EM, and develops small-molecule inhibitors targeting these mechanisms in cancer and neurodegeneration.

faculty.name: Ben E. Black
faculty.title: Eldridge Reeves Johnson Foundation Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Uses biophysical, biochemical, genetic, and cell biological approaches to understand how protein complexes epigenetically mark centromeres and direct accurate chromosome segregation, with recent work on PARP-1 enzyme mechanisms for targeted therapies.

faculty.name: Gregory D. Van Duyne
faculty.title: Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Investigates how DNA and RNA are maintained and processed by cells, including replication, transcription, DNA repair, and recombination, using X-ray diffraction to build three-dimensional models and test mechanistic hypotheses.

faculty.name: Roberto Dominguez
faculty.title: William Maul Measey Presidential Professor of Physiology
faculty.summary: A structural biologist studying how actin filaments are assembled and disassembled using cryo-EM, X-ray crystallography, biochemical reconstitution, and biophysics, with focus on filament dynamics, branched networks formed by Arp2/3, and thin-filament regulation in muscle.

faculty.name: E. Michael Ostap
faculty.title: Professor of Physiology (Director, Pennsylvania Muscle Institute)
faculty.summary: Studies cytoskeletal motor proteins such as myosin, dynein, and kinesin using biochemistry, single-molecule biophysics, and microscopy to understand how these machines convert chemical energy into mechanical force during muscle contraction and cell migration.

faculty.name: Kenji Murakami
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Uses cryo-electron microscopy and cross-linking mass spectrometry with biochemistry to study the mechanisms of RNA polymerase II transitions between initiation, elongation, and re-initiation, and how transcription is regulated within chromatin.

faculty.name: Vera Moiseenkova-Bell
faculty.title: Professor of Systems Pharmacology and Translational Therapeutics
faculty.summary: Specializes in structural biology and pharmacology of ion channels, particularly TRP channels, using cryo-electron microscopy combined with functional studies and structure-based discovery to understand channel mechanisms and develop therapeutic inhibitors.

faculty.name: Kushol Gupta
faculty.title: Research Associate Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Applies X-ray crystallography and solution-based biophysics including small-angle X-ray and neutron scattering to study enzymes underlying metabolic disorders, retroviral integrases and HIV drug development, and biophysical characterization of mRNA lipid nanoparticles.

faculty.name: Kathy Fange Liu
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Investigates how enzymes regulate gene expression differently in normal physiology versus cancer, studying cancer fusion proteins, ribosome function, and enzyme-mediated RNA modifications to expose cancer vulnerabilities.

faculty.name: James Shorter
faculty.title: Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Studies how the proteostasis network prevents, reverses, or promotes formation of misfolded conformers including prions, amyloids, and toxic oligomers, focusing on protein disaggregases such as Hsp104 and molecular chaperones relevant to Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS.

faculty.name: Rahul M. Kohli
faculty.title: Professor of Medicine (Infectious Diseases) and Biochemistry & Biophysics
faculty.summary: Studies DNA-modifying enzymes and their role in genomic complexity, focusing on enzymatic deamination, oxidation, and methylation of cytosine and bacterial pathways to antibiotic resistance, using biochemistry, chemical synthesis, and biological assays.

faculty.name: Jeffery G. Saven
faculty.title: Professor of Chemistry
faculty.summary: Uses theory and computation to study biomolecules, polymers, and condensed-phase systems, with emphasis on developing computational approaches for understanding and designing proteins and biomolecular materials in collaboration with experimental teams.

faculty.name: Greg Bowman
faculty.title: Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Combines biophysical experiments, machine learning, and large-scale physics-based simulations to map protein structural ensembles and dynamics, aiming to develop therapeutics and interpret genetic variation in diseases such as Alzheimer's and COVID-19.

faculty.name: Yi-Wei Chang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Uses cryo-electron tomography to visualize macromolecular machines directly within intact cells and tissues, studying how molecular structure and organization drive biological function across viral assembly, bacterial machines, and host-pathogen interactions.

faculty.name: Blanton Tolbert
faculty.title: Professor of Biochemistry and Biophysics
faculty.summary: Uses biophysical approaches to understand virus-host interactions, examining structural mechanisms of viral entry, replication, and immune evasion to develop antiviral strategies and therapeutic interventions.

faculty.name: Tobias Baumgart
faculty.title: Professor of Chemistry
faculty.summary: Studies the biophysics of biological membranes, focusing on curvature sensing and curvature-generating peripheral membrane proteins such as amphiphysin and endophilin and how protein partitioning between coexisting membrane phases governs signal transduction.

faculty.name: E. James Petersson
faculty.title: Professor of Chemistry
faculty.summary: Studies protein post-translational modifications and the enzymes that install them, and develops synthetic protein modification tools including backbone thioamide probes and fluorescent unnatural amino acids for protein folding studies and imaging.

faculty.name: Elizabeth Rhoades
faculty.title: Professor of Chemistry
faculty.summary: Uses single-molecule fluorescence and other biophysical techniques to study intrinsically disordered and amyloidogenic proteins such as tau and alpha-synuclein, elucidating how conformational plasticity links to structure-function relationships in neurodegenerative disease.

faculty.name: David Chenoweth
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Chemistry
faculty.summary: Grounds research in organic chemistry and molecular recognition to build small-molecule and peptide chemical tools for probing biological systems with spatial and temporal control, including collagen mimetic peptides to interrogate the collagen interactome.

faculty.name: George Burslem
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Cancer Biology and Biochemistry & Biophysics
faculty.summary: Focuses on the chemical biology of lysine post-translational modifications, developing chemical approaches to manipulate protein function and pursuing intracellular protein-editing technologies.

requirements.admission_model: Umbrella graduate group (BGS) with six specialty programs

faculty.name: Jeffrey S. Morris
faculty.title: Professor and Director of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops hybrid ML-AI/statistical tools for extracting knowledge from large-scale biomedical data, including flexible regression methods for complex biomedical objects (functions, images, manifolds) and multi-platform data integration. Extensive applied work in cancer molecular subtyping. ASA Fellow, IMS Fellow.

faculty.name: Russell T. Shinohara
faculty.title: Professor and Deputy Director of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops quantitative biomedical imaging methods to evaluate structural and functional brain changes across the lifespan and in neurological, psychiatric, and developmental disorders.

faculty.name: Hongzhe Li
faculty.title: Perelman Professor of Biostatistics, Epidemiology and Informatics; Vice Chair of Research Integration
faculty.sub_field: Statistical Genomics and Big Data in Health
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and computational methods for high-throughput genomic data including GWAS, genetic pathway analysis, and microbiome/metagenomics. Directs the Center of Statistics in Big Data. Actively recruits PhD students.

faculty.name: Nandita Mitra
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops doubly robust methods for cost-effectiveness estimation and instrumental variable approaches for censored outcomes. Co-Director of the Center for Causal Inference. Editor-in-Chief of Observational Studies. ASA Fellow.

faculty.name: Jinbo Chen
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.sub_field: Electronic Health Records and Risk Prediction
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for risk prediction using electronic health record data, addressing phenotyping inaccuracies, algorithm fairness, and performance monitoring. Director of the Statistical Center for Translational Research in Medicine. Associate Director of Penn Medicine Biobank.

faculty.name: Yong Chen
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops methods for evidence synthesis from multiple data sources including meta-analysis and distributed algorithms for comparative effectiveness research. Founder and Director of the Center for Health AI and Synthesis of Evidence (CHASE). ASA Fellow. Over 200 peer-reviewed publications.

faculty.name: Warren B. Bilker
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops methodological approaches for pharmacoepidemiology and survival analysis, with extensive applied work in schizophrenia research linking brain imaging to clinical course. Leads the biostatistics core of Penn's Schizophrenia Center.

faculty.name: Douglas E. Schaubel
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops survival analysis methods for evaluating time-dependent treatments, with applications in end-stage renal and liver disease and organ transplantation. ASA Fellow. Associate editor at Biometrics and Statistics in Medicine.

faculty.name: Qi Long
faculty.title: Professor and Vice Chair of Faculty Professional Development
faculty.summary: Develops robust statistical and machine learning methods for complex multimodal health data (omics, EHR, imaging, mHealth). Leads coordinating centers for NCI and NHLBI multi-site clinical studies. Elected fellow of AAAS, AIMBE, ASA, IMS, ISI, and AMIA.

faculty.name: Mingyao Li
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and computational methods for single-cell transcriptomics to study cellular heterogeneity in human tissues, with applications in Alzheimer's, heart disease, and gene therapy. Director of Biostatistics for Penn's Gene Therapy Program.

faculty.name: Brielin Chase Brown
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and computational methods for genetic and genomic data analysis.

faculty.name: Iain Mathieson
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Uses statistical and computational methods to study human evolution, population history, and natural selection through analysis of ancient and modern DNA.

faculty.name: Knashawn H. Morales
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.sub_field: Clinical Trials and Mental Health Statistics
faculty.summary: Develops and applies biostatistical methods for behavioral intervention studies and mental health research, with focus on longitudinal data analysis and clinical trial design.

faculty.name: Mary E. Putt
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops biostatistical methods for clinical studies, diagnostic testing evaluation, and survival analysis with biomedical applications.

faculty.name: Sharon Xiangwen Xie
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for survival analysis and longitudinal data with applications in Alzheimer's disease and neurodegenerative disorders.

faculty.name: Yimei Li
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.sub_field: Clinical Trial Design and Pediatric Oncology
faculty.summary: Develops innovative clinical trial designs including Bayesian adaptive methods, with applications in pediatric oncology and cancer research.

faculty.name: Wei-Ting Hwang
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops and applies biostatistical methods in cancer clinical research, including imaging biomarker evaluation and clinical trial methodology.

faculty.name: Justine Shults
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.sub_field: Longitudinal Data and Correlated Data Analysis
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for longitudinal and correlated data analysis, including generalized estimating equation approaches, with clinical and epidemiological applications.

faculty.name: Kai Tan
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops computational and systems biology approaches to study gene regulatory networks and cellular systems, with applications in cancer biology.

faculty.name: Yun Li
faculty.title: Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and computational methods for genetic and genomic studies, focusing on genome-wide association studies and functional genomics.

faculty.name: Dokyoon Kim
faculty.title: Assistant Professor of Biostatistics
faculty.sub_field: Genomic Data Science and Precision Medicine
faculty.summary: Develops computational and data science methods for integrating genomic data to advance precision medicine.

requirements.admission_model: Department admits via Wharton Doctoral Programs

funding.note: Full fellowship covering tuition plus living stipend for all doctoral students

faculty.name: Bhaswar B. Bhattacharya
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical theory and methods at the intersection of nonparametric statistics, distribution-free inference, and network analysis. Works on subgraph counting, two-sample tests for random graphs, optimal transport-based inference, and discrete geometry. PhD from Stanford (2016).

faculty.name: Enric Boix
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Theory of AI and Deep Learning
faculty.summary: Studies theoretical foundations of AI including model distillation, reasoning models, steering and monitoring, training dynamics, and adversarial examples. Published work on universal steering of AI models (Science 2026) and the features at convergence theorem for neural networks.

faculty.name: Tony Cai
faculty.title: Daniel H. Silberberg Professor
faculty.sub_field: High-Dimensional Statistics and Statistical Machine Learning
faculty.summary: Develops fundamental statistical theory and methodology for high-dimensional problems, including heteroskedastic PCA, sparse inference, distributed estimation, and multiple testing. Recipient of COPSS Presidents' Award (2008). Former IMS President (2023-2025).

faculty.name: Sky Cao
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Works on probability theory, stochastic geometric analysis, Yang-Mills theory, and Markov chain Monte Carlo methods, bridging pure mathematical probability with statistical computation.

faculty.name: Yuxin Chen
faculty.title: Gilbert Helman Professor
faculty.sub_field: Statistical Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning
faculty.summary: Develops theoretical foundations for reinforcement learning (offline RL, multi-agent RL), nonconvex optimization, and high-dimensional statistics. Focuses on statistical optimality and sample complexity. PhD from Stanford EE (2015), postdoc with Emmanuel Candès.

faculty.name: Damek Davis
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Optimization for Statistics and Data Science
faculty.summary: Develops optimization algorithms for modern data science with emphasis on nonsmooth optimization, stochastic approximation, and convergence guarantees. Works on variance reduction, mixture model clustering, and computational microscopy.

faculty.name: Edgar Dobriban
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Works on uncertainty quantification (conformal prediction, calibration), AI safety and robustness (jailbreaking, watermarking LLMs), high-dimensional asymptotic statistics, and fairness in ML. PhD from Stanford (2017), T.W. Anderson Dissertation Award.

faculty.name: Giles Hooker
faculty.title: Harry J. Loman Professor and Department Chair
faculty.sub_field: Machine Learning and Functional Data Analysis
faculty.summary: Develops methods for interpretable machine learning, functional data analysis, and statistical ecology. Studies stability and explainability of ML models, with applications in ecology and population dynamics.

faculty.name: Jiaoyang Huang
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Random Matrix Theory and High-Dimensional Probability
faculty.summary: Works on random matrix theory, random graphs, interacting particle systems, and their connections to deep learning optimization and Bayesian posterior sampling. Sloan Research Fellow (2024), NSF CAREER Award (2024).

faculty.name: Shane T. Jensen
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops Bayesian multilevel models for spatial statistics and urban analytics, studying how urban greening affects crime and property. Also works on sports analytics including hockey and baseball player evaluation. Savage Award recipient (2005).

faculty.name: Ying Jin
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops distribution-free inference methods including conformal prediction, with extensions to graph neural networks and foundation models. Works on policy learning, causal effect generalization, and selective inference. Ingram Olkin Award (Stanford, 2024).

faculty.name: Eugene Katsevich
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for high-dimensional variable selection, multiple testing with FDR control, and knockoff-based inference, with applications to genetics and genomics. PhD from Stanford (2019).

faculty.name: Mark G. Low
faculty.title: Walter C. Bladstrom Professor
faculty.summary: Works on statistical decision theory, nonparametric function estimation, and statistical inference, with focus on minimax optimality, adaptive estimation, and confidence bands under shape constraints. IMS Fellow (2004).

faculty.name: Zhimei Ren
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Distribution-Free Inference and Data-Driven Decision Making
faculty.summary: Develops distribution-free inference methods with provable guarantees for prediction, causal inference, and data-driven decision making. Works on conformalized survival analysis and adaptive discovery. PhD from Stanford (2021) under Emmanuel Candès.

faculty.name: Dylan S. Small
faculty.title: Universal Furniture Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for causal inference from observational studies, including sensitivity analysis, matched studies, and instrumental variable models. Applied collaborations in Alzheimer's disease, anesthesia, and public health. IMS Medallion Lecturer (2022).

faculty.name: Weijie Su
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops methods in differential privacy (Gaussian DP), high-dimensional statistics (SLOPE), optimization for deep learning, and large-scale multiple testing. Recipient of COPSS Presidents' Award (2026), Sloan Research Fellowship (2020). PhD from Stanford (2016).

faculty.name: Eric J. Tchetgen Tchetgen
faculty.title: University Professor
faculty.summary: Develops semiparametric efficiency theory with applications to causal inference, missing data problems, and statistical genetics. Recipient of the Rousseeuw Prize for Statistics (2022) and David Cox Medal (2025).

faculty.name: Yuting Wei
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Statistical Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning
faculty.summary: Develops statistical foundations for reinforcement learning (policy evaluation, multi-agent RL) and high-dimensional statistics (Lasso, AMP). NSF CAREER Award (2022), ASA Gottfried E. Noether Award (2025). PhD from UC Berkeley (2018) under Martin Wainwright.

faculty.name: Abraham J. Wyner
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Works on theoretical foundations of machine learning including why boosting and random forests work, information theory, and entropy. Directs Wharton Sports Analytics and Business Initiative. PhD from Stanford.

faculty.name: Nancy R. Zhang
faculty.title: Ge Li and Ning Zhao Professor and Vice Dean of Wharton Doctoral Programs
faculty.summary: Develops statistical models and computational algorithms for high-throughput genomic data including single-cell and spatial genomics, DNA copy number estimation, and intra-tumor heterogeneity analysis. Sloan Fellow (2011), David Cox Medal (2025). PhD from Stanford (2005).

faculty.name: Anderson Ye Zhang
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for group synchronization, spectral analysis, ranking from pairwise comparisons, clustering, stochastic block models, and network analysis. Sloan Research Fellowship in Mathematics (2025), NSF CAREER (2025).

faculty.name: Linda Zhao
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Statistical Machine Learning and Data-Driven Decision Making
faculty.summary: Works on statistical machine learning including personalized RL, contextual bandits, post-selection inference, and network analysis of firm ownership. Research spans data-driven decision making, crowdsourcing, and nonparametric methods. PhD from Cornell.

faculty.name: Bingxin Zhao
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for large-scale genomic and biomedical data, studying brain-body connections using UK Biobank data, including genetic prediction, neuroimaging genetics, and heart-brain interactions. IMS Tweedie New Researcher Award (2025).

faculty.name: Gerard Cachon
faculty.title: Fred R. Sullivan Professor
faculty.sub_field: Operations management, supply chain management, retail operations
faculty.summary: Research in operations management with focus on supply chain coordination, retail operations, and platform economics. Author of leading OM textbook.

faculty.name: Christian Terwiesch
faculty.title: Andrew M. Heller Professor, Department Chair
faculty.sub_field: Innovation management, healthcare operations, service operations
faculty.summary: Research in innovation management, healthcare operations, and matching markets. Studies R&D processes, technology commercialization, and healthcare delivery improvement.

faculty.name: Serguei Netessine
faculty.title: Professor of Innovation and Entrepreneurship
faculty.sub_field: Business model innovation, supply chain, platform operations
faculty.summary: Research in business model innovation and operational strategy, studying platform economics, supply chain finance, and data-driven operations innovation.

faculty.name: Gad Allon
faculty.title: Jeffrey A. Keswin Professor
faculty.sub_field: Service operations, platform operations, sharing economy
faculty.summary: Research in service and platform operations, studying on-demand services, sharing economy models, and data-driven operational strategies for tech companies.

faculty.name: Noah Gans
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Service operations, call centers, queueing systems
faculty.summary: Research in service operations management, focusing on queueing systems, call center operations, and workforce scheduling in service industries.

faculty.name: Santiago Gallino
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Retail operations, omnichannel, supply chain management
faculty.summary: Research in retail operations and supply chain management, studying omnichannel strategies, inventory management, and the operational implications of new technologies.

faculty.name: Xuanming Su
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in operations management with behavioral considerations, studying how human behavior affects operational decisions in pricing, inventory, and supply chains.

faculty.name: Lorin M. Hitt
faculty.title: Zhang Jindong Professor
faculty.sub_field: Information systems, IT productivity, digital transformation
faculty.summary: Research in information systems and the business value of IT, studying how information technology affects productivity, organizational structure, and business strategy.

faculty.name: Prasanna (Sonny) Tambe
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Digital labor markets, AI economics, technology strategy
faculty.summary: Research in technology strategy and the economics of IT, studying how AI and digital technologies transform labor markets, firm strategy, and workforce composition.

faculty.name: Maurice Schweitzer
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in negotiation, decision making, and behavioral ethics, studying how emotions, trust, and deception influence interpersonal and organizational decisions.

faculty.name: Katherine L. Milkman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Behavioral economics, decision making, behavior change
faculty.summary: Research in behavioral economics and decision making, studying what drives behavior change and how to design interventions that improve health, financial, and educational outcomes.

faculty.name: Senthil Veeraraghavan
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research in operations management, studying service systems, healthcare operations, and supply chain design with emphasis on information and incentives.

faculty.name: Sergei Savin
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.sub_field: Healthcare operations, service operations, capacity management
faculty.summary: Research in healthcare and service operations, focusing on capacity management, appointment scheduling, and resource allocation in health delivery organizations.

faculty.name: Hamsa Bastani
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Machine learning, causal inference, healthcare operations
faculty.summary: Research in machine learning and causal inference for healthcare operations, developing methods that combine prediction with prescription in high-stakes medical settings.

faculty.name: Hummy Song
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Healthcare operations, empirical operations, technology adoption
faculty.summary: Research in healthcare operations management, using empirical methods to study how technology and process changes affect healthcare delivery and patient outcomes.

faculty.name: Rachel Glade

faculty.name: Lee Murray

faculty.name: Miki Nakajima

faculty.name: Vasilii Petrenko

faculty.name: Kevin Righter

faculty.name: Dustin Trail

faculty.name: Thomas Weber
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
faculty.summary: Studies ocean biogeochemical cycles and trace element oceanography, including how marine ecosystems respond to climate change.

faculty.name: Robert Strawderman
faculty.title: Professor and Department Chair
faculty.summary: Research focuses on survival analysis, semiparametric methods for missing and censored data, statistical learning for risk and outcome prediction in medicine/epidemiology/public health, dynamic treatment regimes, causal inference, and statistical computing. ASA Fellow and IMS Fellow.

faculty.name: Sally Thurston
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on Bayesian inference, modeling multiple outcomes, correction for measurement error bias, informative prior specification, latent variable models, hierarchical models, and models for multiple correlated exposures with environmental health applications. ASA Fellow.

faculty.name: Abdus Wahed
faculty.title: Professor and Associate Chair
faculty.summary: Research focuses on personalized medicine, statistical methods for dynamic treatment regimes from sequential multiple assignment randomized trials (SMARTs), multivariate ordinal longitudinal data, survival analysis, causal inference, and semiparametric inference. ASA Fellow.

faculty.name: Michael McDermott
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on order-restricted inference, methods to analyze dose-response, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves and surfaces, methods for combining p-values, meta-analysis, missing data problems, and clinical trials methodology with applications in neurological disease. ASA Fellow.

faculty.name: Changyong Feng
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on multivariate survival analysis, empirical processes theory, longitudinal data analysis, and statistical methods in epidemiology and clinical trials.

faculty.name: Brent Johnson
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on semi-parametric and nonparametric methods for missing data problems, causal inference, survival and longitudinal data, and dynamic treatment regimes with applications to HIV/AIDS, infusion trials, neurological and behavioral disorders.

faculty.name: Derick Peterson
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on prognostic gene expression profiles from high-dimensional transcriptomic data, model selection, nonparametric estimation and inference, data-driven smoothing, censored survival data with applications in cancer, cardiology, and infectious respiratory diseases.

faculty.name: Xing Qiu
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on high-dimensional omics data preprocessing, analysis, modeling and integration, diffusion tensor imaging, dynamic network analysis using ODEs and state-space models, and differential geometry applications to hypothesis testing based on correlation and covariance structures.

faculty.name: Tongtong Wu
faculty.title: Professor and Director of MS Programs
faculty.summary: Research focuses on high-dimensional data analysis, survival analysis, machine learning, computational statistics, computational biology and statistical genetics, and longitudinal data analysis.

faculty.name: Christopher Beck
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on inference concerning receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves and surfaces, change-point problems, and clinical trials with applications in orthopedics and neurological disease.

faculty.name: Tanzy Love
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on clustering and latent variable models, mixed membership models and model choice, normalization and preprocessing for gene expression and proteomics data, Bayesian models for QTLs and growth curves, and scalable parallel model-based clustering.

faculty.name: Matthew McCall
faculty.title: Associate Professor and PhD Program Director
faculty.summary: Research focuses on statistical genomics, bioinformatics, systems biology, and biomedical data science. Develops statistical methods for miRNA-seq data, cancer gene regulatory network estimation, adjusting for cellular composition on tissue-level gene expression, and preprocessing and analysis of microglia imaging data.

faculty.name: Samuel Norman-Haignere
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on component modeling of neural responses, neural encoding models, brain organization of speech and music perception, sound synthesis, deep learning, functional MRI, and human intracranial electrophysiology with emphasis on temporal integration.

faculty.name: Michael Sohn
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on high-dimensional data analysis, compositional data analysis, statistical machine learning, causal mediation analysis, and genomics and metagenomics applications.

faculty.name: Seong-Hwan Jun
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on Bayesian models and computation, probabilistic machine learning, graphical models, statistical inference for combinatorial problems, single-cell transcriptomics, multi-omics data integration, cancer genomics, cancer-immune interaction, and phylogenetics.

faculty.name: Charles Wolock
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on nonparametric and semiparametric statistics, machine learning, survival analysis, statistical epidemiology, causal inference, and methods for assessing variable importance.

faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on Bayesian nonparametrics, adaptive clinical trial design, Bayesian bioinformatics, and computational statistics. Joint appointments in Mathematics and the Oden Institute. Elected Fellow of IMS, ASA, and ISBA; recipient of the Zellner Medal from ISBA and past President of ISBA. Adjunct professor at MD Anderson Cancer Center.

faculty.name: Mevin Hooten
faculty.title: Professor and PhD Graduate Advisor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on spatial statistics, ecological statistics, and Bayesian hierarchical models for complex environmental and ecological data. Serves as Graduate Advisor for the PhD program and GSC Chair.

faculty.name: Jay Bartroff
faculty.title: Professor and Associate Chair
faculty.summary: Research focuses on sequential analysis, multiple testing procedures, and Bayesian decision theory. Serves as Associate Chair of the Department of Statistics and Data Sciences and Faculty Advisor for the Undergraduate Major.

faculty.name: Catherine (Kate) Calder
faculty.title: Professor and Vice Provost for Academic Administration
faculty.sub_field: Spatial Statistics, Bayesian Modeling, Network Analysis
faculty.summary: Research focuses on spatial statistics, Bayesian modeling and computation, and statistical network analysis for complex structured data. Uses geographic location data to understand how routine activity patterns and social exposures affect adolescent health. Elected Fellow of ASA and AAAS. Served as department chair from 2019-2025, during which the department tripled its tenure-track faculty.

faculty.name: Roger Peng
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on environmental health statistics, particularly the health impacts of air pollution. Demonstrated that even very low levels of air pollution are statistically linked to increased hospitalizations and deaths from cardiovascular disease. Known for work in reproducible research.

faculty.name: Mingyuan Zhou
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Research at the intersection of Bayesian statistics and machine learning, including deep generative models, reinforcement learning, and Bayesian nonparametrics. Treasurer of the Bayesian Nonparametrics Section of ISBA. Area chair for NeurIPS, ICLR, and AAAI. Joint appointment with IROM.

faculty.name: Layla Parast
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on surrogate marker evaluation, causal inference, and biostatistics. Develops methods to improve medical treatment and clinical trial outcomes. Developed the R packages cohortsurr and etsi for surrogate marker analysis.

faculty.name: Purnamrita Sarkar
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on large-scale statistical machine learning, statistical models for networks, asymptotic theory, and scalable inference algorithms. Co-leads the NSF TRIPODS institute on Foundations of Data Science at UT Austin. Works on streaming PCA, network subsampling, community detection, variational inference, and the network jackknife.

faculty.name: Antonio Linero
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on Bayesian nonparametrics, Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) methods including the SoftBart R package, causal inference, and missing data. Recipient of an NSF CAREER Award for foundations of Bayesian nonparametric causal inference. Works on mediation analysis, survival analysis, and variable selection.

faculty.name: Yang Ni
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Causal Discovery, Bayesian Statistics, Graphical Models
faculty.summary: Research at the intersection of statistics, machine learning, AI, biology, and health. Focuses on Bayesian causal discovery for gene regulatory networks, Bayesian nonparametric modeling, graphical models for nonlinear causal discovery, and reinforcement learning. Applications in multi-omics data and electronic health records. Associate Editor for JASA and Bayesian Analysis.

faculty.name: Abhra Sarkar
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on Bayesian nonparametric and semiparametric methods for complex data, with applications in auditory and vocal communication neuroscience (analyzing animal vocalization sequences), nutritional epidemiology (longitudinal metabolomics), and imaging neuroscience. Recipient of the Mitchell Prize from ISBA for outstanding applied Bayesian analysis.

faculty.name: Nhat Ho
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on heterogeneity of data, interpretability of models, and stability and scalability of optimization and sampling algorithms. Postdoctoral training at UC Berkeley under Michael I. Jordan and Martin J. Wainwright. PhD in Statistics from University of Michigan.

faculty.name: Amanda Glazer
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on causal inference and nonparametric methods with applications in sports analytics. Previously worked with the San Francisco Giants. PhD in Statistics from UC Berkeley.

faculty.name: Yuling Yao
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.sub_field: Bayesian Computation, Machine Learning, Causal Inference
faculty.summary: Research focuses on Bayesian computation, machine learning, and causal inference. Joined UT Austin SDS as part of the 2024 faculty cohort.

faculty.name: Arya Farahi
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research spans astrostatistics (cosmology, two-point correlation function estimation), data science for social applications including transportation and housing. Director of the D3 Lab (Data, Discovery, Decision) and co-PI at the NSF-Simons AI Institute for Cosmic Origins.

faculty.name: Tim Andeen
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: ATLAS experiment at the LHC, focusing on data quality monitoring and Liquid Argon calorimeter electronics.

faculty.name: Kenneth Dunton
faculty.title: Professor and Department Chair
faculty.summary: Dunton investigates coastal ecosystem processes and aquatic plant physiological ecology, focusing on how climate change affects plant species composition, carbon storage, and food web structure across tropical to polar systems. His work emphasizes foundation species such as seagrasses and kelp in productivity and carbon cycling.

faculty.name: Edward Buskey
faculty.title: Professor; Nancy Lee and Perry R. Bass Regents Chair in Marine Science
faculty.summary: Buskey studies the behavioral ecology of marine zooplankton, including how sensory perception guides feeding and predator avoidance. His work examines photobehavior, bioluminescence, predator-prey dynamics, and impacts of crude oil on marine organisms.

faculty.name: Sharon Z. Herzka
faculty.title: Associate Professor; Director, Marine Science Institute
faculty.sub_field: Fish ecology & stable isotope trophic ecology
faculty.summary: Herzka investigates marine ecosystem dynamics in the Gulf of Mexico, focusing on early life history, habitat use, and dispersal of marine fishes. She uses stable isotope analysis to trace nutrient cycling and fish migration patterns.

faculty.name: Andrew Esbaugh
faculty.title: Professor of Marine Science
faculty.summary: Esbaugh investigates how fish physiology adapts to environmental conditions, focusing on respiratory gas exchange, acid-base balance, and osmoregulation. His work spans evolutionary mechanisms in water-breathing animals and physiological responses to ocean acidification and toxin exposure.

faculty.name: Deana Erdner
faculty.title: Professor of Marine Science
faculty.summary: Erdner's laboratory investigates the molecular biology and ecology of marine eukaryotic algae, with emphasis on harmful and/or toxic species, particularly dinoflagellates. Her work spans fundamental biological questions and applied studies of bloom formation.

faculty.name: Zhanfei Liu
faculty.title: Professor; Associate Chair, Department of Marine Science
faculty.summary: Liu studies the source, distribution and diagenesis of biogenic and anthropogenic compounds in the ocean, including natural organic matter, contaminants, and microplastics.

faculty.name: Xinping Hu
faculty.title: Professor, Department of Marine Science
faculty.summary: Hu's work focuses on carbon cycle science in estuarine and coastal environments, quantifying carbonate parameters and investigating how climate variability and anthropogenic pressures affect water chemistry and ecosystem health.

faculty.name: Brett Baker
faculty.title: Associate Professor; Co-director, Center for Planetary Science and Habitability
faculty.summary: Baker investigates microbial genomics and ecology, focusing on uncultured microorganisms and how microbial communities drive biogeochemical cycles. His work reconstructs genomes from natural populations to understand microbial diversity and evolution.

faculty.name: Mark Lever
faculty.title: Associate Professor of Marine Biogeochemistry and Geobiology
faculty.summary: Lever investigates the mechanistic and quantitative influence of microorganisms, humans, and abiotic factors on the short- and long-term fate of organic carbon in aquatic sediments and Earth's crust. His work emphasizes carbon cycling and sustainable carbon sequestration strategies.

faculty.name: Kelly Dorgan
faculty.title: Associate Professor, Marine Science
faculty.summary: Dorgan studies animal-sediment interactions at the intersection of sediment ecology and invertebrate biology. Her lab investigates how burrowing organisms alter their physical and chemical environments and builds mechanistic understanding of bioturbation.

faculty.name: Simon Brandl
faculty.title: Assistant Professor in Marine Science
faculty.summary: Brandl investigates biodiversity, coastal ecosystem processes, and nutrient cycling in oceanic and freshwater environments. His work focuses on fish ecology and the ecosystem functions fishes provide.

faculty.name: Jordan Casey
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Casey uses a molecular approach to measure marine biodiversity and trace trophic interactions, focusing on cryptic trophic pathways, fine-scale niche partitioning, and food web resilience under global change. Her work emphasizes tropical coral reefs and the Texas Coastal Bend.

requirements.english: TOEFL 79 (iBT) OR IELTS overall band score of 6.5 (international applicants only)
requirements.admission_model_note: Decisions made by the CSEM Admissions Committee: 'As soon as the CSEM Admissions Committee makes a decision on your application, it will be reflected in your MyStatus page.' No advisor pre-match is required, but the Statement of Purpose asks applicants to name 'who from among our faculty you would like to advise you on your research.'

funding.note: Considered but not explicitly guaranteed. 'All PhD applicants are considered for funding (fellowships and/or research assistantships)' and 'All applicants to the CSEM PhD Program are considered for financial aid as part of the admissions process.' No published multi-year funding guarantee or duration was found; Master's students have no funding. Source: oden.utexas.edu how-to-apply and admissions-faq pages.

requirements.contact_note: 'Applicants are not required to contact faculty directly as part of our application process.' (CSEM Admissions FAQ). The Statement of Purpose does ask applicants to identify faculty they would like to work with.

faculty.name: Lawrence Band
faculty.title: Ernest H. Ern Professor
faculty.summary: Band studies eco-hydrology across natural and urban watersheds, including the role of forests and tree canopy on flooding and drought. His current work emphasizes green infrastructure design and computational tools for watershed restoration.

faculty.name: Meghan Blumstein
faculty.title: Assistant Professor (Joint Faculty with Landscape Architecture)
faculty.summary: Blumstein studies how forests will survive stress from pests, disease, disturbance, and a changing climate. Her lab combines genomics, quantitative genetics, plant physiology, and spatially explicit modeling to understand drivers of resilience in tree species.

faculty.name: Max C. N. Castorani
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Castorani investigates ecological processes governing species abundance, distribution, and ecosystem stability across scales, focusing on disturbance and biodiversity's role in stabilizing function. His work centers on nearshore marine systems such as kelp forests and seagrass meadows.

faculty.name: Frederick Cheng
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Cheng examines how natural and built infrastructure cycle pollutants and protect water resources through nature-based solutions. His group studies interactions between hydrologic processes and biogeochemical cycles across terrestrial-aquatic interfaces using modeling, geospatial analysis, and machine learning.

faculty.name: Robert E. Davis
faculty.title: Director of Undergraduate Programs, Professor
faculty.summary: Davis investigates interactions between weather/climate and human health, emphasizing heat mortality and respiratory morbidity and mortality. His work also covers synoptic climatology, air-quality health linkages, and climate influences on viticulture.

faculty.name: Stephan De Wekker
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: De Wekker studies how landscape heterogeneities affect atmospheric boundary layer processes in mountainous terrain. His work integrates field studies, data analysis, and numerical modeling to examine atmospheric circulation and regional transport.

faculty.name: Scott Doney
faculty.title: Joe D. and Helen J. Kington Professor in Environmental Change
faculty.summary: Doney's research spans oceanography, climate, and biogeochemistry, using numerical models, remote sensing, and data analysis. He focuses on how the global carbon cycle and marine ecosystems respond to climate change, including ocean warming, sea-ice loss, and ocean acidification.

faculty.name: Howard E. Epstein
faculty.title: Sidman P. Poole Professor
faculty.summary: Epstein studies Arctic tundra vegetation dynamics in response to climate change and disturbance. He also examines carbon cycling and carbon-water interactions in Mid-Atlantic temperate forests along successional gradients.

faculty.name: Kevin Grise
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Grise's group focuses on atmospheric dynamics and their role in variability and long-term change in the climate system. His work examines clouds and their climate effects, circulation changes under greenhouse gas increases, and how storm tracks vary across timescales.

faculty.name: Huilin Huang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Huang studies land-atmosphere interactions amid environmental change, with expertise in wildfire and land cover change. His work involves Earth system model development, including fire models, land surface models, and regional and global circulation models.

faculty.name: Manuel Lerdau
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Lerdau is an organismal ecologist studying resource acquisition and allocation in plants, herbivory and tri-trophic interactions, atmospheric chemistry and air pollution, and ecosystem impacts of biological invasions. Current work emphasizes genomics, stress tolerance, trace gas exchange, and ecosystem responses to climate change.

faculty.name: Ajay B. Limaye
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Limaye studies the evolution of landscapes on Earth and other planets, focusing on the role of rivers. His work examines river forms and dynamics, sedimentary records of climate on Mars and Titan, and landslide-ecology interactions using remote sensing, modeling, and laboratory experiments.

faculty.name: Antonios Mamalakis
faculty.title: Assistant Professor (Joint Faculty with School of Data Science)
faculty.summary: Mamalakis is an environmental data scientist who uses statistical and Bayesian analysis, machine/deep learning, and explainable AI to address environmental challenges. His work improves prediction of hydroclimate and extreme events and advances understanding of climate teleconnections, predictability, and causal discovery.

faculty.name: Karen McGlathery
faculty.title: Sherrell J. Aston Professor
faculty.summary: McGlathery examines ecosystem dynamics in shallow coastal systems and how climate change, nutrient enrichment, and invasive species drive change. She investigates blue carbon sequestration in seagrass ecosystems, seagrass restoration, and salt marsh resilience to rising seas.

faculty.name: Lauren Miller
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Miller investigates past changes in coastal, marine, and glacial environments through sedimentological and geomorphological archives. She examines the processes that shaped these systems over time.

faculty.name: Charity Nyelele
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Nyelele explores connections between biodiversity, climate change, and ecosystem services through an environmental justice lens. She focuses on urban forested systems and how planning and management affect the availability and equitable distribution of services such as stormwater management, air quality, and carbon sequestration.

faculty.name: Sally Pusede
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Pusede is an atmospheric chemist investigating air quality and climate change, with focus on reactive nitrogen, chemical oxidation, neighborhood-level variability, and nitrous oxide emissions. She is also Co-Director of the Repair Lab, an interdisciplinary environmental justice initiative at UVA.

faculty.name: Matthew A. Reidenbach
faculty.title: Department Chair, Professor
faculty.summary: Reidenbach studies environmental fluid dynamics with emphasis on physical-biological interactions in coastal environments, including flow and turbulence effects on nutrient exchange in coral reefs, estuarine sediment transport, and wave dynamics. His research also examines how ecosystems such as coral reefs, seagrasses, and oyster beds respond to waves and storms.

faculty.name: Justin Richardson
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Richardson investigates soil biogeochemistry, examining how metals and metalloids are sourced from rocks and minerals and move via water and air to and from soils. His work spans natural and human-disturbed ecosystems in the eastern United States using advanced analytical techniques.

faculty.name: Todd Scanlon
faculty.title: Associate Chair, Professor
faculty.summary: Scanlon investigates catchment hydrology and land-atmosphere interactions, examining water, energy, and gas exchange between terrestrial surfaces and the atmosphere. His work integrates field observations, remote sensing, and modeling across multiple scales.

faculty.name: Kathleen Schiro
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Schiro studies atmospheric convection, tropical dynamics, and regional hydroclimatology. Her work aims to improve understanding of clouds, convection, and precipitation in a changing climate by combining field observations, satellite data, and modeling.

faculty.name: Xi Yang
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Yang investigates how vegetation and climate interact as the planet warms, spanning spatial ecology, plant physiology, remote sensing, and climate change. She develops remote-sensing methods for measuring plant traits and uses computational techniques like data assimilation to improve predictive models.

faculty.name: Jianhui Zhou

faculty.summary: Research interests include dimension reduction, robust statistics, longitudinal data analysis, functional data analysis, quantile regression, and growth curve modeling. Has advised eight PhD students with placements at Facebook, Amazon, Yahoo Research, and other industry roles.

faculty.title: Professor, General Faculty, Director of Graduate Studies

faculty.name: Jordan Rodu
faculty.title: Associate Professor

faculty.name: Martin Slawski
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Research combines statistics and computer science to address contemporary data science challenges, including high-dimensional data analysis, data integration and record linkage (with connections to data privacy), permuted/mismatched data problems, data compression and dimensionality reduction, biometric recognition, sparse signal recovery, and matrix factorization. Applied to health and engineering domains with NSF, NIH, and National Institute of Justice funding.

faculty.name: Dan Spitzner
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.sub_field: Bayesian Statistics and Mixed Methods Research
faculty.summary: Research focuses on coordinated analysis of diverse data forms and conceptions of statistical knowledge that integrate with alternative inquiry modes including qualitative and mixed methods. Technical work in Bayesian statistics includes model choice techniques for high-dimensional analysis and clustering problems, communicating strength of evidence, functional data analysis, and classical shrinkage estimation. Interested in application of statistical methods in socially inclusive research.

faculty.name: Gretchen Martinet

faculty.name: Shounak Chattopadhyay
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research focuses on developing scalable, structured, and interpretable Bayesian methods, with emphasis on Bayesian nonparametrics. Works on incorporating prior information, bypassing computational bottlenecks, and obtaining provable theoretical guarantees. Member of the OHDSI community and passionate about delivering reliable clinical evidence from massive observational healthcare data-driven studies.

faculty.name: Chunlin Li
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Research is centered on causal inference and its intersections with machine learning and public health applications. Previously an Assistant Professor at Iowa State University. PhD in Statistics from University of Minnesota, Twin Cities (2022).

faculty.title: Assistant Professor

Recent work includes vertex misalignment and changepoint localization in network time series, recovering manifold structure in LLM responses, joint cluster recovery, Procrustes problems on random matrices, and joint spectral clustering in multilayer degree-corrected stochastic blockmodels (published in JASA). Also funded by CosmicAI for merger t

faculty.name: Lingxiao Wang
faculty.title: Assistant Professor

Develops pseudo-weighting methods for nonprobability samples, model-assisted calibration weighting, and methods for integrating epidemiologic cohort data with national health surveys (NHIS, NHANES) and cancer registries. Builds nationally representative lung cancer risk models for screening and estimates pure risks for minority subgroups. Former Research Fellow at NCI/NIH.

Emphasizes trustworthy and interpretable AI with rigorous statistical inference. Methodological toolkit includes non- and semi-parametric inference, distributed learning, probabilistic generative modeling, causal learning, functional data analysis, and spatial/spatiotemporal data modeling. PhD in Statistics from I

faculty.name: Taylor Brown
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, General Faculty

Published work on Bayesian forecasting algorithms for time series, particle filtering (including a C++ library PF), particle swarm algorithms for posterior predictive distributions, correlated pseudo-marginal sampling, and multivariate stochastic volatility models with Particle MCMC. PhD in Statistics from University of Virginia (2018).

faculty.name: Jeffrey Berman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies seismic performance of steel and heavy timber structures, innovative seismic load resisting systems, and performance-based seismic design, with a focus on Pacific Northwest seismic hazards. Works in the UW Large-Scale Structural Engineering Testing Laboratory.

faculty.name: Paolo Calvi
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Combines large-scale experimental testing with numerical modeling to evaluate structures under earthquakes and other natural hazards. Focuses on passive/semi-active/active response-control technologies, base-isolated buildings, bridge bearings, and effects of corrosion and material degradation on structural resilience.

faculty.name: Marc Eberhard
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches rapid construction and performance of reinforced and prestressed concrete buildings and bridges subjected to gravity loads, earthquakes, and tsunamis.

faculty.name: Dawn Lehman
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Conducts large-scale testing of bridge and building components and performance-based earthquake engineering research, including concrete-filled tube components and connections, RC wall design and retrofit, tsunami evacuation structures, and sustainable concrete materials.

faculty.name: Laura Lowes
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Develops tools for modeling the nonlinear response of structural systems subjected to severe loading, including finite element modeling of reinforced concrete components, beam-column joint response under earthquake loading, and fiber optic sensing for structural health monitoring.

faculty.name: Michael Motley
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Studies fluid-structure interaction of large-scale structural systems, including tsunami wave load prediction, multi-hazard response of coastal infrastructure, and structural response of renewable energy devices and marine composites using computational fluid dynamics.

faculty.name: Travis Thonstad
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.summary: Researches earthquake engineering, structural robustness, and precast and prestressed concrete structures. Holds a Ph.D. in Civil and Environmental Engineering from the University of Washington.

faculty.name: Richard Wiebe
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Studies nonlinear structural dynamics of civil, mechanical, and aerospace structures using numerical and experimental methods, including structural response in extreme environments, stability of slender structures, and marine turbine applications.

faculty.name: Michael Brett
faculty.title: Professor
faculty.summary: Researches eutrophication and regulation of algal biomass in lakes, essential fatty acid production and bioaccumulation in aquatic food webs, zooplankton ecology, and nutrient bioavailability and biogeochemical recalcitrance.

faculty.name: David Butman
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.summary: Investigates global and regional carbon cycling and the biogeochemical connections between land and water systems using advanced field techniques, geospatial modeling, and satellite remote sensing, with a focus on freshwater resource management and climate impacts.

faculty.name: Michael Dodd
faculty.title: Professor

faculty.name: Erica Fuhrmeister

faculty.name: Gregory Korshin
